117 public static linearUnitsType ParseUnits(string units) => units?.ToLowerInvariant() switch
118 {
119 "unitless" => linearUnitsType.Unitless,
120 "inch" or "inches" => linearUnitsType.Inches,
121 "foot" or "feet" or "ft" => linearUnitsType.Feet,
122 "mile" or "miles" or "mi" => linearUnitsType.Miles,
123 "mm" or "millimeter" or "millimeters" => linearUnitsType.Millimeters,
124 "cm" or "centimeter" or "centimeters" => linearUnitsType.Centimeters,
125 "m" or "meter" or "meters" => linearUnitsType.Meters,
126 "km" or "kilometer" or "kilometers" => linearUnitsType.Kilometers,
127 "microinch" or "microinches" => linearUnitsType.Microinches,
128 "mil" or "mils" => linearUnitsType.Mils,
129 "yard" or "yards" => linearUnitsType.Yards,
130 "angstrom" or "angstroms" => linearUnitsType.Angstroms,
131 "nm" or "nanometer" or "nanometers" => linearUnitsType.Nanometers,
132 "micron" or "microns" => linearUnitsType.Microns,
133 "dm" or "decimeter" or "decimeters" => linearUnitsType.Decimeters,
134 "dam" or "decameter" or "decameters" => linearUnitsType.Decameters,
135 "hm" or "hectometer" or "hectometers" => linearUnitsType.Hectometers,
136 "gm" or "gigameter" or "gigameters" => linearUnitsType.Gigameters,
137 "au" or "astronomical" => linearUnitsType.Astronomical,
138 "ly" or "lightyear" or "lightyears" => linearUnitsType.LightYears,
139 "parsec" or "parsecs" => linearUnitsType.Parsecs,
140 _ => linearUnitsType.Millimeters
141 };

648 {
649 CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange();
650 var dlg = new OpenFileDialog
651 {

655 };
656

658 {

660 if (config != null)
661 {
662 await RestoreSessionFromConfig(config);
663 }
664 }
665 });

671 private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task RestoreSessionFromConfig(HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Models.Configuration.SessionConfig config)
672 {
673 if (config == null) return;
674 CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange();
675 UndoManager.Clear();
676
677 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_RestoringSession") ?? "Restoring session...";
678 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
679
680 try
681 {
682 // 1. Clear current state
683 CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange();
684 _designControl.Clear();
685
686 Entities.Clear();
687 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
688 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
689 _allFacesByColor.Clear();
690 _facesByColor.Clear();
691 _holesByColor.Clear();
692 _faceIndexToHoleMap = null;
693 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
694 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
695 _flippedFaceNormals.Clear();
696 _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
697 _pathManager.ClearAllPaths();
698 _pathManager.InvalidateShellCache();
699
700 // Re-initialize manager since _designControl.Clear() removed its block/reference
701 _ignoredItemManager = new IgnoredItemManager(_designControl);
702
703 // 2. Load Models
704 if (config.Models.Any())
705 {
706 CurrentlyLoadedFilePath = config.Models.First().FilePath;
707 }
708
709 foreach (var model in config.Models)
710 {
711 if (File.Exists(model.FilePath))
712 {
713 await ImportModelQuietlyAsync(model.FilePath, LoadMatrixFromArray(model.CurrentTransform), LoadMatrixFromArray(model.OriginalTransform));
714 }
715 }
716
717 // Build file-path-to-entity-index map from newly loaded entities
718 // This is needed because ImportModelQuietlyAsync creates entities at new indices
719 var fileToEntityIndex = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
720 for (int i = 0; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
721 {
722 var ent = _designControl.Entities[i];
723 if (IsSessionModelEntity(ent))
724 {
725 string? filePath = ent.EntityData as string;
726 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath) && !fileToEntityIndex.ContainsKey(filePath))
727 fileToEntityIndex[filePath] = i;
728 }
729 }
730
731 var oldToNewEntityIndex = new Dictionary<int, int>();
732
733 // Run all UI/restoration operations synchronously on the UI thread dispatcher
734 await _designControl.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
735 {
736 // 3. Restore Metadata (Faces/Holes) directly from configuration
737 // We DO NOT re-extract faces here to save time and ensure exact match with saved state
738 if (config.FullCADData != null && config.FullCADData.Any())
739 {
740 foreach (var groupDTO in config.FullCADData)
741 {
742 string colorKey = groupDTO.ColorName ?? "Default";
743
744 if (!_allFacesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey)) _allFacesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADFace>();
745 if (!_facesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey)) _facesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADFace>();
746 if (!_holesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey)) _holesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADHole>();
747
748 _allFacesByColor[colorKey].AddRange(groupDTO.Faces);
749
750 foreach (var holeDto in groupDTO.Holes)
751 {
752 _holesByColor[colorKey].Add(CADHole.FromDTO(holeDto));
753 }
754
755 // Split _allFacesByColor into _facesByColor (non-hole faces only for tree view)
756 var holeFaceIndices = _holesByColor[colorKey].SelectMany(h => h.FaceGlobalIndices).ToHashSet();
757 _facesByColor[colorKey].AddRange(groupDTO.Faces.Where(f => !holeFaceIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)));
758 }
759
760 // Remap EntityIndex for all restored faces to match newly loaded entity indices
761 // We map each face's Original EntityIndex (which is face.EntityIndex right now)
762 // to the new EntityIndex in the loaded session.
763 // First, let's build a map of ModelFilePath -> List of new entity indices
764 var fileToEntityIndices = new Dictionary<string, List<int>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
765 for (int i = 0; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
766 {
767 var ent = _designControl.Entities[i];
768 if (IsSessionModelEntity(ent))
769 {
770 string? filePath = ent.EntityData as string;
771 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
772 {
773 if (!fileToEntityIndices.ContainsKey(filePath))
774 fileToEntityIndices[filePath] = new List<int>();
775 fileToEntityIndices[filePath].Add(i);
776 }
777 }
778 }
779
780 // We also need to group the faces by their original EntityIndex so we can map them in order.
781 // Assuming that the order of original EntityIndex for a given file matches the order of new EntityIndex.
782 var originalIndicesByFile = new Dictionary<string, SortedSet<int>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
783 foreach (var faceList in _allFacesByColor.Values)
784 {
785 foreach (var face in faceList)
786 {
787 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(face.ModelFilePath))
788 {
789 if (!originalIndicesByFile.ContainsKey(face.ModelFilePath))
790 originalIndicesByFile[face.ModelFilePath] = new SortedSet<int>();
791 originalIndicesByFile[face.ModelFilePath].Add(face.EntityIndex);
792 }
793 }
794 }
795
796 // Create the explicit mapping from old EntityIndex to new EntityIndex
797 foreach (var kvp in originalIndicesByFile)
798 {
799 string filePath = kvp.Key;
800 var oldIndices = kvp.Value.ToList();
801 if (fileToEntityIndices.TryGetValue(filePath, out var newIndices))
802 {
803 // Map in order. If there are mismatches, map up to the available count.
804 int count = Math.Min(oldIndices.Count, newIndices.Count);
805 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
806 {
807 oldToNewEntityIndex[oldIndices[i]] = newIndices[i];
808 }
809 }
810 }
811
812 foreach (var faceList in _allFacesByColor.Values)
813 {
814 foreach (var face in faceList)
815 {
816 if (oldToNewEntityIndex.TryGetValue(face.EntityIndex, out int newIdx))
817 {
818 face.EntityIndex = newIdx;
819 }
820 else
821 {
822 // Fallback: try to find an entity that can hold this face if the exact mapping failed
823 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(face.ModelFilePath) && fileToEntityIndices.TryGetValue(face.ModelFilePath, out var newIndices))
824 {
825 foreach (int possibleIdx in newIndices)
826 {
827 if (possibleIdx < _designControl.Entities.Count && _designControl.Entities[possibleIdx] is Brep brep)
828 {
829 if (face.FaceIndex < brep.Faces.Length)
830 {
831 face.EntityIndex = possibleIdx;
832 break;
833 }
834 }
835 }
836 }
837 }
838 }
839 }
840
841 UpdateFaceIndexToHoleMap();
842 FacesUpToDate = true;
843 }
844
845 // 4. Restore Statuses (Ignored / Flipped)
846 _flippedFaceNormals = new HashSet<int>(config.FlippedNormals);
847 ApplyFlippedFaceTextures();
848
849 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
850 foreach (var faceIdx in config.IgnoredFacesIndices)
851 {
852 var face = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).FirstOrDefault(f => f.FaceGlobalIndex == faceIdx);
853 if (face != null)
854 {
855 face.IsIgnored = true;
856 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
857 }
858 }
859
860 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
861 foreach (var holeId in config.IgnoredHolesIndices)
862 {
863 var hole = _holesByColor.Values.SelectMany(h => h).FirstOrDefault(h => h.HoleId == holeId);
864 if (hole != null)
865 {
866 hole.IsIgnored = true;
867 IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
868 }
869 }
870
871 // 5. Restore Paths
872 if (config.ProbePathPlanningInfo != null)
873 {
874 _pathManager.LoadPathFromDTO(config.ProbePathPlanningInfo);
875 RemapLoadedPathPointEntityIndices(oldToNewEntityIndex);
876 RepairMissingPathPointOwnershipFromModelGeometry();
877 if (measuring_sp != null)
878 {
879 // Only collapse if there are actual paths
880 if (config.ProbePathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths != null && config.ProbePathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths.Any())
881 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
882 else
883 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
884 }
885 _lastSavedPathHash = _pathManager.GetPathStateHash();
886 }
887 else
888 {
889 if (measuring_sp != null)
890 {
891 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
892 }
893 _lastSavedPathHash = string.Empty;
894 }
895
896 // 6. Restore Meshes (Shells only, Ignored mesh is reconstructed dynamically below)
897 void EnsureLayerExistsLocal(string layerName)
898 {
899 if (!_designControl.Layers.Contains(layerName))
900 {
901 bool isShell = layerName != null && layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
902 var layer = new devDept.Eyeshot.Layer(layerName) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.White, Visible = !isShell };
903 _designControl.Layers.Add(layer);
904 }
905 }
906
907 if (config.ShellMeshes != null)
908 {
909 foreach (var shellDto in config.ShellMeshes)
910 {
911 var mesh = shellDto.ToMesh();
912 if (mesh != null)
913 {
914 EnsureLayerExistsLocal(mesh.LayerName);
915 if (mesh.LayerName != null && mesh.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
916 {
917 mesh.Visible = false;
918 }
919 _designControl.Entities.Add(mesh);
920 }
921 }
922 }
923
924 var sdfValidationInput = BuildSdfShellCacheValidationInput(config.Models, recomputeHashes: true);
925 _pathManager.TryAttachSdfShellCache(config.SdfShellCache, sdfValidationInput);
926
927 // 7. Restore entity processing order
928 if (config.ModelFileOrder != null && config.ModelFileOrder.Any())
929 {
930 var cadEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsSessionModelEntity).ToList();
931 var ordered = new List<Entity>();
932 var usedEntities = new HashSet<Entity>();
933
934 foreach (var filePath in config.ModelFileOrder)
935 {
936 // Find the first entity matching the file path that hasn't been used yet
937 var match = cadEntities.FirstOrDefault(e =>
938 string.Equals(e.EntityData as string, filePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
939 !usedEntities.Contains(e));
940
941 if (match != null)
942 {
943 ordered.Add(match);
944 usedEntities.Add(match);
945 }
946 }
947 // Add any remaining entities that weren't explicitly ordered
948 ordered.AddRange(cadEntities.Except(ordered));
949 OrderedPartEntities = ordered;
950 }
951
952 // 8. Reconstruct Ignored Mesh dynamically from stored indices
953 if (IgnoredFaces.Any())
954 {
955 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(IgnoredFaces);
956 }
957
958 // 9. UI Update - Enable commands before populating TreeView
959 CanExtractFaces = true;
960 CanExport = true;
961
962 bool hasExtractedFaces = config.FullCADData != null && config.FullCADData.Any();
963 bool hasPlanning = config.ProbePathPlanningInfo != null && config.ProbePathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths != null && config.ProbePathPlanningInfo.ColorPaths.Any();
964
965 PlanningTab_Enabled = hasExtractedFaces;
966 MeasuringTab_Enabled = hasExtractedFaces && hasPlanning;
967
968 _lastExtractedEntityCount = _designControl.Entities.Count;
969 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces") ?? "Update Faces";
970
971 // 10. Final Visual & UI Update
972 _ignoredItemManager.SyncVisibility();
973 _visualsManager.DrawAllMarkers(_allFacesByColor, _holesByColor, IgnoredFaces, IgnoredHoles, _flippedFaceNormals);
974
975 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
976 _designControl.Invalidate();
977
978 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
979 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
980
981 if (TreeViewItems == null || TreeViewItems.Count == 0)
982 {
983 PlanningTab_Enabled = false;
984 }
985
986 planning_sp?.InitializeToleranceSliders();
987 measuring_sp?.UpdateMeasurementCounts();
988
989 SaveCurrentSession();
990
991 // 11. Reconstruct Undo History from EditHistory
992 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.EditHistory.Any())
993 {
994 UndoManager.Clear();
995 foreach (var edit in _pathManager.EditHistory)
996 {
997 var color = Color.FromArgb(edit.ColorR, edit.ColorG, edit.ColorB);
998 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths.TryGetValue(color, out var path))
999 {
1000 var oldPos = new Point3D(edit.OldX, edit.OldY, edit.OldZ);
1001 var newPos = new Point3D(edit.NewX, edit.NewY, edit.NewZ);
1002
1003 // Reconstruct the command using the target marker entity created during DrawAllPaths
1004 var marker = FindMarker(color, edit.PointIndex);
1005 if (marker != null)
1006 {
1007 // Use MoveWaypointCommand to support cross-session undo
1008 UndoManager.PushCommand(new MoveWaypointCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, path, edit.PointIndex, oldPos, newPos, Vector3D.AxisZ, Vector3D.AxisZ, marker));
1009 }
1010 }
1011 }
1012 UndoManager.MarkSaved();
1013 }
1014
1015 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_SessionRestored") ?? "Session restored from {0}", config.Timestamp);
1016 DesignerVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
1017 }, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
1018
1019 await Task.Delay(200);
1020 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
1021 {
1022 _designControl.Entities.UpdateBoundingBox();
1023 _designControl.ZoomFit();
1024 _designControl.Invalidate();
1025 }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle);
1026 }
1027 catch (Exception ex)
1028 {
1029 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show($"Error restoring session: {ex.Message}", "Error", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
1030 }
1031 finally
1032 {
1033 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
1034 }
1035 }

1040 private sealed class PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds
1041 {
1045 public int EntityIndex { get; set; }
1049 public Point3D BoxMin { get; set; } = Point3D.Origin;
1053 public Point3D BoxMax { get; set; } = Point3D.Origin;
1054 }
1055
1060 private void RemapLoadedPathPointEntityIndices(IReadOnlyDictionary<int, int> oldToNewEntityIndex)
1061 {
1062 if (_pathManager?.ColorPaths == null)
1063 return;
1064
1065 foreach (var path in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
1066 {
1067 if (path?.Points == null)
1068 continue;
1069
1070 EnsurePathPointEntityIndexCount(path);
1071
1072 for (int i = 0; i < path.PointEntityIndices.Count; i++)
1073 {
1074 int oldIndex = path.PointEntityIndices[i];
1075 if (oldIndex < 0)
1076 continue;
1077
1078 if (oldToNewEntityIndex != null && oldToNewEntityIndex.TryGetValue(oldIndex, out int newIndex))
1079 {
1080 path.PointEntityIndices[i] = newIndex;
1081 }
1082 else if (!IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(oldIndex))
1083 {
1084 path.PointEntityIndices[i] = -1;
1085 }
1086 }
1087 }
1088 }
1089
1093 private void RepairMissingPathPointOwnershipFromModelGeometry()
1094 {
1095 if (_pathManager?.ColorPaths == null || _designControl?.Entities == null)
1096 return;
1097
1098 var partBounds = BuildPathOwnershipRepairPartBounds();
1099 if (partBounds.Count == 0)
1100 return;
1101
1102 var exclusiveColorOwnersByArgb = BuildExclusiveFaceColorOwnersByArgb();
1103
1104 foreach (var path in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
1105 {
1106 if (path?.Points == null || path.Points.Count == 0)
1107 continue;
1108
1109 EnsurePathPointEntityIndexCount(path);
1110
1111 bool hasMissingOwnership = path.PointEntityIndices.Any(index => !IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(index));
1112 if (!hasMissingOwnership)
1113 continue;
1114
1115 int colorArgb = path.Color.ToArgb();
1116 for (int i = 0; i < path.Points.Count; i++)
1117 {
1118 if (IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(path.PointEntityIndices[i]))
1119 continue;
1120
1121 int inferredEntityIndex = -1;
1122 if (!IsBridgeIntermediaryPathPoint(path, i))
1123 {
1124 if (exclusiveColorOwnersByArgb.TryGetValue(colorArgb, out int colorOwner) &&
1125 IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(colorOwner))
1126 {
1127 inferredEntityIndex = colorOwner;
1128 }
1129 else
1130 {
1131 inferredEntityIndex = FindNearestPartEntityIndex(path.Points[i], partBounds);
1132 }
1133 }
1134
1135 path.PointEntityIndices[i] = inferredEntityIndex;
1136 }
1137 }
1138 }
1139
1144 private List<PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds> BuildPathOwnershipRepairPartBounds()
1145 {
1146 var bounds = new List<PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds>();
1147 if (_designControl?.Entities == null)
1148 return bounds;
1149
1150 for (int i = 0; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
1151 {
1152 var entity = _designControl.Entities[i];
1153 if (!IsSessionModelEntity(entity))
1154 continue;
1155
1156 if (!TryGetFiniteEntityBounds(entity, out var boxMin, out var boxMax))
1157 continue;
1158
1159 bounds.Add(new PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds
1160 {
1161 EntityIndex = i,
1162 BoxMin = boxMin,
1163 BoxMax = boxMax
1164 });
1165 }
1166
1167 return bounds;
1168 }
1169
1174 private Dictionary<int, int> BuildExclusiveFaceColorOwnersByArgb()
1175 {
1176 var ownersByColor = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();
1177 if (_allFacesByColor == null)
1178 return new Dictionary<int, int>();
1179
1180 foreach (var face in _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(faces => faces))
1181 {
1182 if (face == null || !IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(face.EntityIndex))
1183 continue;
1184
1185 int argb = face.FaceColor.ToArgb();
1186 if (!ownersByColor.TryGetValue(argb, out var owners))
1187 {
1188 owners = new HashSet<int>();
1189 ownersByColor[argb] = owners;
1190 }
1191
1192 owners.Add(face.EntityIndex);
1193 }
1194
1195 return ownersByColor
1196 .Where(kvp => kvp.Value.Count == 1)
1197 .ToDictionary(kvp => kvp.Key, kvp => kvp.Value.First());
1198 }

1205 private bool IsCurrentSessionModelEntityIndex(int entityIndex)
1206 {
1207 return _designControl?.Entities != null &&
1208 entityIndex >= 0 &&
1209 entityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count &&
1210 IsSessionModelEntity(_designControl.Entities[entityIndex]);

1217 private static void EnsurePathPointEntityIndexCount(ColorPath path)
1218 {
1219 path.PointEntityIndices ??= new List<int>();
1220
1221 if (path.Points == null)
1222 {
1223 path.PointEntityIndices.Clear();
1224 return;
1225 }
1226
1227 while (path.PointEntityIndices.Count < path.Points.Count)
1228 path.PointEntityIndices.Add(-1);
1229
1230 if (path.PointEntityIndices.Count > path.Points.Count)
1231 path.PointEntityIndices.RemoveRange(path.Points.Count, path.PointEntityIndices.Count - path.Points.Count);
1232 }
1233
1240 private static bool IsBridgeIntermediaryPathPoint(ColorPath path, int pointIndex)
1241 {
1242 string? pointType = path.PointTypes != null &&
1243 pointIndex >= 0 &&
1244 pointIndex < path.PointTypes.Count
1245 ? path.PointTypes[pointIndex]
1246 : null;
1247
1248 return string.Equals(pointType, "BridgeIntermediary", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1249 }
1250
1257 private static int FindNearestPartEntityIndex(Point3D point, IReadOnlyList<PathOwnershipRepairPartBounds> partBounds)
1258 {
1259 if (!IsFiniteGeometryPoint(point) || partBounds == null || partBounds.Count == 0)
1260 return -1;
1261
1262 int bestEntityIndex = -1;
1263 double bestDistanceSquared = double.MaxValue;
1264
1265 foreach (var bounds in partBounds)
1266 {
1267 double distanceSquared = DistanceSquaredToBox(point, bounds.BoxMin, bounds.BoxMax);
1268 if (distanceSquared < bestDistanceSquared)
1269 {
1270 bestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared;
1271 bestEntityIndex = bounds.EntityIndex;
1272 }
1273 }
1274
1275 return bestEntityIndex;
1276 }
1277
1285 private static bool TryGetFiniteEntityBounds(Entity entity, out Point3D boxMin, out Point3D boxMax)
1286 {
1287 boxMin = Point3D.Origin;
1288 boxMax = Point3D.Origin;
1289
1290 if (entity == null)
1291 return false;
1292
1293 try
1294 {
1295 entity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
1296 var min = entity.BoxMin;
1297 var max = entity.BoxMax;
1298 if (!IsFiniteGeometryPoint(min) || !IsFiniteGeometryPoint(max))
1299 return false;
1300
1301 boxMin = new Point3D(
1302 Math.Min(min.X, max.X),
1303 Math.Min(min.Y, max.Y),
1304 Math.Min(min.Z, max.Z));
1305 boxMax = new Point3D(
1306 Math.Max(min.X, max.X),
1307 Math.Max(min.Y, max.Y),
1308 Math.Max(min.Z, max.Z));
1309 return true;
1310 }
1311 catch
1312 {
1313 return false;
1314 }
1315 }
1316
1324 private static double DistanceSquaredToBox(Point3D point, Point3D boxMin, Point3D boxMax)
1325 {
1326 double dx = point.X < boxMin.X ? boxMin.X - point.X : point.X > boxMax.X ? point.X - boxMax.X : 0.0;
1327 double dy = point.Y < boxMin.Y ? boxMin.Y - point.Y : point.Y > boxMax.Y ? point.Y - boxMax.Y : 0.0;
1328 double dz = point.Z < boxMin.Z ? boxMin.Z - point.Z : point.Z > boxMax.Z ? point.Z - boxMax.Z : 0.0;
1329
1330 return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
1331 }
1332
1338 private static bool IsFiniteGeometryPoint(Point3D point)
1339 {
1340 return point != null &&
1341 !double.IsNaN(point.X) &&
1342 !double.IsNaN(point.Y) &&
1343 !double.IsNaN(point.Z) &&
1344 !double.IsInfinity(point.X) &&
1345 !double.IsInfinity(point.Y) &&
1346 !double.IsInfinity(point.Z);
1347 }

1355 private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task ImportModelQuietlyAsync(string path, devDept.Geometry.Transformation currentTrans, devDept.Geometry.Transformation originalResetTrans)
1356 {
1357 // Similar to LoadModelAsync but without clearing and with specific transforms
1358 try
1359 {
1360 var tempDesign = new Design();
1361 ReadSTEP reader = null!;
1362
1363 await Task.Run(() =>
1364 {
1365 reader = new ReadSTEP(path);
1366 reader.DoWork();
1367 }).ConfigureAwait(false);
1368
1369 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
1370 {
1371 reader.AddTo(tempDesign);
1372
1373 // IMPORTANT: Copy Blocks from tempDesign to _designControl
1374 // BlockReferences in Entities need their Blocks to be present in the same Document
1375 foreach (Block b in tempDesign.Blocks)
1376 {
1377 if (!_designControl.Blocks.Contains(b.Name))
1378 _designControl.Blocks.Add(b);
1379 }
1380
1381 // IMPORTANT: Copy Layers from tempDesign to _designControl
1382 foreach (Layer l in tempDesign.Layers)
1383 {
1384 if (!_designControl.Layers.Contains(l.Name))
1385 _designControl.Layers.Add(l);
1386 }
1387
1388 foreach (var ent in tempDesign.Entities)
1389 {
1390 ent.EntityData = path; // Important for saving later
1391
1392 // Apply current transform
1393 ent.TransformBy(currentTrans);
1394
1395 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
1396
1397 // Store in _originalPositions for Reset capability
1398 StoreOriginalPosition(ent, new List<Entity> { ent }, currentTrans);
1399 }
1400 _designControl.Units = _units;
1401 });
1402 }
1403 catch (Exception ex)
1404 {
1405 Debug.WriteLine($"Error importing model quietly: {ex.Message}");
1406 }
1407 }

1412 public void SaveCurrentSession()
1413 {
1414 try
1415 {
1416 var config = new HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Models.Configuration.SessionConfig
1417 {
1418 Timestamp = DateTime.Now,
1419 SessionName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath)
1420 ? $"Session_{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}"
1421 : $"{Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath)} — {DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}"
1422 };
1423
1424 // 1. Models and their transforms
1425 config.Models = BuildCurrentSessionModelInfos();
1426 // 2. Metadata
1427 config.IgnoredFacesIndices = _ignoredItemManager?.GetIgnoredFaceIndices() ?? new List<int>();
1428 config.IgnoredHolesIndices = IgnoredHoles.Select(h => h.HoleId).ToList();
1429 config.FlippedNormals = _flippedFaceNormals.ToList();
1430
1431 // 3. Full CAD Data (Faces, Holes, Metadata)
1432 // Use _allFacesByColor so that faces belonging to holes are also persisted.
1433 config.FullCADData = HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.JsonExportUtils.GetColorGroupedExportDTOs(_allFacesByColor, _holesByColor, false);
1434
1435 // 3b. Color Tolerances — save for ALL colours (faces + holes)
1436 var allColorKeys = new HashSet<string>(_facesByColor.Keys, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1437 foreach (var k in _holesByColor.Keys) allColorKeys.Add(k);
1438 foreach (var colorHex in allColorKeys)
1439 {
1440 var tol = ToleranceConfigManager.GetValue(colorHex);
1441 if (tol != null)
1442 config.ColorTolerances[colorHex] = tol;
1443 }
1444
1445 // 3c. Entity processing order (from Entity Filter dialog)
1446 config.ModelFileOrder = OrderedPartEntities
1447 .Select(e => e.EntityData as string ?? string.Empty)
1448 .Where(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p))
1449 .ToList();
1450 // Fallback: if no explicit ordering, save the natural order of loaded models
1451 if (!config.ModelFileOrder.Any() && config.Models.Any())
1452 config.ModelFileOrder = config.Models.Select(m => m.FilePath).ToList();
1453
1454 // 4. Path Planning
1455 if (_pathManager != null)
1456 {
1457 config.ProbePathPlanningInfo = _pathManager.GetPathExportDTO(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath ?? "Session");
1458 }
1459
1460 // 5. Meshes - Find robustly including inside blocks
1461 var allMeshes = new List<Mesh>();
1462 allMeshes.AddRange(_designControl.Entities.OfType<Mesh>());
1463 foreach (var br in _designControl.Entities.OfType<BlockReference>())
1464 {
1465 if (_designControl.Blocks.Contains(br.BlockName))
1466 {
1467 allMeshes.AddRange(_designControl.Blocks[br.BlockName].Entities.OfType<Mesh>());
1468 }
1469 }
1470
1471 config.ShellMeshes = allMeshes
1472 .Where(m => m.LayerName != null && m.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_"))
1473 .Select(m => ShellMeshDTO.FromMesh(m)).ToList();
1474
1475 if (_pathManager != null)
1476 {
1477 var sdfValidationInput = BuildSdfShellCacheValidationInput(config.Models, recomputeHashes: false);
1478 _pathManager.UpdateShellCacheValidationModels(sdfValidationInput.Models);
1479 config.SdfShellCache = _pathManager.ExportSdfShellCache(sdfValidationInput);
1480 }
1481
1482 config.EyeshotFaceReferences = allMeshes
1483 .Where(m => m.LayerName != null && m.LayerName.Contains("FaceReference"))
1484 .Select(m => ShellMeshDTO.FromMesh(m)).ToList();
1485
1486 config.IgnoredFacesMesh = null; // No longer saving the mesh, will reconstruct from indices
1487
1488 config.UndoHistory = UndoManager.ExportTimeline();
1489
1490 HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.Configuration.SessionConfigurationManager.SaveSession(config);
1491 if (_pathManager != null) _lastSavedPathHash = _pathManager.GetPathStateHash();
1492 UndoManager.MarkSaved();
1493 }
1494 catch (Exception ex)
1495 {
1496 Debug.WriteLine($"Error saving session: {ex.Message}");
1497 }
1498 }

1504 private List<ModelFileInfo> BuildCurrentSessionModelInfos()
1505 {
1506 var models = new List<ModelFileInfo>();
1507 var savedPaths = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1508 var mainParts = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsSessionModelEntity).ToList();
1509
1510 foreach (var part in mainParts)
1511 {
1512 if (part.LayerName != null && IsSessionSystemLayer(part.LayerName))
1513 continue;
1514
1515 string? path = part.EntityData as string;
1516 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
1517 path = CurrentlyLoadedFilePath;
1518
1519 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) || !File.Exists(path) || !savedPaths.Add(path))
1520 continue;
1521
1522 var currentTransform = GetCurrentTransformForSessionEntity(part);
1523 models.Add(new ModelFileInfo
1524 {
1525 FilePath = path,
1526 Hash = HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.Configuration.SessionConfigurationManager.CalculateFileHash(path),
1527 CurrentTransform = GetMatrixAsArray(currentTransform),
1528 OriginalTransform = GetMatrixAsArray(devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity())
1529 });
1530 }
1531
1532 return models;
1533 }
1534
1540 private devDept.Geometry.Transformation GetCurrentTransformForSessionEntity(Entity part)
1541 {
1542 foreach (var stored in _originalPositions.Values)
1543 {
1544 var entityTransform = stored.entities.FirstOrDefault(item => ReferenceEquals(item.ent, part));
1545 if (entityTransform.ent != null && entityTransform.trans != null)
1546 {
1547 var currentTrans = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)entityTransform.trans.Clone();
1548 currentTrans.Invert();
1549 return currentTrans;
1550 }
1551 }
1552
1553 return devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
1554 }
1555
1561 private double[] GetMatrixAsArray(devDept.Geometry.Transformation trans)
1562 {
1563 var arr = new double[16];
1564 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1565 {
1566 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
1567 {
1568 arr[i * 4 + j] = trans[i, j];
1569 }
1570 }
1571 return arr;
1572 }
1573
1579 private devDept.Geometry.Transformation LoadMatrixFromArray(double[] arr)
1580 {
1581 if (arr == null || arr.Length != 16) return devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
1582 var trans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation();
1583 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1584 {
1585 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
1586 {
1587 trans[i, j] = arr[i * 4 + j];
1588 }
1589 }
1590 return trans;
1591 }

1599 private SdfShellCacheValidationInput BuildSdfShellCacheValidationInput(IEnumerable<ModelFileInfo>? models, bool recomputeHashes)
1600 {
1601 var input = new SdfShellCacheValidationInput
1602 {
1603 OffsetDistance = double.Parse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ApproachOffsetDistance"] ?? "3.0"),
1604 VoxelSize = PathManager.SdfShellVoxelSize,
1605 HoleFaceIndices = GetCurrentShellHoleFaceIndices().OrderBy(i => i).ToList(),
1606 FlippedNormals = _flippedFaceNormals.OrderBy(i => i).ToList()
1607 };

1610 {
1611 foreach (var model in models)

1613 if (model == null)
1614 continue;
1615
1616 input.Models.Add(new SdfShellModelFingerprintDTO
1617 {
1618 FilePath = model.FilePath,
1619 Hash = recomputeHashes
1620 ? HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.Configuration.SessionConfigurationManager.CalculateFileHash(model.FilePath)
1621 : model.Hash,
1622 CurrentTransform = NormalizeTransformArray(model.CurrentTransform)
1623 });
1624 }
1625 }
1626
1627 return input;

1634 private HashSet<int> GetCurrentShellHoleFaceIndices()
1635 {
1636 var indices = new HashSet<int>();
1637 if (_holesByColor == null)
1638 return indices;
1639
1640 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
1641 {
1642 foreach (var hole in holeList)
1643 {
1644 if (hole?.FaceGlobalIndices == null)
1645 continue;
1646
1647 foreach (var faceIndex in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
1648 {
1649 indices.Add(faceIndex);
1650 }
1651 }
1652 }
1653
1654 return indices;
1655 }
1656
1662 private static double[] NormalizeTransformArray(double[]? transform)
1663 {
1664 if (transform == null || transform.Length != 16)
1665 {
1666 var identity = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
1667 var values = new double[16];
1668 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
1669 {
1670 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
1671 {
1672 values[i * 4 + j] = identity[i, j];
1673 }
1674 }
1675
1676 return values;
1677 }
1678
1679 return transform.ToArray();
1680 }

1687 private static bool IsSessionModelEntity(Entity? entity)
1688 {
1689 if (entity == null)
1690 return false;
1691
1692 if (entity.EntityData as string == "UI_MARKER" || entity.EntityData as string == "PART_ORIGIN")
1693 return false;
1694
1695 string? layerName = entity.LayerName;
1696 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName) && IsSessionSystemLayer(layerName))
1697 return false;
1698
1699 string? sourcePath = entity.EntityData as string;
1700 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath) && File.Exists(sourcePath))
1701 return true;
1702
1703 if (entity is Brep || entity is Mesh || entity is Solid)
1704 return true;
1705
1706 return HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.EyeshotGeometryUtils.TryConvertToBrep(entity) != null;
1707 }
1708
1714 private static bool IsSessionSystemLayer(string layerName)
1715 {
1716 return layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1717 layerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1718 layerName.StartsWith("PATH_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1719 layerName.StartsWith("SCANNER_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1720 layerName.StartsWith("PROBE_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1721 layerName.StartsWith("TRACKING_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1722 layerName.StartsWith("MEASUREMENT_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1723 layerName.Contains("SIMULATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1724 layerName.Equals("MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1725 layerName.Equals("COLLISION_MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1726 layerName.Equals("RAYCAST_HITS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1727 layerName.Equals("PROBE_TRACKING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
1728 layerName.Equals("SCANNER_FOV_VISUALIZATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
1729 }

2209 public string ShellVisibilityMenuText
2210 {
2211 get
2212 {
2213 try
2214 {
2215 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null)
2216 return GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2217
2218 // Prefer layer visibility because shell toggle works at layer level
2219 var shellLayerNames = _designControl.Layers
2220 .Where(l => l != null && l.Name != null &&
2221 l.Name.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
2222 .Select(l => l.Name)
2223 .ToList();
2224
2225 if (shellLayerNames.Count > 0)
2226 {
2227 bool anyLayerVisible = shellLayerNames.Any(layerName => _designControl.Layers.Contains(layerName) && _designControl.Layers[layerName].Visible);
2228 return anyLayerVisible
2229 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_HideShellMesh") ?? "Hide Exterior Shell"
2230 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2231 }
2232
2233 // Fallback for cases where shell entities exist without dedicated layers
2234 var shellEntities = _designControl.Entities
2235 .Where(e => e != null && e.LayerName != null &&
2236 e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
2237 .ToList();
2238
2239 if (shellEntities.Count == 0)
2240 return GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2241
2242 bool anyVisible = shellEntities.Any(e => e != null && e.Visible);
2243 return anyVisible
2244 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_HideShellMesh") ?? "Hide Exterior Shell"
2245 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2246 }
2247 catch
2248 {
2249 return GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowShellMesh") ?? "Show Exterior Shell";
2250 }
2251 }
2252 }

2453 #region Constructor
2458 public MainViewModel(MainWindow parent)
2459 {
2460 // Sync configurations dynamically from 3DModels files
2461 DynamicToolScanner.SyncConfigurations();
2462
2463 //Ensure creation of ProtectedConfig and the ExampleProfileDataXML files
2464 ProtectedConfigManager.EnsureConfigFileExists();
2465 //Ensure the PasswordFile exists
2466 SecurePasswordManager.InitializeOnFirstRun();
2467 //Set Default ProtectedValues
2468 Machine_IPAddress = ProtectedConfigManager.ReadConfig("Machine_IPAddress");
2469
2470 // Load Language
2471 var asm = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
2472 XmlDocument newDocLanguage = new XmlDocument();
2473 string languageCode = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Language"] ?? "EN"; // Default to "EN" if not set
2474 string doclanguage_filetype = ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["DocLanguage_FileType"] ?? ".xml";
2475 var stream = asm.GetManifestResourceStream($"{asm.GetName().Name}.Language.{languageCode + doclanguage_filetype}");
2476 if (stream != null) { newDocLanguage.Load(stream); }
2477 DocLanguage = newDocLanguage;
2478 // Set Language
2479 XmlDataProvider languageData = (XmlDataProvider)parent.Resources["Language"];
2480 languageData.Document = DocLanguage;
2481 parent.Resources["Language"] = languageData;
2482
2483 //Set UI Language Defaults
2484 ConnectButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Connect") ?? connectButton_Text;
2485 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces") ?? extractUpdateFacesButton_Text;
2486 Status_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "NotConnected") ?? status_Text;
2487 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? machine_Status_ProgressText;
2488 WindowMaximizeReduce = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Maximize") ?? "Maximize";
2489
2490 // Get ParentWindow
2491 MainParent = parent;
2492
2493 //Initialization of SidePanels
2494 about_sp = new About_SidePanel(this);
2495 measuring_sp = new Measuring_SidePanel(this);
2496 planning_sp = new Planning_SidePanel(this);
2497 settings_sp = new Settings_SidePanel(this);
2498 InitializePanelTimers();
2499
2500 //App Clock
2501 ClockTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
2502 ClockTimer.Tick += ClockTimer_Tick;
2503 ClockTimer.Start();
2504
2505 // Events
2506 parent.Closing += parent_Closing;
2507 parent.KeyDown += parent_KeyDown;
2508 parent.PreviewKeyDown += parent_KeyDown;
2509 parent.FacesTreeView.SelectedItemChanged += FaceTreeView_SelectedItemChanged;
2510
2511 //Part Manager Initialization
2512 _designControl = parent.designControl ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(parent.designControl));
2513
2514 // Hook up ContextMenuOpening event to prevent default context menu during manual marking
2515 _designControl.ContextMenuOpening += DesignControl_ContextMenuOpening;

2576 {
2577 if (vp.ToolBars != null && vp.ToolBars.Count > 0)
2578 {
2579 var tb = vp.ToolBars[0];

2582 var vpBtn = new ToolBarButton(new BitmapImage(new Uri("pack://application:,,,/Images/App_Resources/sectionview.png")), "SectionViewMain", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_SectionView") ?? "Toggle Section View Plane", ToolBarButton.styleType.ToggleButton, true);

2594 // Retry strategy to catch late-initialized toolbars
2595 _designControl.Loaded += (s, e) =>
2596 {
2597 var timer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(0.5) };
2598 int retries = 0;
2599 timer.Tick += (st, et) =>
2600 {
2601 addBtnToToolBars();
2602 if (_designControl.Viewports != null && _designControl.Viewports.Any(vp => vp.ToolBars != null && vp.ToolBars.Any(tb => tb.Buttons.Any(b => b.Name == "SectionViewMain"))))
2603 {
2604 timer.Stop();
2605 }
2606 if (retries++ > 20) timer.Stop();
2607 };
2608 timer.Start();
2609 };

2685 private void parent_KeyDown(object? sender, System.Windows.Input.KeyEventArgs e)
2686 {
2687 if (_designControl == null) return;
2688
2689 if (e.Key == Key.Z && Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Control)
2690 {
2691 UndoManager.Undo();
2692 e.Handled = true;
2693 return;
2694 }
2695 if (e.Key == Key.Y && Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Control)
2696 {
2697 UndoManager.Redo();
2698 e.Handled = true;
2699 return;
2700 }
2701
2702 // Handle ObjectManipulator Enter/Esc or Custom Dragging Enter/Esc
2703 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible || _isCustomDragging)
2704 {
2705 var waypointEntity = (!_isPartManipulating && (_manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData))
2706 ? _manipulatingEntity
2707 : (!_isPartManipulating ? _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.Selected && ent.EntityData is WaypointData) : null);
2708
2709 if (e.Key == Key.Enter || e.Key == Key.Return)
2710 {
2711 StopManipulating(null!);
2712 e.Handled = true;
2713 return;
2714 }
2715 else if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
2716 {
2717 if (waypointEntity != null)
2718 {
2719 CancelWaypointManipulation(waypointEntity);
2720 }
2721 else
2722 {
2723 ResetObjectPosition(null!);
2724 }
2725 e.Handled = true;
2726 return;
2727 }
2728 }
2729
2730 if (e.Key == Key.Return)
2731 {
2732 MainParent.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Next));
2733 }
2734 else if (e.Key == Key.Tab)
2735 {
2736 MainParent.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.Next));
2737 }
2738 }

3169 var result = MessageBox.Show(
3170 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_ResetAllPoints") ?? "Deseja reverter todas as edições manuais e restaurar os pontos para as posições geradas automaticamente?",
3171 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_ResetPointsTitle") ?? "Restaurar Pontos Originais",
3172 MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
3173 MessageBoxImage.Question);
3174
3175 if (result == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
3176 {
3177 foreach (var path in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
3178 {
3179 for (int i = 0; i < path.Points.Count; i++)
3180 {
3181 if (i < path.OriginalPoints.Count)

3186 }
3187 _pathManager.EditHistory.Clear();
3188 UndoManager.Clear();
3189 _pathManager.ClearPathVisuals();
3190 _pathManager.DrawAllPaths();
3191 _designControl.Invalidate();
3192 SaveCurrentSession();
3193 }
3194 }

3238 private void ResetObjectPosition(object parameter)
3239 {
3240 _isPartManipulating = false;
3241 if (_isCreatingIntermediaryPoint)
3242 {
3243 CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation();
3244 return;
3245 }
3246
3247 if (_designControl == null) return;
3248 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
3249 if (partEntity == null) return;
3250
3251 bool wasManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible;
3252 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
3253 {
3254 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
3255 _manipulatingEntity = null;
3256 }
3257 else if (_originalPositions != null && _originalPositions.TryGetValue(partEntity, out var originalData))
3258 {
3259 foreach (var item in originalData.entities)
3260 {
3261 item.ent.TransformBy(item.trans);
3262 }
3263
3264 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
3265 if (partIndex >= 0 && originalData.entities.Count > 0)
3266 {
3267 var trans = originalData.entities[0].trans;
3268 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyTransformation(partIndex, trans);
3269 }
3270
3271 if (originalData.grid != null)
3272 {
3273 var plane = originalData.grid.Plane;
3274 plane.TransformBy(originalData.gridTrans);
3275 originalData.grid.Plane = plane;
3276 }
3277
3278 _originalPositions.Remove(partEntity);
3279
3280 if (_selectionUtils != null)
3281 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
3282
3283 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
3284 _designControl.ZoomFit();
3285 _designControl.Invalidate();
3286 _pathManager?.InvalidateShellCache();
3287 }
3288 else if (wasManipulating)
3289 {
3290 _selectionUtils?.ClearDesignControlSelection();
3291 _designControl.Invalidate();
3292 }
3293 if (!wasManipulating)
3294 {
3295 _pathManager?.RegeneratePathVisuals();
3296 }
3297 }
3298
3302 private void CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation()
3303 {
3304 _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint = false;
3305 _isCustomDragging = false;
3306 _prevDragPosition = null;
3307 _tempInsertPath = null;
3308 _tempInsertPosition = null;
3309 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
3310 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = null;
3311 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
3312 _manipulatingEntity = null;
3313
3314 if (_designControl != null)
3315 {
3316 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
3317 {
3318 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
3319 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible = false;
3320 }
3321
3322 if (_draggingSphere != null)
3323 {
3324 _designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
3325 _draggingSphere = null;
3326 }
3327
3328 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
3329 _designControl.Invalidate();
3330 }
3331 }

3336 private void CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange()
3337 {
3338 _isPartManipulating = false;
3339 _isCustomDragging = false;
3340 _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint = false;
3341 _prevDragPosition = null;
3342 _initialTriadTrans = null;
3343 _tempInsertPath = null;
3344 _tempInsertPosition = null;
3345 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
3346 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = null;
3347 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
3348 _manipulatingEntity = null;
3349 _draggingSpherePosition = null;
3350
3351 if (_designControl == null)
3352 return;
3353
3354 try
3355 {
3356 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator != null)
3357 {
3358 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
3359 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible = false;
3360 }
3361 }
3362 catch (Exception ex)
3363 {
3364 Debug.WriteLine($"Failed to cancel active ObjectManipulator before model change: {ex.Message}");
3365 }
3366
3367 if (_draggingSphere != null)
3368 {
3369 try
3370 {
3371 if (_designControl.Entities.Contains(_draggingSphere))
3372 _designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
3373 }
3374 catch (Exception ex)
3375 {
3376 Debug.WriteLine($"Failed to remove temporary dragging sphere before model change: {ex.Message}");
3377 }
3378 finally
3379 {
3380 _draggingSphere = null;
3381 }
3382 }
3383
3384 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
3385 _selectionUtils?.ClearDesignControlSelection();
3386 _designControl.Invalidate();
3387 }
3388
3393 private void CancelWaypointManipulation(Entity? waypointEntity)
3394 {
3395 _isPartManipulating = false;
3396 _isCustomDragging = false;
3397 _prevDragPosition = null;
3398 _manipulatingEntity = null;
3399
3400 bool wasCreatingIntermediary = _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint;
3401
3402 if (_isCreatingIntermediaryPoint)
3403 {
3404 CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation();
3405 return;
3406 }
3407
3408 if (_designControl != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
3409 {
3410 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
3411 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible = false;
3412 }
3413
3414 if (_designControl != null && _draggingSphere != null)
3415 {
3416 _designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
3417 _draggingSphere = null;
3418 }
3419
3420 if (waypointEntity != null)
3421 {
3422 waypointEntity.Visible = true;
3423 waypointEntity.Selected = false;
3424 }
3425
3426 if (_designControl == null) return;
3427 _designControl.ObjectManipulator?.Cancel();
3428
3429 if (waypointEntity != null && waypointEntity.EntityData is WaypointData wp)
3430 {
3431 if (_oldPathStateForWaypointMove != null)
3432 {
3433 // Pre-apply cancellation: path data has not been committed yet.
3434 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
3435 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = null;
3436 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
3437 }
3438 else if (wp.IsNew)
3439 {
3440 // Just remove the newly created point
3441 if (wp.PointIndex >= 0 && wp.PointIndex < wp.Path.Points.Count)
3442 {
3443 wp.Path.Points.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
3444 if (wp.Path.Normals != null && wp.Path.Normals.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.Normals.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
3445 if (wp.Path.IsMeasure != null && wp.Path.IsMeasure.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.IsMeasure.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
3446 if (wp.Path.PointTypes != null && wp.Path.PointTypes.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.PointTypes.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
3447 if (wp.Path.OriginalPoints != null && wp.Path.OriginalPoints.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.OriginalPoints.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
3448 if (wp.Path.PointEntityIndices != null && wp.Path.PointEntityIndices.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.PointEntityIndices.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
3449 if (wp.Path.UpVectors != null && wp.Path.UpVectors.Count > wp.PointIndex) wp.Path.UpVectors.RemoveAt(wp.PointIndex);
3450
3451 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
3452 {
3453 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData otherWp && otherWp.Path == wp.Path && otherWp.PointIndex > wp.PointIndex)
3454 {
3455 otherWp.PointIndex--;
3456 }
3457 }
3458 }
3459 _designControl.Entities.Remove(waypointEntity);
3460 }
3461 else
3462 {
3463 if (wp.PointIndex >= 0 && wp.PointIndex < wp.Path.Points.Count && wp.Path.Points[wp.PointIndex].DistanceTo(wp.OriginalPosition) > 1e-4)
3464 {
3465 wp.Path.Points[wp.PointIndex] = (Point3D)wp.OriginalPosition.Clone();
3466 }
3467 }
3468
3469 if (wp.IsNew)
3470 {
3471 _pathManager?.ClearSinglePathVisuals(wp.Path.Color);
3472 _pathManager?.DrawSinglePath(wp.Path);
3473 }
3474 }
3475
3476 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
3477 _designControl.Invalidate();
3478 }
3479
3483 private Entity? FindApproachEntityForMeasure(WaypointData wpData)
3484 {
3485 if (_designControl == null || wpData.Path?.IsMeasure == null) return null;
3486
3487 int approachIdx = -1;
3488 if (wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.PointIndex - 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
3489 {
3490 approachIdx = wpData.PointIndex - 1;
3491 }
3492 else if (wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
3493 {
3494 approachIdx = wpData.PointIndex + 1;
3495 }
3496
3497 if (approachIdx < 0) return null;
3498
3499 return _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(e =>
3500 e.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path == wpData.Path && wd.PointIndex == approachIdx);
3501 }

3884 return;

3886 SidePanelTab settingsSidePanel = MainParent.SettingsSidePanel;
3887 int PanelSize = 400;

3889 // Check if we're closing the currently open panel
3890 bool isClosing = settingsSidePanel.IsExpanded;
3891
3892 CloseAllSlidePanels(settingsSidePanel);
3893
3894 settingsSidePanel.MoveSize = PanelSize;
3895
3896 if (!isClosing)
3897 {
3898 // Create instance once and reuse
3899 if (settings_sp == null)
3900 {
3901 settings_sp = new Settings_SidePanel(this);
3902 }
3903
3904 // Always set it (reattach to visual tree)
3905 settingsSidePanel.AdditionalContent = settings_sp;
3906 settingsSidePanel.Expand();
3907 }
3908 else
3909 {
3910 // Just collapse, delayed detachment will happen automatically
3911 settingsSidePanel.Collapse();
3912 _ = DelayedDetachContentFromPanel(settingsSidePanel, 850);
3913 }
3914
3915 StartPanelTimer(settingsPanelTimer);
3916 }

4169 StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

4171 if (CameraFollowEnabled)

4175 {
4176 Header = scannerMode
4177 ? (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StopFollowingScanner") ?? "Stop Following Scanner")
4178 : (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StopFollowingProbe") ?? "Stop Following Probe"),
4179 Command = ToggleCameraFollowCommand,
4180 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🛑", FontSize = 12 },
4181 ToolTip = scannerMode
4182 ? "Stops the camera from automatically following the scanner"
4183 : "Stops the camera from automatically following the probe"

4192 Header = scannerMode

4194 : (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FollowProbe") ?? "Follow Probe"),
4195 Command = ToggleCameraFollowCommand,

4197 ToolTip = scannerMode

4199 : "Makes the camera automatically follow the probe during simulation"
4200 };
4201 contextMenu.Items.Add(followItem);

4205 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());

4294 private void ShowContextMenuForWaypoint(Entity entity, WaypointData wpData)
4295 {
4296 var contextMenu = new ContextMenu();
4297
4298 bool isPointManipulating = _isCustomDragging || (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible && !_isPartManipulating);
4299 bool isMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex];
4300 bool isScanPoint = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count && string.Equals(wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex], "scanpoints", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
4301 bool nextIsMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1];
4302 bool prevIsMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.PointIndex - 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1];
4303 bool isApproach = !isMeasure && (nextIsMeasure || prevIsMeasure);
4304 if (isApproach && wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
4305 {
4306 wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex] = "Approach";
4307 }
4308
4309 if (isPointManipulating)
4310 {
4311 var applyItem = new MenuItem
4312 {
4313 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_AcceptPosition") ?? "Accept Position",
4314 Command = StopManipulatingCommand,
4315 CommandParameter = entity,
4316 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "✅", FontSize = 12 }
4317 };
4318 contextMenu.Items.Add(applyItem);
4319
4320 var cancelItem = new MenuItem
4321 {
4322 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_Cancel") ?? "Cancel",
4323 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "❌", FontSize = 12 }
4324 };
4325 cancelItem.Click += (s, e) =>
4326 {
4327 CancelWaypointManipulation(entity);
4328 };
4329 contextMenu.Items.Add(cancelItem);
4330 }
4331 else
4332 {
4333 var moveItem = new MenuItem
4334 {
4335 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_MovePoint") ?? "Move Point",
4336 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🎮", FontSize = 12 }
4337 };
4338 moveItem.Click += (s, e) =>
4339 {
4340 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
4341 {
4342 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData)
4343 {
4344 ent.Selected = false;
4345 }
4346 }
4347 entity.Selected = true;
4348
4349 Point3D pt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
4350 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = wpData.Path.CloneState();
4351 _prevDragPosition = (Point3D)pt.Clone();
4352
4353 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = new List<(ColorPath Path, int PointIndex)>();
4354 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = new List<(ColorPath Path, ColorPath OldState)>();
4355
4356 string ptType = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count ? wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex] : "";
4357 if (ptType == "Bridge" || ptType == "BridgeIntermediary")
4358 {
4359 if (_pathManager != null)
4360 {
4361 foreach (var otherPath in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
4362 {
4363 if (otherPath == wpData.Path) continue;
4364 for (int k = 0; k < otherPath.Points.Count; k++)
4365 {
4366 string otherPtType = otherPath.PointTypes != null && k < otherPath.PointTypes.Count ? otherPath.PointTypes[k] : "";
4367 if (otherPtType == "Bridge" || otherPtType == "BridgeIntermediary")
4368 {
4369 if (otherPath.Points[k].DistanceTo(wpData.OriginalPosition) < 0.01)
4370 {
4371 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Add((otherPath, k));
4372 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Add((otherPath, otherPath.CloneState()));
4373 }
4374 }
4375 }
4376 }
4377 }
4378 }
4379
4380 if (isMeasure)
4381 {
4382 var closest = FindClosestFace(pt);
4383 _draggingMeasurePointFace = closest.Face;
4384 _draggingMeasurePointBrep = closest.Brep;
4385
4386 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
4387 {
4388 try
4389 {
4390 _draggingFaceMesh = _draggingMeasurePointBrep.Faces[_draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex].ConvertToMesh();
4391 }
4392 catch
4393 {
4394 _draggingFaceMesh = null;
4395 }
4396 }
4397 }
4398
4399 Vector3D zAxis = wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex];
4400 if (isApproach)
4401 {
4402 int mIdx = -1;
4403 if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
4404 {
4405 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex + 1;
4406 }
4407 else if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
4408 {
4409 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex - 1;
4410 }
4411
4412 if (mIdx != -1)
4413 {
4414 zAxis = wpData.Path.Normals[mIdx];
4415 }
4416 }
4417
4418 if (zAxis.LengthSquared < 1e-6) zAxis = Vector3D.AxisZ;
4419 zAxis.Normalize();
4420
4421 Vector3D xAxis = Vector3D.Cross(Vector3D.AxisZ, zAxis);
4422 if (xAxis.LengthSquared < 1e-6) xAxis = Vector3D.Cross(Vector3D.AxisY, zAxis);
4423 xAxis.Normalize();
4424
4425 Vector3D yAxis = Vector3D.Cross(zAxis, xAxis);
4426 yAxis.Normalize();
4427
4428 var trans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation();
4429 trans[0, 0] = xAxis.X; trans[0, 1] = yAxis.X; trans[0, 2] = zAxis.X; trans[0, 3] = pt.X;
4430 trans[1, 0] = xAxis.Y; trans[1, 1] = yAxis.Y; trans[1, 2] = zAxis.Y; trans[1, 3] = pt.Y;
4431 trans[2, 0] = xAxis.Z; trans[2, 1] = yAxis.Z; trans[2, 2] = zAxis.Z; trans[2, 3] = pt.Z;
4432
4433 // If it's a measure point, also select the associated approach point entity and orient camera
4434 if (isMeasure)
4435 {
4436 var approachEntity = FindApproachEntityForMeasure(wpData);
4437 if (approachEntity != null) approachEntity.Selected = true;
4438
4439 // Put camera normal to the surface for a top-down drag view
4440 /*
4441 if (_draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
4442 {
4443 _cameraUtils.OrientCameraToFacePerpendicularly(_draggingMeasurePointFace);
4444 }
4445 else
4446 {
4447 _cameraUtils.OrientCameraToNormal(pt, zAxis);
4448 }
4449 */
4450 }
4451
4452 _initialTriadTrans = trans;
4453 _manipulatingEntity = entity;
4454
4455 if (isMeasure && !isScanPoint)
4456 {
4457 _isCustomDragging = true;
4458 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
4459
4460 // Keep the real measurepoint sphere visible
4461 entity.Selected = false;
4462
4463 // Create dragging sphere
4464 _draggingSphere = devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh.CreateSphere(0.45, 8, 8);
4465 _draggingSphere.Color = System.Drawing.Color.LimeGreen;
4466 _draggingSphere.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
4467 _draggingSphere.Translate(pt.X, pt.Y, pt.Z);
4468 _draggingSphere.Selected = true;
4469 _designControl.Entities.Add(_draggingSphere);
4470 _draggingSpherePosition = (Point3D)pt.Clone();
4471 }
4472 else
4473 {
4474 _isCustomDragging = false;
4475 _draggingMeasurePointFace = null;
4476 _draggingMeasurePointBrep = null;
4477 _draggingFaceMesh = null;
4478
4479 ConfigureWaypointManipulator(isApproach);
4480 _designControl.Invalidate();
4481 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Enable(_initialTriadTrans, false);
4482 _designControl.Invalidate();
4483 ConfigureWaypointManipulator(isApproach);
4484
4485 }
4486
4487 _designControl.Invalidate();
4488 };
4489 contextMenu.Items.Add(moveItem);
4490 }
4491
4492 // Always show the "Delete Point" option
4493 var deleteItem = new MenuItem
4494 {
4495 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_DeletePoint") ?? "Delete Point",
4496 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🗑️", FontSize = 12 }
4497 };
4498 deleteItem.Click += (s, e) =>
4499 {
4500 bool isManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible;
4501 if (isManipulating)
4502 {
4503 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
4504 }
4505
4506 string pointType = "";
4507 if (wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
4508 {
4509 pointType = wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex];
4510 }
4511
4512 if (pointType == "Start" || pointType == "End")
4513 {
4514 // Do not delete normal path points like Start or End. Just cancel manipulation.
4515 if (isManipulating)
4516 {
4517 CancelWaypointManipulation(entity);
4518 }
4519 return;
4520 }
4521
4522 // Capture path state before deletion
4523 var oldState = wpData.Path.CloneState();
4524
4525 // Remove from Path
4526 if (wpData.PointIndex >= 0 && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Points.Count)
4527 {
4528 int indexToRemove = wpData.PointIndex;
4529 wpData.Path.Points.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
4530 wpData.Path.Normals.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
4531 if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count)
4532 wpData.Path.IsMeasure.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
4533 if (wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
4534 wpData.Path.PointTypes.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
4535 if (wpData.Path.OriginalPoints != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
4536 wpData.Path.OriginalPoints.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
4537
4538 // Update Path visuals (clears single path visuals and redraws spheres + segment lines correctly!)
4539 if (_pathManager != null)
4540 {
4541 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(wpData.Path);
4542 }
4543
4544 // Register command in Undo history
4545 if (_pathManager != null)
4546 {
4547 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, wpData.Path.Color, oldState, wpData.Path.CloneState()));
4548 }
4549
4550 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
4551 _designControl.Invalidate();
4552 }
4553 };
4554 contextMenu.Items.Add(deleteItem);
4555
4556 // Only add the "Revert Position" context menu item if the point has actually been moved after generation
4557 bool canRevert = wpData.GeneratedPosition != null && wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex].DistanceTo(wpData.GeneratedPosition) > 0.001;
4558 if (canRevert)
4559 {
4560 var revertItem = new MenuItem
4561 {
4562 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RevertPosition") ?? "Revert Position",
4563 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "↩️", FontSize = 12, Padding = new Thickness(4, 0, 0, 0) }
4564 };
4565 revertItem.Click += (s, e) =>
4566 {
4567 bool isManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible;
4568 if (isManipulating)
4569 {
4570 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
4571 }
4572
4573 var oldState = wpData.Path.CloneState();
4574
4575 // Revert the point's position to its GeneratedPosition
4576 Point3D genPos = wpData.GeneratedPosition!;
4577 if (genPos != null)
4578 {
4579 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex] = (Point3D)genPos.Clone();
4580
4581 // If it is a measure point, update adjacent approach points back to their generated positions too!
4582 if (isMeasure && !isScanPoint)
4583 {
4584 Vector3D newNormal = wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex];
4585 var closest = FindClosestFace(genPos);
4586 if (closest.Brep != null && closest.Face != null)
4587 {
4588 try
4589 {
4590 var fn = closest.Brep.Faces[closest.Face.FaceIndex].Normal(genPos);
4591 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
4592 {
4593 newNormal = fn;
4594 newNormal.Normalize();
4595 }
4596 }
4597 catch { }
4598 }
4599 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex] = newNormal;
4600
4601 if (wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
4602 {
4603 var entryWd = FindWaypointData(wpData.Path, wpData.PointIndex - 1);
4604 if (entryWd?.GeneratedPosition != null)
4605 {
4606 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex - 1] = (Point3D)entryWd.GeneratedPosition.Clone();
4607 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex - 1] = (Vector3D)newNormal.Clone();
4608 }
4609 }
4610 if (wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
4611 {
4612 var exitWd = FindWaypointData(wpData.Path, wpData.PointIndex + 1);
4613 if (exitWd?.GeneratedPosition != null)
4614 {
4615 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex + 1] = (Point3D)exitWd.GeneratedPosition.Clone();
4616 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex + 1] = (Vector3D)newNormal.Clone();
4617 }
4618 }
4619 }
4620
4621 if (_pathManager != null)
4622 {
4623 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(wpData.Path);
4624 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, wpData.Path.Color, oldState, wpData.Path.CloneState()));
4625 }
4626
4627 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
4628 _designControl.Invalidate();
4629 }
4630 };
4631 contextMenu.Items.Add(revertItem);
4632 }
4633
4634 contextMenu.PlacementTarget = _designControl;
4635 RegisterAndOpenContextMenu(contextMenu);
4636 }

4643 public void HighlightGeometryItem(object? item, bool selectInTree = false)
4644 {
4645 if (item == null || _visualsManager == null) return;
4646
4647 try
4648 {
4649 isUpdatingSelection = true;
4650 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
4651 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
4652
4653 if (item is CADFace face)
4654 {
4655 HighlightFace(face);
4656 if (selectInTree)
4657 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(face);
4658 }
4659 else if (item is CADHole hole)
4660 {
4661 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(hole);
4662
4663 var topFace = GetHoleFaces(hole)
4664 .OrderBy(f => hole.TopCenterPoint == null
4665 ? 0.0
4666 : EyeshotGeometryUtils.GetFaceCenter(f).DistanceTo(hole.TopCenterPoint))
4667 .FirstOrDefault();
4668 if (topFace != null)
4669 HighlightFace(topFace, includeParentHole: false);
4670
4671 if (selectInTree)
4672 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(hole);
4673
4674 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingHole") ?? "Highlighting hole {0}", hole.HoleId);
4675 }
4676 else if (item is FacePoint vertex)
4677 {
4678 var parentFace = FindParentFaceForVertexPoint(vertex);
4679 if (parentFace != null)
4680 {
4681 if (selectInTree)
4682 _treeViewHelper.SelectVertexInTree(parentFace, vertex.VertexIndex);
4683
4684 TrySelectBrepVertex(parentFace, vertex.VertexIndex);
4685 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(parentFace, highlightVertexIndex: vertex.VertexIndex);
4686 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(parentFace);
4687 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = parentFace;
4688
4689 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(parentFace);
4690 if (parentHole != null)
4691 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
4692 }
4693 }
4694 else if (item is Point4D controlPoint)
4695 {
4696 _visualsManager.ShowTemporaryControlPointSphere(controlPoint);
4697 }
4698
4699 _selectionUtils.TryRefreshDesignControlSelection();
4700 _designControl.Invalidate();
4701 }
4702 catch (Exception ex)
4703 {
4704 Debug.WriteLine($"Error highlighting geometry item: {ex.Message}");
4705 }
4706 finally
4707 {
4708 isUpdatingSelection = false;
4709 }
4710
4711 void HighlightFace(CADFace cadFace, bool includeParentHole = true)
4712 {
4713 if (cadFace.EntityIndex >= 0 && cadFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
4714 _visualsManager.HighlightFaceVisualFallback(_designControl.Entities[cadFace.EntityIndex] as Brep, cadFace.FaceIndex);
4715
4716 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(cadFace);
4717 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(cadFace);
4718 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = cadFace;
4719
4720 if (!includeParentHole) return;
4721
4722 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(cadFace);
4723 if (parentHole != null)
4724 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
4725 }
4726
4727 List<CADFace> GetHoleFaces(CADHole hole)
4728 {
4729 if (_allFacesByColor == null || hole.FaceGlobalIndices == null || !hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any())
4730 return new List<CADFace>();
4731
4732 return _allFacesByColor.Values
4733 .SelectMany(list => list)
4734 .Where(face => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(face.FaceGlobalIndex))
4735 .ToList();
4736 }
4737
4738 CADFace? FindParentFaceForVertexPoint(FacePoint vertexPoint)
4739 {
4740 if (_allFacesByColor == null)
4741 return null;
4742
4743 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list);
4744 return allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point => ReferenceEquals(point, vertexPoint)))
4745 ?? allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point =>
4746 point.VertexIndex == vertexPoint.VertexIndex &&
4747 Math.Abs(point.X - vertexPoint.X) < 1e-6 &&
4748 Math.Abs(point.Y - vertexPoint.Y) < 1e-6 &&
4749 Math.Abs(point.Z - vertexPoint.Z) < 1e-6))
4750 ?? allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point => point.VertexIndex == vertexPoint.VertexIndex));
4751 }
4752
4753 void TrySelectBrepVertex(CADFace parentFace, int vertexIndex)
4754 {
4755 if (parentFace.EntityIndex < 0 || parentFace.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
4756 return;
4757
4758 if (_designControl.Entities[parentFace.EntityIndex] is not Brep brep)
4759 return;
4760
4761 try
4762 {
4763 var brepType = brep.GetType();
4764 var setVertex = brepType.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int), typeof(bool) })
4765 ?? brepType.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int) });
4766
4767 if (setVertex == null)
4768 return;
4769
4770 try
4771 {
4772 setVertex.Invoke(brep, new object[] { vertexIndex, true });
4773 }
4774 catch
4775 {
4776 setVertex.Invoke(brep, new object[] { vertexIndex });
4777 }
4778 }
4779 catch { }
4780 }
4781 }

4787 public void ShowContextMenuFor(object item)
4788 {
4789 if (item == null) return;
4790
4791 var contextMenu = new ContextMenu();
4792
4793 if (item is CADFace face)
4794 {
4795 if (IgnoredFaces.Contains(face) || IgnoredHoles.Any(h => h.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(face.FaceGlobalIndex)))
4796 {
4797 var unignoreMenuItem = new MenuItem
4798 {
4799 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RestoreFace") ?? "Restore Face",
4800 Command = UnignoreItemCommand,
4801 CommandParameter = face,
4802 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "♻️", FontSize = 12 },
4803 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RestoreFace_ToolTip") ?? "Restaura esta face para ser contabilizada na exportação e na geração do programa."
4804 };
4805 contextMenu.Items.Add(unignoreMenuItem);
4806 }
4807 else
4808 {
4809 var ignoreMenuItem = new MenuItem
4810 {
4811 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_IgnoreFace") ?? "Ignore Face",

4814 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🚫", FontSize = 12 },
4815 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_IgnoreFace_ToolTip") ?? "Marca esta face para ser ignorada na exportação e na árvore de itens."
4816 };
4817 contextMenu.Items.Add(ignoreMenuItem);
4818 }
4819
4820 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
4821
4822 // Add "Convert to Hole" option for cylindrical faces
4823 if (IsCylindricalFace(face))
4824 {
4825 if (_pendingHoleConversionFace == null)
4826 {
4827 // First face selection - offer both options
4828 var convertToHoleMenuItem = new MenuItem

5169 private void IgnoreItem(object item)
5170 {
5171 SetItemIgnoredState(item, true);
5172 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
5173 () => SetItemIgnoredState(item, false, true),
5174 () => SetItemIgnoredState(item, true, true),
5175 item is CADFace ? "Ignored Face" : "Ignored Hole",
5176 "Geometry"
5177 ));
5178 }
5179
5186 private void SetItemIgnoredState(object item, bool isIgnored, bool isUndoRedo = false)
5187 {
5188 if (item is CADFace face)
5189 {
5190 if (isIgnored)
5191 {
5192 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(face)) IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
5193 face.IsIgnored = true;
5194 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
5195 {
5196 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(new List<CADFace> { face });
5197 }
5198 }
5199 else
5200 {
5201 IgnoredFaces.Remove(face);
5202 face.IsIgnored = false;
5203 _ignoredItemManager.RestoreOriginalStyle(new List<CADFace> { face });
5204
5205 var parentHole = IgnoredHoles.FirstOrDefault(h => h.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(face.FaceGlobalIndex));
5206 if (parentHole != null)
5207 {
5208 IgnoredHoles.Remove(parentHole);
5209 parentHole.IsIgnored = false;
5210 }
5211 }
5212 }
5213 else if (item is CADHole hole)
5214 {
5215 var facesInHole = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list)
5216 .Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
5217 if (isIgnored)
5218 {
5219 if (!IgnoredHoles.Contains(hole)) IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
5220 hole.IsIgnored = true;
5221 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
5222 {
5223 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(f)) IgnoredFaces.Add(f);
5224 f.IsIgnored = true;
5225 }
5226 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
5227 {
5228 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(facesInHole);
5229 }
5230 }
5231 else
5232 {
5233 IgnoredHoles.Remove(hole);
5234 hole.IsIgnored = false;
5235 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
5236 {
5237 IgnoredFaces.Remove(f);
5238 f.IsIgnored = false;
5239 }
5240 _ignoredItemManager.RestoreOriginalStyle(facesInHole);
5241 }
5242 }
5243
5244 if (!isUndoRedo)
5245 {
5246 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
5247 }
5248 else
5249 {
5250 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
5251 }
5252
5253 if (measuring_sp != null)
5254 {
5255 measuring_sp.UpdateMeasurementCounts();
5256 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
5257 }
5258 _designControl?.Invalidate();
5259
5260 if (!isUndoRedo)
5261 {
5262 SaveCurrentSession();
5263 }
5264 }

5306 private async void ToggleShellVisibility()
5307 {
5308 try
5309 {
5310 if (_designControl == null) return;
5311
5312 // Check if the SDF layer exists
5313 if (!_designControl.Layers.Contains(SdfShellVisualizer.LAYER_SDF))
5314 {

5316 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ShellVisibility_AskGenerate") ?? "Shell mesh does not exist. Do you want to generate it now?",
5317 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ShellVisibility_Title") ?? "Shell Visibility",
5318 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
5319 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Question);
5320
5321 if (result == System.Windows.MessageBoxResult.Yes)
5322 {
5323 if (_pathManager != null)
5324 {
5325 await _pathManager.GenerateOversizedShellFromDesignAsync(_designControl, default);
5326 SdfShellVisualizer.Toggle(_designControl);
5327 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShellVisibilityMenuText));
5328 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShellMeshesExist));
5329 }
5330 }
5331 return;
5332 }
5333
5334 SdfShellVisualizer.Toggle(_designControl);
5335 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShellVisibilityMenuText));
5336 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShellMeshesExist));
5337 }
5338 catch (Exception ex)
5339 {
5340 Debug.WriteLine($"Error toggling shell visibility: {ex.Message}");

5369 private void FlipSelectedFaceNormal(object? parameter)
5370 {
5371 if (parameter is not CADFace face)
5372 {
5373 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
5374 $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_NoFaceSelected") ?? "No face selected."}\n\n{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_SelectFaceFirst") ?? "Please select a face first to flip its normal."}",
5375 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Title") ?? "Flip Normal",
5376 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
5377 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
5378 return;
5379 }
5380
5381 // Toggle the flipped state for this face
5382 // CRITICAL: Use FaceGlobalIndex (entity-level) for IgnoredItemManager, FaceIndex (BREP-level) for ShellGenerator
5383 bool wasFlipped = _flippedFaceNormals.Contains(face.FaceIndex);
5384 if (!wasFlipped)
5385 {
5386 _flippedFaceNormals.Add(face.FaceIndex);
5387 Debug.WriteLine($"SUCCESS: Flipped normal for face - FaceGlobalIndex: {face.FaceGlobalIndex}, BREP FaceIndex: {face.FaceIndex}");
5388 }
5389 else
5390 {
5391 _flippedFaceNormals.Remove(face.FaceIndex);
5392 Debug.WriteLine($"SUCCESS: Restored normal for face {face.FaceGlobalIndex} (BREP face index: {face.FaceIndex})");
5393 }
5394
5395 // Refresh normals display if currently visible
5396 if (_designControl != null)
5397 {
5398 bool normalsVisible = bool.Parse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ShowNormals"] ?? "false");
5399 if (normalsVisible)
5400 {
5401 // Force refresh by toggling off and on
5402 _designControl.ShowNormals = false;
5403 _designControl.Invalidate();
5404 _designControl.ShowNormals = true;
5405 _designControl.Invalidate();
5406 }
5407 }
5408
5409 // Notify user
5410 string message = wasFlipped
5411 ? string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Restored") ?? "Normal for face {0} restored to original direction.", face.FaceGlobalIndex)
5412 : string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Success") ?? "Normal for face {0} flipped successfully.", face.FaceGlobalIndex);
5413
5414 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
5415 message,
5416 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Title") ?? "Flip Normal",
5417 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
5418 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
5419
5420 //UI Updates
5421 if (measuring_sp != null) { measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible; }
5422
5423 // FACE-JUMPING INTEGRATION: Invalidate existing path when normal is flipped
5424 // Per REQUIREMENTS.md: Flipping must invalidate path and trigger shell regeneration
5425 if (_generatedPathEntities != null && _generatedPathEntities.Count > 0)
5426 {
5427 Debug.WriteLine($" INFO: Normal flip triggered path invalidation - clearing {_generatedPathEntities.Count} path entities");
5428 ClearPathVisuals();
5429 }
5430
5431 // Aplicar textura vermelha nas faces invertidas
5432 ApplyFlippedFaceTextures();
5433 }
5434
5438 private async void RegenerateOffsetShell()
5439 {
5440 if (_designControl == null)
5441 {
5442 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
5443 "No design loaded.",
5444 "Regenerate Offset Shell",
5445 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
5446 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
5447 return;
5448 }
5449
5450 try
5451 {
5452 // Save current shell visibility state
5453 bool shellWasVisible = false;
5454 if (_designControl.Layers.Contains("SHELL_UNIFIED"))
5455 {
5456 shellWasVisible = _designControl.Layers["SHELL_UNIFIED"].Visible;
5457 }
5458
5459 // Clear red overlays before regenerating
5460 if (_ignoredItemManager != null && _flippedFaceNormals.Count > 0)
5461 {
5462 _ignoredItemManager.ClearFlippedFaceOverlays(_flippedFaceNormals.ToList());
5463 }
5464
5465 // Show progress
5466 Machine_Status_ProgressText = "Regenerating offset shell...";
5467 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
5468
5469 Debug.WriteLine("INFO: Regenerating offset shell...");
5470 // Call the async method to regenerate shell
5471 await _pathManager.GenerateOversizedShellFromDesignAsync(_designControl, default);
5472
5473 Machine_Status_Progress = 100;
5474 Machine_Status_ProgressText = "Shell regenerated successfully!";
5475
5476 Debug.WriteLine($"SUCCESS: Shell regeneration complete");
5477
5478 // Restore shell visibility state if it was visible before
5479 if (shellWasVisible && _designControl.Layers.Contains("SHELL_UNIFIED"))
5480 {
5481 _designControl.Layers["SHELL_UNIFIED"].Visible = true;
5482 Debug.WriteLine(" 👁️ Shell layer visibility restored");
5483 }
5484
5485 // Refresh the viewport to show updated shell
5486 _designControl.Invalidate();
5487 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(50); // Small delay for render
5488
5489 // Clear the flipped faces list since they've been applied
5490 _flippedFaceNormals.Clear();
5491
5492 // Brief success message
5493 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(2000);
5494 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
5495 Machine_Status_ProgressText = string.Empty;
5496 }
5497 catch (Exception ex)
5498 {
5499 Debug.WriteLine($"ERROR: Error regenerating shell: {ex.Message}");
5500 Debug.WriteLine($" Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
5501 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
5502 $"Failed to regenerate shell:\n{ex.Message}",
5503 "Error",
5504 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
5505 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
5506 }
5507 }
