5639 private void ConvertHoleToFaces(CADHole holeToConvert)
5640 {
5641 if (holeToConvert == null) return;
5642 PerformConvertHoleToFaces(holeToConvert);
5643
5644 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
5645 () =>
5646 {
5647 AddNewHole(holeToConvert);
5648 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
5649 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
5650 },
5651 () => PerformConvertHoleToFaces(holeToConvert),
5652 description: $"Convert Hole {holeToConvert.HoleId} to Faces",
5653 category: "Hole Management"
5654 ));
5655 }
5656
5661 private void PerformConvertHoleToFaces(CADHole holeToConvert)
5662 {
5663 if (holeToConvert == null) return;
5664
5665 string colorKey = _holesByColor.FirstOrDefault(kvp => kvp.Value.Contains(holeToConvert)).Key;
5666 if (colorKey == null) return;
5667
5668 // 1. Remove hole from the main holes dictionary
5669 _holesByColor[colorKey].Remove(holeToConvert);
5670 if (_holesByColor[colorKey].Count == 0)
5671 {
5672 _holesByColor.Remove(colorKey);
5673 }
5674
5675 // 2. Find the constituent faces from the master list
5676 var facesToAdd = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list)
5677 .Where(f => holeToConvert.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
5678
5679 // 3. Add these faces to the non-hole faces dictionary
5680 if (!_facesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey))
5681 {
5682 _facesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADFace>();
5683 }
5684 _facesByColor[colorKey].AddRange(facesToAdd);
5685
5686 // 4. Update the lookup map
5687 foreach (var faceIdx in holeToConvert.FaceGlobalIndices)
5688 {
5689 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null)
5690 _faceIndexToHoleMap.Remove(faceIdx);
5691 }
5692
5693 // 5. Rebuild the cache and repopulate the tree
5694 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
5695 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
5696
5697 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"Hole {holeToConvert.HoleId} converted to {facesToAdd.Count} faces.";
5698 }

6076 public async Task ImportModelWithoutClearingAsync()
6077 {
6078 CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange();
6079 if (!CheckAndDiscardExistingPaths()) return;
6080
6081 var dlg = new OpenFileDialog
6082 {
6083 Filter = "STEP files (*.stp;*.step)|*.stp;*.step|IGES files (*.igs;*.iges)|*.igs;*.iges|OBJ files (*.obj)|*.obj|STL files (*.stl)|*.stl|All files (*.*)|*.*",
6084 FilterIndex = 1,
6085 Title = "Select CAD file"
6086 };
6087
6088 if (dlg.ShowDialog() != true)
6089 return;
6090
6091 string path = dlg.FileName;
6092 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_LoadingAdditionalModel");
6093 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
6094
6095 try
6096 {
6097 string extension = Path.GetExtension(path).ToLowerInvariant();
6098 ReadSTL stlReader = null!;
6099 ReadSTEP stepReader = null!;
6100 ReadIGES igesReader = null!;
6101 ReadOBJ objReader = null!;
6102
6103 // Run the heavy parsing part off the UI thread
6104 await Task.Run(() =>
6105 {
6106 if (extension == ".stl")
6107 {
6108 stlReader = new ReadSTL(path);
6109 stlReader.DoWork();
6110 }
6111 else if (extension == ".igs" || extension == ".iges")
6112 {
6113 igesReader = new ReadIGES(path);
6114 igesReader.DoWork();
6115 }
6116 else if (extension == ".obj")
6117 {
6118 objReader = new ReadOBJ(path);
6119 objReader.DoWork();
6120 }
6121 else
6122 {
6123 stepReader = new ReadSTEP(path);
6124 stepReader.DoWork();
6125 }
6126 });
6127
6128 // 2️⃣ Everything that creates UI objects must run on the UI thread
6129 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
6130 {
6131 var tempDesign = new Design();
6132 if (extension == ".stl")
6133 {
6134 stlReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
6135 }
6136 else if (extension == ".igs" || extension == ".iges")
6137 {
6138 igesReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
6139 }
6140 else if (extension == ".obj")
6141 {
6142 objReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
6143 }
6144 else
6145 {
6146 stepReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
6147 }
6148
6149 var importedEntities = tempDesign.Entities.ToList();
6150 if (importedEntities.Count == 0)
6151 {
6152 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
6153 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_NoEntitiesFound")!,
6154 Path.GetFileName(path));
6155 return;
6156 }
6157
6158 // Duplicate filtering
6159 var existingBoxes = _designControl.Entities
6160 .Select(e => (e.BoxMin, e.BoxMax))
6161 .ToHashSet();
6162
6163 var uniqueEntities = importedEntities
6164 .Where(e => !existingBoxes.Contains((e.BoxMin, e.BoxMax)))
6165 .ToList();
6166
6167 if (uniqueEntities.Count == 0)
6168 {
6169 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
6170 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_AllEntitiesAlreadyExist") ?? "All entities from {0} already exist",
6171 Path.GetFileName(path));
6172 return;
6173 }
6174
6175 int entityCountBeforeImport = _designControl.Entities.Count;
6176 int gridCountBeforeImport = _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0 ? _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Count : 0;
6177
6178 foreach (var ent in uniqueEntities)
6179 {
6180 // Store original filename in EntityData for tooltip
6181 ent.EntityData = path;
6182 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
6183 }
6184 _designControl.Units = _units;
6185
6186 AddPartOrigins(uniqueEntities, path); // Add origin symbol for the new model group
6187
6188 var newEntities = _designControl.Entities.Skip(entityCountBeforeImport).ToList();
6189 var newGrids = _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0
6190 ? _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Skip(gridCountBeforeImport).ToList()
6191 : new List<devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid>();
6192 var relatedGeneratedEntities = new List<Entity>();
6193
6194 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
6195 () =>
6196 {
6197 if (relatedGeneratedEntities.Count == 0)
6198 {
6199 relatedGeneratedEntities.AddRange(_designControl.Entities.Where(ent =>
6200 ent?.LayerName != null &&
6201 (ent.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
6202 ent.LayerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))));
6203 }
6204
6205 foreach (var ent in relatedGeneratedEntities)
6206 {
6207 _designControl.Entities.Remove(ent);

6209
6210 foreach (var ent in newEntities)
6211 {
6212 _designControl.Entities.Remove(ent);
6213 if (OrderedPartEntities.Contains(ent))
6214 {
6215 OrderedPartEntities.Remove(ent);
6216 }
6217 }
6218 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
6219 {
6220 foreach (var g in newGrids)
6221 {
6222 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(g);
6223 }
6224 }
6225 FacesUpToDate = false;
6226 _pathManager.InvalidateShellCache();
6227 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
6228 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
6229 _designControl.Invalidate();
6230 },
6231 () =>
6232 {
6233 foreach (var ent in newEntities)
6234 {
6235 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(ent))
6236 {
6237 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
6238 }
6239 }
6240 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
6241 {
6242 foreach (var g in newGrids)
6243 {
6244 if (!_designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Contains(g))
6245 {
6246 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(g);
6247 }
6248 }
6249 }
6250 foreach (var ent in relatedGeneratedEntities)
6251 {
6252 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(ent))
6253 {
6254 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
6255 }
6256 }
6257 FacesUpToDate = false;
6258 _pathManager.InvalidateShellCache();
6259 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
6260 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
6261 _designControl.Invalidate();
6262 },
6263 description: $"Import Model {Path.GetFileName(path)}",
6264 category: "Model Import"
6265 ));
6266
6267 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
6268 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_AddedEntitiesFromModel") ?? "Added {0} entities from {1}",
6269 uniqueEntities.Count(), Path.GetFileName(path));

6273 _pathManager.InvalidateShellCache();

6276 CanExtractFaces = true;
6277 await Task.Delay(200);
6278 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>

6280 _designControl.Entities.UpdateBoundingBox();
6281 _designControl.ZoomFit();

"An error occurred while loading the STEP model:") + $" {ex.Message}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_ImportError") ?? "HirEV SmartFitSystems - Import Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);

6303 public void RemoveModelEntity(Entity? entity)
6304 {
6305 if (entity == null) return;
6306
6307 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
6308 {
6309 if (_designControl.Entities.Contains(entity))
6310 {
6311 string? sourcePath = entity.EntityData as string;
6312 int orderedPartIndex = OrderedPartEntities.IndexOf(entity);
6313
6314 var removedGrids = new List<devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid>();
6315 var originSymbols = new List<BlockReference>();
6316
6317 // Check if any other entities from the same model remain (same source path) excluding this one
6318 bool anyRemaining = _designControl.Entities
6319 .Any(e => e != null && e != entity && e.EntityData as string == sourcePath && (e is Brep || e is Mesh));
6320
6321 if (!anyRemaining && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath))
6322 {
6323 // Remove associated PART_ORIGIN BlockReference
6324 originSymbols = _designControl.Entities
6325 .OfType<BlockReference>()
6326 .Where(br => (br.EntityData as string) == $"PART_ORIGIN:{sourcePath}")
6327 .ToList();
6328
6329 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
6330 {
6331 // Remove associated Viewport Grids matching the origin position
6332 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
6333 {
6334 var gridsToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
6335 .Where(g => g.Plane.Origin.Equals(os.InsertionPoint))
6336 .ToList();
6337 removedGrids.AddRange(gridsToRemove);
6338 }
6339 }
6340 }
6341
6342 Action doRemove = () =>
6343 {
6344 _designControl.Entities.Remove(entity);
6345
6346 if (orderedPartIndex >= 0 && OrderedPartEntities.Contains(entity))
6347 {
6348 OrderedPartEntities.Remove(entity);
6349 }
6350
6351 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
6352 {
6353 _designControl.Entities.Remove(os);
6354 }
6355
6356 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
6357 {
6358 foreach (var g in removedGrids)
6359 {
6360 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(g);
6361 }
6362 }
6363
6364 // Mark state as dirty so user knows they need to update faces
6365 FacesUpToDate = false;
6366 _pathManager.InvalidateShellCache();
6367 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0)
6368 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces")
6369 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
6370
6371 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
6372 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
6373 _designControl.Invalidate();
6374 };
6375
6376 Action undoRemove = () =>
6377 {
6378 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(entity))
6379 {
6380 _designControl.Entities.Add(entity);
6381 }
6382
6383 if (orderedPartIndex >= 0 && !OrderedPartEntities.Contains(entity))
6384 {
6385 if (orderedPartIndex <= OrderedPartEntities.Count)
6386 {
6387 OrderedPartEntities.Insert(orderedPartIndex, entity);
6388 }
6389 else
6390 {
6391 OrderedPartEntities.Add(entity);
6392 }
6393 }
6394
6395 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
6396 {
6397 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(os))
6398 {
6399 _designControl.Entities.Add(os);
6400 }
6401 }
6402
6403 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
6404 {
6405 foreach (var g in removedGrids)
6406 {
6407 if (!_designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Contains(g))
6408 {
6409 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(g);
6410 }
6411 }
6412 }
6413
6414 FacesUpToDate = false;
6415 _pathManager.InvalidateShellCache();
6416 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0)
6417 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces")
6418 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
6419
6420 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
6421 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
6422 _designControl.Invalidate();
6423 };
6424
6425 // Execute the removal
6426 doRemove();
6427
6428 // Push the undo/redo action command to the UndoManager
6429 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
6430 undoAction: undoRemove,
6431 redoAction: doRemove,
6432 description: $"Remove Model Entity {entity.GetType().Name}",
6433 category: "Model Import"
6434 ));
6435 }
6436 });
6437 }

6451 private async Task ReExtractFacesPreservingIgnoredStateAsync(
6452 int entityCountBeforeImport,
6453 HashSet<(int EntityIndex, int FaceIndex)> preservedIgnoredFaceIndices,
6454 HashSet<int> preservedIgnoredHoleIds)
6455 {
6456 try
6457 {
6458 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_UpdatingFaces");
6459
6460 // Run extraction-heavy work in background thread
6461 var token = _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default;
6465 var extractionResult = await Task.Run(async () =>
6466 {
6467 await UpdateProgressAsync(0, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_PreparingExtraction") ?? "A iniciar extração de faces..."} (0%)", delay: 0);
6468 var extractor = new FaceExtractor(_designControl.Entities);
6469 var extractedFaces = extractor.ExtractFaces((percentage, faceCount) =>
6470 {
6471 // Map 0-100% of extraction to 0-68% of overall progress
6472 int overallProgress = (int)(percentage * 0.68);
6473 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
6474 {
6475 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
6476 string extractingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractingFaces") ?? "A extrair faces";
6477 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{extractingText} ({percentage}%)";
6478 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
6479 }, token);
6480
6481 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
6482 await UpdateProgressAsync(69, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ProcessingFaceData") ?? "A processar dados das faces..."} (69%)");
6483
6484 await UpdateProgressAsync(70, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingHoleDetection") ?? "A iniciar deteção de furos..."} (70%)");
6485
6486 List<CADHole> detectedHoles;
6487 List<CADFace> nonHoleFaces;
6488 (detectedHoles, nonHoleFaces) = HoleDetector.DetectHoles(extractedFaces, (percentage, holeCount) =>
6489 {
6490 // Map 0-100% of hole detection to 70-88% of overall progress
6491 int overallProgress = 70 + (int)(percentage * 0.18);
6492 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
6493 {
6494 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
6495 string detectingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_DetectingHoles") ?? "A detetar furos";
6496 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{detectingText} ({overallProgress}%)";
6497 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
6498 }, token);
6499
6500 // await UpdateProgressAsync(89, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_HoleDetectionComplete") ?? "Deteção de furos completa..."} (89%)");
6501
6502 return (extractedFaces, detectedHoles, nonHoleFaces);
6503 }, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
6504
6505 // Now we’re back on the UI thread
6506 var (faces, holes, nonHoleFaces) = extractionResult;
6507
6508 // Update main data structures
6509 _allFacesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(faces);
6510 _facesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(nonHoleFaces);
6511 _holesByColor = GroupHolesByColor(holes);
6512
6513 // Rebuild face-to-hole mapping
6514 _faceIndexToHoleMap = new Dictionary<int, CADHole>();
6515 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
6516 {
6517 foreach (var hole in holeList)
6518 {
6519 foreach (var faceGlobalIndex in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
6520 {
6521 if (!_faceIndexToHoleMap.ContainsKey(faceGlobalIndex))
6522 _faceIndexToHoleMap.Add(faceGlobalIndex, hole);
6523 }
6524 }
6525 }
6526
6527 // Reapply ignored state to faces
6528 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
6529 foreach (var face in faces)
6530 {
6531 if (preservedIgnoredFaceIndices.Contains((face.EntityIndex, face.FaceIndex)))
6532 {
6533 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
6534 face.IsIgnored = true;
6535 }
6536 }
6537
6538 // Reapply ignored state to holes
6539 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
6540 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
6541 {
6542 foreach (var hole in holeList)
6543 {
6544 if (preservedIgnoredHoleIds.Contains(hole.HoleId))
6545 {
6546 IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
6547 hole.IsIgnored = true;
6548
6549 // Also mark constituent faces as ignored
6550 var facesInHole = faces
6551 .Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex))
6552 .ToList();
6553
6554 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6555 {
6556 IgnoredFaces.Add(f);
6557 f.IsIgnored = true;
6558 }
6559 }
6560 }
6561 }
6562
6563 // Update visual representation
6564 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
6565 {
6566 var ignoredFacesList = IgnoredFaces.ToList();
6567 if (ignoredFacesList.Any())
6568 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(ignoredFacesList);
6569 }
6570
6571 // Refresh tree view and UI
6572 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
6573 _treeViewHelper.PopulateTreeView(
6574 _facesByColor,
6575 _holesByColor,
6576 _allFacesByColor,
6577 showExteriorOnly: IsExteriorOnlyChecked,
6578 showVisibleOnly: IsVisibleOnlyChecked
6579 );
6580
6581 CanExport = true;
6582 planning_sp?.InitializeToleranceSliders();
6583
6584 int restoredFaceCount = IgnoredFaces.Count;
6585 int restoredHoleCount = IgnoredHoles.Count;
6586
6587 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
6588 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_FacesExtracted")!,
6589 faces.Count,
6590 _facesByColor.Count
6591 ) + (holes.Count > 0 ? $" | {holes.Count} holes detected" : "")
6592 + (restoredFaceCount > 0 || restoredHoleCount > 0
6593 ? $" | Restored {restoredFaceCount} ignored faces, {restoredHoleCount} ignored holes"
6594 : "");
6595
6596 SaveCurrentSession();
6597 }
6598 catch (Exception ex)
6599 {
6600 MessageBox.Show(
6601 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_ExtractFacesError") ?? "Error updating faces:") + $" {ex.Message}",
6602 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Internal Error",
6603 MessageBoxButton.OK,
6604 MessageBoxImage.Error
6605 );
6606 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractionFailed");
6607 }
6608 }

6836 private async Task ExtractOrUpdateFacesAsync()
6837 {
6838 try
6839 {
6840 if (IsExtractingFaces)
6841 {
6842 CancelFaceExtraction();
6843 return;
6844 }
6845
6846 // SUCCESS: Check if path generation is in progress and prompt user
6847 if (_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource != null && !_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
6848 {
6849 var result = MessageBox.Show(
6850 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_CancelGenerationAndUpdateFaces") ?? "Quer cancelar a geração de trajetórias e atualizar as faces?",
6851 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_CancelGenerationTitle") ?? "Cancelar Geração de Trajetórias",
6852 MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
6853 MessageBoxImage.Question);
6854
6855 if (result == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
6856 {
6857 CancelPathGeneration();
6858 // Wait a short moment to allow the background task to respond to cancellation
6859 await Task.Delay(200);
6860 }
6861 else
6862 {
6863 return; // User chose not to cancel, so abort extraction
6864 }
6865 }
6866
6867 int previousEntityCount = 0;
6868 if (_allFacesByColor != null && _allFacesByColor.Count > 0)
6869 {
6870 previousEntityCount = _allFacesByColor.Values
6871 .SelectMany(f => f)
6872 .Select(f => f.EntityIndex)
6873 .DefaultIfEmpty(-1)
6874 .Max() + 1;
6875 }
6876
6877 // No previous extraction or user forces update when faces are up to date -> full extraction
6878 if (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0 || previousEntityCount >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
6879 {
6880 await PerformFaceExtractionAsync(false);
6881 _lastExtractedEntityCount = _designControl.Entities.Count;
6882 }
6883 else
6884 {
6885 // Incremental extraction (new entities added)
6886 await PerformFaceExtractionAsync(true, previousEntityCount);
6887 _lastExtractedEntityCount = _designControl.Entities.Count;
6888 }
6889
6890 FacesUpToDate = true; // Mark faces as up-to-date after extraction
6891 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces") ?? "Update Faces";
6892 }
6893 catch (Exception ex)
6894 {
6895 MessageBox.Show(
6896 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_ExtractFacesError") ??
6897 "Error extracting faces:") + $" {ex.Message}",
6898 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Internal Error",
6899 MessageBoxButton.OK,
6900 MessageBoxImage.Error
6901 );
6902 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractionFailed") ?? "Extraction failed";
6903 }
6904 }

6912 private async Task PerformFaceExtractionAsync(bool isIncremental, int entityCountBeforeImport = 0)
6913 {
6914 try
6915 {
6916 if (IsExtractingFaces) return;
6917 IsExtractingFaces = true;
6918 _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
6919 _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
6920
6921 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
6922
6923 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
6924 {
6925 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(16, 207, 200));
6926 EyeshotStatus_Text = isIncremental ?
6927 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractingNewFaces") ?? "Extracting faces from the new entities") :
6928 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractingFaces") ?? "Extracting faces...");
6929
6930 // Update text to "Cancel Extraction"
6931 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "CancelExtraction") ?? "Cancelar Extração";
6932 });
6933 await UpdateProgressAsync(0, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingExtraction") ?? "A iniciar extração..."} (0%)");
6934
6935 var entitiesToExtract = new EntityList();
6936 var originalIndices = new List<int>();
6937
6938 if (!isIncremental)
6939 {
6940 await UpdateProgressAsync(1, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingMarkers") ?? "A limpar marcadores..."} (1%)");
6941 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
6942
6943 await UpdateProgressAsync(2, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingSelection") ?? "A limpar seleção..."} (2%)");
6944 _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
6945
6946 await UpdateProgressAsync(3, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingTreeView") ?? "A limpar árvore..."} (3%)");
6947 TreeViewItems.Clear();
6948

7137 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{filteringFacesMsg} (93%)");
7138
7139 var vertexToFaces = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<CADFace>>();
7140 var token = _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default;
7141
7142 if (extractedFaces != null && detectedHoles != null)
7143 {
7144 foreach (var f in extractedFaces)
7145 {
7146 foreach (var kp in f.KeyPoints.Where(p => p.PointType == PointTypeEnum.Corner))
7147 {
7148 if (!vertexToFaces.ContainsKey(kp.VertexIndex))
7149 vertexToFaces[kp.VertexIndex] = new HashSet<CADFace>();
7150 vertexToFaces[kp.VertexIndex].Add(f);
7151 }
7152 }
7153
7154 var faceIdxToHole = new Dictionary<int, CADHole>();
7155 foreach (var h in detectedHoles)
7156 {
7157 foreach (var fIdx in h.FaceGlobalIndices)
7158 faceIdxToHole[fIdx] = h;
7159 }
7160
7161 var facesToIgnore = new List<CADFace>();
7162 static double GetBridgeFaceConfigDouble(string key, double defaultValue)
7163 {
7164 return double.TryParse(
7165 ConfigurationManager.AppSettings[key],
7166 System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any,
7167 System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
7168 out var value)
7169 ? value
7170 : defaultValue;
7171 }
7172
7173 bool allowSingleSidedShelfFaces =
7174 bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["HoleDetection_AutoIgnoreSingleSidedShelfFaces"], out var configuredSingleSidedShelf) &&
7175 configuredSingleSidedShelf;
7176 double bridgeAlignmentDotThreshold = GetBridgeFaceConfigDouble("HoleDetection_BridgeFaceAlignmentDot", 0.85);
7177 double bridgePlaneDistanceTolerance = GetBridgeFaceConfigDouble("HoleDetection_BridgeFacePlaneDistanceTolerance", 2.0);
7178 double bridgeAxisDistanceMultiplier = GetBridgeFaceConfigDouble("HoleDetection_BridgeFaceAxisDistanceDiameterMultiplier", 1.5);
7179 double bridgeSideTolerance = GetBridgeFaceConfigDouble("HoleDetection_BridgeFaceSideTolerance", 0.1);
7180
7181 foreach (var face in extractedFaces.Where(f => f.FaceType == FaceTypeEnum.Planar))
7182 {
7183 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
7184 var faceCenter = EyeshotGeometryUtils.GetFaceCenter(face);
7185 var faceNormal = EyeshotGeometryUtils.GetFaceAxis(face);
7186
7187 bool holeAboveDetected = false;
7188 bool holeBelowDetected = false;
7189
7190 var adjacentFaces = new HashSet<CADFace>();
7191 foreach (var kp in face.KeyPoints.Where(p => p.PointType == PointTypeEnum.Corner))
7192 {
7193 if (vertexToFaces.TryGetValue(kp.VertexIndex, out var adj))
7194 {
7195 foreach (var af in adj)
7196 if (af != face) adjacentFaces.Add(af);
7197 }
7198 }
7199
7200 var adjacentHoles = new HashSet<CADHole>();
7201 foreach (var af in adjacentFaces)
7202 {
7203 if (faceIdxToHole.TryGetValue(af.FaceGlobalIndex, out var hole))
7204 {
7205 adjacentHoles.Add(hole);
7206 }
7207 }
7208
7209 foreach (var hole in adjacentHoles)
7210 {
7211 if (hole.AxisDirection == null || hole.TopCenterPoint == null || hole.BottomCenterPoint == null) continue;
7212
7213 double alignmentDot = Math.Abs(Vector3D.Dot(faceNormal, hole.AxisDirection));
7214 if (alignmentDot > bridgeAlignmentDotThreshold)
7215 {
7216 Point3D holeCenter = new Point3D(
7217 (hole.TopCenterPoint.X + hole.BottomCenterPoint.X) / 2.0,
7218 (hole.TopCenterPoint.Y + hole.BottomCenterPoint.Y) / 2.0,
7219 (hole.TopCenterPoint.Z + hole.BottomCenterPoint.Z) / 2.0
7220 );
7221 Vector3D faceToHoleCentroid = new Vector3D(faceCenter, holeCenter);
7222 double relPos = Vector3D.Dot(faceToHoleCentroid, faceNormal);
7223
7224 if (relPos > bridgeSideTolerance) holeAboveDetected = true;
7225 else if (relPos < -bridgeSideTolerance) holeBelowDetected = true;
7226 }
7227 }
7228
7229 if (!holeAboveDetected || !holeBelowDetected)
7230 {
7231 var sameColorHoles = detectedHoles.Where(h => h.HoleColor == face.FaceColor).ToList();
7232
7233 if (sameColorHoles.Any())
7234 {
7235 foreach (var hole in sameColorHoles)
7236 {
7237 if (adjacentHoles.Contains(hole)) continue;
7238 if (hole.AxisDirection == null || hole.TopCenterPoint == null || hole.BottomCenterPoint == null) continue;
7239
7240 double alignmentDot = Math.Abs(Vector3D.Dot(faceNormal, hole.AxisDirection));
7241 if (alignmentDot > bridgeAlignmentDotThreshold)
7242 {
7243 double distToPlaneTop = Math.Abs(Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(faceCenter, hole.TopCenterPoint), faceNormal));
7244 double distToPlaneBottom = Math.Abs(Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(faceCenter, hole.BottomCenterPoint), faceNormal));
7245 double diameter = !double.IsNaN(hole.TopDiameter) && hole.TopDiameter > 0 ? hole.TopDiameter : hole.BottomDiameter;
7246 double distToAxis = DistancePointToLine(faceCenter, hole.TopCenterPoint, hole.AxisDirection);
7247
7248 if ((distToPlaneTop < bridgePlaneDistanceTolerance || distToPlaneBottom < bridgePlaneDistanceTolerance) &&
7249 diameter > 0 &&
7250 distToAxis < diameter * bridgeAxisDistanceMultiplier)
7251 {
7252 Point3D holeCenter = new Point3D(
7253 (hole.TopCenterPoint.X + hole.BottomCenterPoint.X) / 2.0,
7254 (hole.TopCenterPoint.Y + hole.BottomCenterPoint.Y) / 2.0,
7255 (hole.TopCenterPoint.Z + hole.BottomCenterPoint.Z) / 2.0
7256 );
7257
7258 Vector3D faceToHoleCentroid = new Vector3D(faceCenter, holeCenter);
7259 double relPos = Vector3D.Dot(faceToHoleCentroid, faceNormal);
7260
7261 if (relPos > bridgeSideTolerance) holeAboveDetected = true;
7262 else if (relPos < -bridgeSideTolerance) holeBelowDetected = true;
7263 }
7264 }
7265 }
7266 }
7267 }
7268
7269 if (holeAboveDetected && holeBelowDetected)
7270 {
7271 face.IsIgnored = true;
7272 face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles = true;
7273 facesToIgnore.Add(face);
7274 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(face)) IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
7275 Debug.WriteLine($" > SUCCESS: Auto-ignored bridge face {face.FaceGlobalIndex} (Sandwiched context)");
7276 }
7277 else if (allowSingleSidedShelfFaces && holeAboveDetected)
7278 {
7279 if (detectedHoles.Any(h => h.HoleColor == face.FaceColor))
7280 {
7281 face.IsIgnored = true;
7282 face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles = true;
7283 facesToIgnore.Add(face);
7284 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(face)) IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
7285 Debug.WriteLine($" > SUCCESS: Auto-ignored interior face {face.FaceGlobalIndex} (Same color shelf)");
7286 }
7287 }
7288 }
7289 if (facesToIgnore.Any())
7290 {
7291 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(facesToIgnore);
7292 }
7293 }

7295 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GeneratingMeasurementPoints") ?? "A gerar pontos de medição..."} (93%)");
7296 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

7340

7384 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>

7386 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractionCancelled") ?? "Face Extraction Cancelled";
7387 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractionCancelled") ?? "Face Extraction Cancelled";
7388 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;

7457 private void ConvertSingleFaceToHole(CADFace face)
7458 {
7459 if (face == null) return;
7460 try
7461 {
7462 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
7463 int holeId = GetNextHoleId();
7464 var newHole = HoleDetector.CreateHoleFromSingleFace(face, holeId, allFaces);
7465 if (newHole != null)
7466 {
7467 AddNewHole(newHole);
7468 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7469 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7470 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"Hole {newHole.HoleId} converted from single face.";
7471
7472 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7473 () =>
7474 {
7475 PerformConvertHoleToFaces(newHole);
7476 },
7477 () =>
7478 {
7479 AddNewHole(newHole);
7480 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7481 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7482 },
7483 description: $"Convert single face to Hole {newHole.HoleId}",
7484 category: "Hole Management"
7485 ));

7487 }
7488 catch (Exception ex)

7490 Debug.WriteLine($"Error converting single face to hole: {ex.Message}");

7497 private void StartFaceToHoleConversion(CADFace face)
7498 {
7499 if (face == null || !IsCylindricalFace(face))
7500 {
7501 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_InvalidFaceForConversion")
7502 ?? "Invalid face for conversion. Face must be cylindrical.";
7503 return;
7504 }
7505
7506 _pendingHoleConversionFace = face;
7507 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_SelectSecondFace")
7508 ?? "Select another cylindrical face with the same radius to complete hole conversion.";
7509 }
7510
7514 private void CompleteFaceToHoleConversion(CADFace secondFace)
7515 {
7516 if (_pendingHoleConversionFace == null || secondFace == null)
7517 {
7518 CancelFaceToHoleConversion();
7519 return;
7520 }
7521
7522 // Validate compatibility using HoleDetector
7523 if (!HoleDetector.CanConvertToHole(_pendingHoleConversionFace, secondFace))
7524 {
7525 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_IncompatibleFaces")
7526 ?? "Selected faces are not compatible. Both faces must be cylindrical with the same radius.";
7527 return;
7528 }
7529
7530 try
7531 {
7532 // Get all faces for context (needed for hole validation)
7533 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
7534
7535 // Get next hole ID
7536 int holeId = GetNextHoleId();
7537
7538 // Create hole using HoleDetector's public method
7539 var newHole = HoleDetector.CreateHoleFromTwoFaces(
7540 _pendingHoleConversionFace,
7541 secondFace,
7542 holeId,
7543 allFaces
7544 );
7545
7546 if (newHole != null)
7547 {
7548 // Add the new hole to the appropriate collection
7549 AddNewHole(newHole);
7550
7551 // Refresh the tree view
7552 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7553 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7554
7555 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
7556 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionComplete")
7557 ?? "Hole conversion complete. Created Hole {0}.",
7558 newHole.HoleId
7559 );
7560
7561 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7562 () =>
7563 {
7564 PerformConvertHoleToFaces(newHole);
7565 },
7566 () =>
7567 {
7568 AddNewHole(newHole);
7569 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7570 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7571 },
7572 description: $"Convert faces to Hole {newHole.HoleId}",
7573 category: "Hole Management"
7574 ));
7575 }
7576 else
7577 {
7578 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionFailed")
7579 ?? "Failed to create hole from selected faces.";
7580 }
7581 }
7582 catch (Exception ex)
7583 {
7584 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
7585 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionError")
7586 ?? "Error during hole conversion: {0}",
7587 ex.Message
7588 );
7589 }
7590 finally
7591 {
7592 _pendingHoleConversionFace = null;
7593 }
7594 }

7600 {
7601 _pendingHoleConversionFace = null;

7603 ?? "Hole conversion cancelled.";

7610 {

7613 _faceBeingMarkedManually = face;
7614 _holeBeingMarkedManually = null;
7615 }
7616 else if (item is CADHole hole)
7617 {
7618 _holeBeingMarkedManually = hole;
7619 _faceBeingMarkedManually = null;
7620 }
7621 else
7622 {
7623 return;
7624 }
7625
7626 _isManualMarkingActive = true;
7627 _manuallyMarkedPoints.Clear();
7628 ClearManualMarkingSpheres();
7629
7630 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingStarted")
7631 ?? "Manual marking mode active. Click on the surface to add measurement points. Right-click to finish.";
7632 }
7633
7637 private void CompleteManualMarking()
7638 {
7639 if (!_isManualMarkingActive)
7640 return;
7641
7642 try
7643 {
7644 if (_faceBeingMarkedManually != null && _manuallyMarkedPoints.Any())
7645 {
7646 var face = _faceBeingMarkedManually;
7647 var oldPoints = face.MeasurementPoints?.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList() ?? new List<Point4D>();
7648 var oldHasManual = face.HasManualMeasurementPoints;
7649
7650 var newPoints = _manuallyMarkedPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 1.0)).ToList();
7651
7652 Action<List<Point4D>, bool> setPointsAction = (pts, hasManual) =>
7653 {
7654 face.MeasurementPoints = pts.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
7655 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = hasManual;
7656 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
7657 {
7658 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
7659 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
7660 }
7661 };
7662
7663 setPointsAction(newPoints, true);
7664
7665 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7666 () => setPointsAction(oldPoints, oldHasManual),
7667 () => setPointsAction(newPoints, true)
7668 ));
7669
7670 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingComplete")
7671 ?? "Manual marking complete. {0} measurement points marked.";
7672 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(message, _manuallyMarkedPoints.Count);
7673 }
7674 else if (_holeBeingMarkedManually != null && _manuallyMarkedPoints.Any())
7675 {
7676 var hole = _holeBeingMarkedManually;
7677 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
7678 var holeFaces = allFaces.Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
7679
7680 var oldStates = holeFaces.ToDictionary(f => f, f => new
7681 {
7682 Points = f.MeasurementPoints?.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList() ?? new List<Point4D>(),
7683 HasManual = f.HasManualMeasurementPoints
7684 });
7685
7686 var newPoints = _manuallyMarkedPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 1.0)).ToList();
7687
7688 Action<bool> setPointsAction = (isRedo) =>
7689 {
7690 foreach (var face in holeFaces)
7691 {
7692 if (isRedo)
7693 {
7694 face.MeasurementPoints = newPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
7695 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = true;
7696 }
7697 else
7698 {
7699 face.MeasurementPoints = oldStates[face].Points.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
7700 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = oldStates[face].HasManual;
7701 }
7702 }
7703 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
7704 {
7705 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
7706 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
7707 }
7708 };
7709
7710 setPointsAction(true);
7711
7712 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7713 () => setPointsAction(false),
7714 () => setPointsAction(true)
7715 ));
7716
7717 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingComplete")
7718 ?? "Manual marking complete. {0} measurement points marked.";
7719 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(message, _manuallyMarkedPoints.Count);
7720 }
7721 else
7722 {
7723 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingCancelled")
7724 ?? "Manual marking cancelled - no points marked.";
7725 }
7726
7727 // Refresh measurement point visualization if currently shown
7728 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
7729 {
7730 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
7731 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
7732 }
7733 }
7734 finally
7735 {
7736 _isManualMarkingActive = false;
7737 _faceBeingMarkedManually = null;
7738 _holeBeingMarkedManually = null;
7739 _manuallyMarkedPoints.Clear();
7740 ClearManualMarkingSpheres();
7741 _designControl.Invalidate();
7742 SaveCurrentSession();
7743 }
7744 }

7753 try { _designControl.Entities.Remove(sphere); } catch { }

7755 _manualMarkingSpheres.Clear();
7756 _designControl?.Invalidate();

7776 private bool IsSpecificContextMenuTargetUnderCursor()
7777 {
7778 if (_designControl == null)
7779 return false;
7780
7781 try
7782 {
7783 var mousePosition = Mouse.GetPosition(_designControl);
7784 if (double.IsNaN(mousePosition.X) ||
7785 double.IsNaN(mousePosition.Y) ||
7786 mousePosition.X < 0 ||
7787 mousePosition.Y < 0 ||
7788 mousePosition.X > _designControl.ActualWidth ||
7789 mousePosition.Y > _designControl.ActualHeight)
7790 {
7791 return false;
7792 }
7793
7794 var screenPoint = new System.Drawing.Point((int)mousePosition.X, (int)mousePosition.Y);
7795 var itemUnderCursor = _designControl.GetItemUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
7796 if (itemUnderCursor != null)
7797 return true;
7798
7799 int entityIndex = _designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
7800 if (entityIndex < 0 || entityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
7801 return false;
7802
7803 return IsSpecificContextEntity(_designControl.Entities[entityIndex]);
7804 }
7805 catch (Exception ex)
7806 {
7807 Debug.WriteLine($"Context menu hit-test failed: {ex.Message}");
7808 return false;
7809 }
7810 }
7811
7817 private bool IsSpecificContextEntity(Entity? entity)
7818 {
7819 if (entity == null)
7820 return false;
7821
7822 if (entity.EntityData is WaypointData ||
7823 entity.EntityData is PathSegmentData ||
7824 entity is LinearPath linearPath &&
7825 linearPath.LayerName != null &&
7826 linearPath.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
7827 {
7828 return true;
7829 }
7830
7831 if (_visualsManager?.ControlPointSpheres?.Contains(entity) == true ||
7832 _manualMarkingSpheres.Contains(entity))
7833 {
7834 return true;
7835 }
7836
7837 if (entity.EntityData is string entityData &&
7838 entityData.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
7839 {
7840 return true;
7841 }
7842
7843 if (entity is Brep || entity is Mesh)
7844 {
7845 return !IsDesignerUtilityLayer(entity.LayerName);
7846 }
7847
7848 return false;
7849 }
7850
7856 private static bool IsDesignerUtilityLayer(string? layerName)
7857 {
7858 return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName) &&
7859 (layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7860 layerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7861 layerName.StartsWith("PATH_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7862 layerName.Contains("SIMULATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7863 string.Equals(layerName, "MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7864 string.Equals(layerName, "COLLISION_MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7865 string.Equals(layerName, "RAYCAST_HITS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7866 string.Equals(layerName, "PROBE_TRACKING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7867 string.Equals(layerName, "SCANNER_FOV_VISUALIZATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
7868 }

7899 private int GetNextHoleId()

7901 int maxId = 0;
7902
7903 if (_holesByColor != null)
7904 {
7905 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
7906 {
7907 foreach (var hole in holeList)

7910 }
7911 }

7920 private void AddNewHole(CADHole hole)
7921 {
7922 // Determine the color key from the constituent faces
7923 string colorKey = "Default";
7924
7925 if (hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null && hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any() && _allFacesByColor != null)
7926 {
7927 foreach (var kvp in _allFacesByColor)
7928 {
7929 if (kvp.Value.Any(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)))
7930 {
7931 colorKey = kvp.Key;
7932 break;
7933 }
7934 }
7935 }
7936
7937 // Add to holes collection
7938 if (_holesByColor != null)
7939 {
7940 if (!_holesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey))
7941 {
7942 _holesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADHole>();
7943 }
7944
7945 _holesByColor[colorKey].Add(hole);
7946 }
7947
7948 // Update face-to-hole mapping if it exists
7949 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null && hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null)
7950 {
7951 foreach (var faceIdx in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
7952 {
7953 _faceIndexToHoleMap[faceIdx] = hole;
7954 }
7955 }
7956
7957 // Automatically remove constituent faces from _facesByColor
7958 if (hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null && _facesByColor != null)
7959 {
7960 var keysToClean = new List<string>();
7961 foreach (var kvp in _facesByColor)
7962 {
7963 kvp.Value.RemoveAll(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex));
7964 if (kvp.Value.Count == 0)
7965 {
7966 keysToClean.Add(kvp.Key);
7967 }
7968 }
7969 foreach (var key in keysToClean)
7970 {
7971 _facesByColor.Remove(key);
7972 }
7973 }
7974 }

8112 public async Task<bool> GenerateAndVisualizePaths()
8113 {
8114 // Create new cancellation token for this generation
8115 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
8116 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
8117
8118 // Update button text to "Cancel"
8119 var measuring_sp = Application.Current.Windows.OfType<Window>().FirstOrDefault()?
8120 .FindName("Measuring_SidePanelContainer") as Measuring_SidePanel;
8121 if (measuring_sp != null)
8122 {
8123 measuring_sp.IsPathGenerationRunning = true;
8124 }
8125
8126 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
8127
8128 // Set progress bar to a subtle light gray color for path generation
8129 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(220, 220, 230));
8130 Machine_Status_Progress = 10;
8131 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingPathGeneration") ?? "Starting path generation...";
8132 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_GeneratingPaths") ?? "Generating measurement paths...";
8133
8134 try
8135 {
8136 if (_pathManager == null) return false;
8137
8138 CMMType selectedCmmType = GetSelectedCmmType();
8139 _pathManager.SetCmmType(selectedCmmType);
8140
8141 // 1. Clear previous paths
8142 Machine_Status_Progress = 15;
8143 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingPaths") ?? "Clearing previous paths...";
8144
8145 _pathManager.ClearAllPaths();
8146
8147 Machine_Status_Progress = 20;
8148 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_CollectingFaces") ?? "Collecting faces...";
8149
8150 // 2. Collect all faces
8151 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
8152 if (!allFaces.Any())
8153 {
8154 MessageBox.Show(
8155 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_NoFacesAvailable") ?? "No faces have been extracted. Please extract faces first.",
8156 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningErrorTitle") ?? "Path Planning Error",
8157 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8158 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
8159
8160 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningFailed") ?? "Path planning failed";
8161 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8162 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
8163 return false;
8164 }
8165
8166 // Auto-ignore bottom planar faces if Scanner and AvoidBottomFace is true
8167 if (selectedCmmType == CMMType.Scanner)
8168 {
8169 bool avoidBottomFace = false;
8170 bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Scanner_AvoidBottomFace"] ?? "false", out avoidBottomFace);
8171 if (avoidBottomFace)
8172 {
8173 bool addedAny = false;
8174 var groups = allFaces.GroupBy(f => f.EntityIndex);
8175 foreach (var group in groups)
8176 {
8177 var planarFaces = group.Where(f => f.FaceType == FaceTypeEnum.Planar && f.ControlPoints != null && f.ControlPoints.Any()).ToList();
8178 if (planarFaces.Any())
8179 {
8180 var bottomPlanarFace = planarFaces.OrderBy(f => f.ControlPoints.Average(cp => cp.Z)).First();
8181 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(bottomPlanarFace))
8182 {
8183 IgnoredFaces.Add(bottomPlanarFace);
8184 addedAny = true;
8185 }
8186 }
8187 }
8188 if (addedAny && _ignoredItemManager != null)
8189 {
8190 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(IgnoredFaces);
8191 }
8192 }
8193 }
8194
8195 // 3. Create color-tool dictionary using MeasuringToolByColor.xml configuration
8196 var colorToolDictionary = new Dictionary<Color, string>();
8197 var allColors = allFaces.Select(f => f.FaceColor).Distinct();
8198 foreach (var color in allColors)
8199 {
8200 if (!colorToolDictionary.ContainsKey(color))
8201 {
8202 // Get tool from configuration (will auto-add to config if not found)
8203 string toolName = _measuringToolConfig.GetToolForColor(color);
8204 colorToolDictionary.Add(color, toolName);
8205 }
8206 }
8207
8208 // 4. Path planning parameters
8209 bool filterPointsToBeInsideFace = true;
8210 double retractDistance = 10.0;
8211
8212 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8213 {
8214 Machine_Status_Progress = 1; StatusProgressBarColor = new System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Colors.DodgerBlue);
8215 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GeneratingPaths") ?? "Generating paths...";
8216 });
8217
8218 // 5. Generate paths with progressive progress updates
8219 Dictionary<System.Drawing.Color, List<Point3D>>? plannedPaths = null;
8220 _pendingScannerNormalsByColor = null;
8221 _pendingScannerUpVectorsByColor = null;
8222 _pendingScannerPointTypesByColor = null;
8223 _pendingScannerEntityIndicesByColor = null;
8224
8225 if (selectedCmmType == CMMType.Probe)
8226 {
8227 // Subscribe to path generation progress events for real-time updates
8228 EventHandler<PathGenerationProgressEventArgs> progressHandler = (s, e) =>
8229 {
8230 // SUCCESS: FIX: Use BeginInvoke (async) instead of Invoke (blocking) to prevent UI freeze
8231 Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
8232 {
8233 // Use 0-100% based on overall progress across all colors
8234 int progressPercent = (int)(e.OverallProgress * 100.0);
8235 Machine_Status_Progress = progressPercent;
8236
8237 // Format progress message with color name and RGB values
8238 var faceColor = e.CurrentColor;
8239
8240 // Get friendly color name using ColorNamer utility
8241 string colorName;
8242 try
8243 {
8244 colorName = ColorNamer.GetColorName(faceColor);
8245 }
8246 catch
8247 {
8248 // Fallback to generic name if ColorNamer fails
8249 colorName = "Color";
8250 }
8251
8252 // Format with color name and RGB values to match TreeView format: "ColorName (R#_G#_B#)"
8253 string colorDisplayText = $"{colorName} (R{faceColor.R}_G{faceColor.G}_B{faceColor.B})";
8254
8255 string generatingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GeneratingPathFor") ?? "Generating Path for";
8256 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{generatingText}: {colorDisplayText} - {e.CurrentPointIndex}/{e.TotalPointsInCurrentColor} faces ({progressPercent}%)";
8257
8258 // Normalize color to consistent lightness using HSL conversion (88% lightness for all colors)
8259 var normalizedColor = NormalizeColorLightness(faceColor, targetLightness: 0.88);
8260 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(normalizedColor.R, normalizedColor.G, normalizedColor.B));
8261 });
8262 };
8263
8264 _pathManager.PathGenerationProgress += progressHandler;
8265
8266 // Pass flipped face normals to PathManager before generating paths
8267 _pathManager.FlippedFaceNormals = _flippedFaceNormals;
8268
8269 // Run path generation asynchronously with cancellation support
8270 plannedPaths = await _pathManager.CreatePathHeuristicAsync(
8271 _designControl,
8272 allFaces,
8273 filterPointsToBeInsideFace,
8274 colorToolDictionary,
8275 retractDistance,
8276 _holesByColor, // Pass hole information to differentiate holes from cylindrical faces
8277 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource.Token // SUCCESS: Pass cancellation token
8278 );
8279
8280 // Check if cancelled
8281 if (_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource.Token.IsCancellationRequested)
8282 {
8283 Debug.WriteLine("🚫 Path generation was cancelled");
8284 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathGeneration_Cancelled") ?? "Path generation cancelled";
8285 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8286 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Orange);
8287
8288 SaveCurrentSession();
8289 return false;
8290 }
8291
8292 // Unsubscribe from progress events
8293 _pathManager.PathGenerationProgress -= progressHandler;
8294
8295 // Force design refresh to ensure entities are recognized
8296 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
8297 _designControl.Invalidate();
8298
8299 // Small delay to ensure entities are processed
8300 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(100);
8301
8302 // Debug: Count shell meshes
8303 int shellCount = _designControl.Entities.Count(e =>
8304 e.LayerName != null && e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
8305 Debug.WriteLine($"INFO: Shell meshes found after generation: {shellCount}");
8306
8307 // Notify that shell meshes now exist
8308 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShellMeshesExist));
8309 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShellVisibilityMenuText));
8310
8311 // Force command manager to re-evaluate
8312 CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
8313 }
8314 else // Scanner
8315 {
8316 _scanPathManager = new ScanPathManager(IgnoredFaces);
8317
8318 Machine_Status_Progress = 45;
8319 Machine_Status_ProgressText =
8320 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GeneratingScanPaths")
8321 ?? "Generating scanner paths...";
8322
8323 var allKnownHoles = _holesByColor.Values
8324 .SelectMany(h => h)
8325 .ToList();
8326
8327 EventHandler<ScanPathProgressEventArgs> scanProgressHandler = (s, e) =>
8328 {
8329 Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
8330 {
8331 int mappedPercent = 45 + (int)Math.Round(e.Percent * 0.25);
8332 Machine_Status_Progress = Math.Max(45, Math.Min(70, mappedPercent));
8333
8334 string template = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, e.MessageKey) ?? e.MessageKey;
8335 string message;
8336 try
8337 {
8338 message = e.Args.Length > 0 ? string.Format(template, e.Args) : template;
8339 }
8340 catch
8341 {
8342 message = template;
8343 }
8344
8345 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{e.Percent:F0}% - {message}";
8346 });
8347 };
8348
8349 List<ScanPath> scanPaths;
8350 _scanPathManager.ProgressChanged += scanProgressHandler;
8351 try
8352 {
8353 scanPaths = await Task.Run(() =>
8354 _scanPathManager.GenerateScanPaths(allFaces, allKnownHoles));
8355 }
8356 finally
8357 {
8358 _scanPathManager.ProgressChanged -= scanProgressHandler;
8359 }
8360
8361 // Convert scanner paths to the dictionary format expected by the rest of the method.
8362 // Keep scanner orientations separately so simulation can rotate the scanner/FOV correctly.
8363 plannedPaths = new Dictionary<Color, List<Point3D>>();
8364 var scannerNormalsByColor = new Dictionary<Color, List<Vector3D>>();
8365 var scannerUpVectorsByColor = new Dictionary<Color, List<Vector3D>>();
8366 var scannerPointTypesByColor = new Dictionary<Color, List<string>>();
8367 var scannerEntityIndicesByColor = new Dictionary<Color, List<int>>();
8368 if (scanPaths.Any())
8369 {
8370 // All positions live on one spherical path; group by the parent face color
8371 // so the existing LoadPaths / DrawAllPaths infrastructure is unchanged.
8372 var pathsByColor = scanPaths
8373 .Where(sp => sp.Face != null)
8374 .GroupBy(sp => sp.Face.FaceColor);
8375
8376 foreach (var group in pathsByColor)
8377 {
8378 var points = group
8379 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.Position))
8380 .ToList();
8381 var normals = group
8382 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => ScannerOrientationToToolNormal(sp.Orientation)))
8383 .ToList();
8384 var upVectors = group
8385 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.UpVector))
8386 .ToList();
8387 var pointTypes = group
8388 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.PointType))
8389 .ToList();
8390 var entityIndices = group
8391 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.ParentFace?.EntityIndex ?? group.First().Face?.EntityIndex ?? -1))
8392 .ToList();
8393 plannedPaths[group.Key] = points;
8394 scannerNormalsByColor[group.Key] = normals;
8395 scannerUpVectorsByColor[group.Key] = upVectors;
8396 scannerPointTypesByColor[group.Key] = pointTypes;
8397 scannerEntityIndicesByColor[group.Key] = entityIndices;
8398 }
8399
8400 // If all ScanPoints ended up with a null ParentFace (greedy-selected
8401 // positions get null from FindNearestFace), fall back to a single entry
8402 // keyed on the first face color so at least one path is drawn.
8403 if (!plannedPaths.Any() && allFaces.Any())
8404 {
8405 var allPoints = scanPaths
8406 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.Position))
8407 .ToList();
8408 var allNormals = scanPaths
8409 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => ScannerOrientationToToolNormal(p.Orientation)))
8410 .ToList();
8411 var allUpVectors = scanPaths
8412 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.UpVector))
8413 .ToList();
8414 var allPointTypes = scanPaths
8415 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.PointType))
8416 .ToList();
8417 var fallbackColor = allFaces.First().FaceColor;
8418 plannedPaths[fallbackColor] = allPoints;
8419 scannerNormalsByColor[fallbackColor] = allNormals;
8420 scannerUpVectorsByColor[fallbackColor] = allUpVectors;
8421 scannerPointTypesByColor[fallbackColor] = allPointTypes;
8422 scannerEntityIndicesByColor[fallbackColor] = scanPaths
8423 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.ParentFace?.EntityIndex ?? sp.Face?.EntityIndex ?? -1))
8424 .ToList();
8425 }
8426 }
8427
8428 _pendingScannerNormalsByColor = scannerNormalsByColor;
8429 _pendingScannerUpVectorsByColor = scannerUpVectorsByColor;
8430 _pendingScannerPointTypesByColor = scannerPointTypesByColor;
8431 _pendingScannerEntityIndicesByColor = scannerEntityIndicesByColor;
8432 }
8433
8434 Machine_Status_Progress = 70;
8435 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_LoadingPaths") ?? "Loading paths...";
8436
8437 if (plannedPaths == null) return false;
8438
8439 // 6. Load the paths into PathManager, then export after metadata is applied.
8440 string modelName = $"Model_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss}";
8441 _pathManager!.LoadPaths(plannedPaths, colorToolDictionary, modelName, autoExport: false, generatedCmmType: selectedCmmType);
8442 ApplyPendingScannerNormals();
8443 ApplyPendingScannerUpVectors();
8444 ApplyPendingScannerPointTypes();
8445 ApplyPendingScannerEntityIndices();
8446
8447 foreach (var cp in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
8448 {
8449 cp.PathCmmType = selectedCmmType;
8450 }
8451
8452 try
8453 {
8454 _pathManager.ExportPaths(modelName);
8455 }
8456 catch (Exception ex)
8457 {
8458 Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Auto-export failed: {ex.Message}");
8459 }
8460
8461 Machine_Status_Progress = 85;
8462 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_DrawingPaths") ?? "Drawing paths...";
8463
8464 // 7. Draw all paths
8465 _pathManager.DrawAllPaths();
8466
8467 // Collision Detection Check (only path lines vs part, with 5 mm inside threshold)
8468 // Only run for Probing mode (CMM_MeasuringType == 0) to avoid false positives for scan paths
8469 try
8470 {
8471 if (!IsScannerMode)
8472 {
8473 // Only check trajectory lines (exclude measurement point spheres/markers)
8474 var pathEntities = _designControl.Entities
8475 .OfType<LinearPath>()
8476 .Where(e => e.LayerName != null && e.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))
8477 .Cast<Entity>()
8478 .ToList();
8479
8480 var partEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e is Brep || e is Mesh).ToList();
8481
8482 if (pathEntities.Any() && partEntities.Any())
8483 {
8484 var listToCheck = new List<Entity>();
8485 listToCheck.AddRange(pathEntities);
8486 listToCheck.AddRange(partEntities);
8487
8488 await Task.Run(() =>
8489 {
8490 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8491 {
8492 Machine_Status_Progress = 88;
8493 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_CollisionDetection") ?? "Running collision detection...";
8494 });
8495
8496 var cd = new devDept.Eyeshot.CollisionDetection(listToCheck, _designControl.Blocks, true, collisionCheckType.OB, 5);
8497 cd.DoWork();
8498
8499 if (cd.Result != null && cd.Result.Count() > 0)
8500 {
8501 var pathEntitySet = new HashSet<Entity>(pathEntities);
8502
8503 // Filter results to only keep path-part collisions
8504 bool collisionFound = false;
8505 foreach (var res in cd.Result)
8506 {
8507 var ent1 = res.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity;
8508 var ent2 = res.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity;
8509
8510 bool isPath1 = pathEntitySet.Contains(ent1);
8511 bool isPath2 = pathEntitySet.Contains(ent2);
8512 bool isPart1 = ent1 is Brep || ent1 is Mesh;
8513 bool isPart2 = ent2 is Brep || ent2 is Mesh;
8514
8515 if ((isPath1 && isPart2) || (isPath2 && isPart1))
8516 {
8517 collisionFound = true;
8518 break;
8519 }
8520 }
8521
8522 if (collisionFound)
8523 {
8524 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8525 {
8526 MessageBox.Show(
8527 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_CollisionDetected") ?? "The path planning finished with collisions.",
8528 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_CollisionDetectedTitle") ?? "Collision Detected",
8529 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8530 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
8531 });
8532 }
8533 }
8534 });
8535 }
8536 }
8537 }
8538 catch (Exception ex)
8539 {
8540 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in collision detection: {ex.Message}");
8541 }
8542
8543 Machine_Status_Progress = 100;
8544 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_PathGenerationComplete") ?? "Path generation complete!";
8545
8546 // 8. Success message with formatting
8547 string successMessage = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningComplete") ??
8548 "Path planning complete. Generated {0} paths. Total points: {1}";
8549
8550 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(successMessage,
8551 plannedPaths.Count,
8552 plannedPaths.Sum(p => p.Value.Count));
8553
8554 // 9. Display path information
8555 ShowPathInfo();
8556
8557 // 10. Refresh the tool-color list in Measuring_SidePanel
8558 measuring_sp?.RefreshColorToolList();
8559
8560 // Reset progress bar after completion
8561 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
8562 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8563 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
8564
8565 SaveCurrentSession();
8566 }
8567 catch (OperationCanceledException)
8568 {
8569 // SUCCESS: Path generation was cancelled by user
8570 Debug.WriteLine("🚫 Path generation cancelled by user");
8571 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8572 {
8573 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathGeneration_Cancelled") ?? "Path generation cancelled";
8574 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8575 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Orange);
8576 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathGeneration_Cancelled") ?? "Cancelled";
8577 });
8578
8579 SaveCurrentSession();
8580
8581 return false;
8582 }
8583 catch (Exception ex)
8584 {
8585 string errorMessage = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_PathPlanningFailed") ?? "Path planning failed";
8586
8587 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8588 {
8589 MessageBox.Show(
8590 $"{errorMessage}: {ex.Message}",
8591 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "HirEV SmartFitSystems - Internal Error",
8592 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8593 MessageBoxImage.Error);
8594
8595 EyeshotStatus_Text = errorMessage;
8596
8597 // Reset progress bar on error
8598 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Red);
8599 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8600 Machine_Status_ProgressText = "Error";
8601 });
8602
8603 return false;
8604 }
8605 finally
8606 {
8607 // SUCCESS: Always reset state, even if cancelled or error
8608 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => Mouse.OverrideCursor = null);
8609
8610 // Reset button text back to "Generate Paths"
8611 if (measuring_sp != null)
8612 {
8613 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => measuring_sp.IsPathGenerationRunning = false);
8614 }
8615
8616 // Ensure all paths are visible after (re)generation
8617 ShowAllPaths = true;
8618
8619 // Dispose cancellation token source
8620 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
8621 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource = null;
8622 }
8623 return true;
8624 }

8635 public async void StartPathSimulation()
8636 {
8637 if (_isModelLoading) return;
8638 try
8639 {
8640 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any())
8641 {
8642 MessageBox.Show(
8643 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_NoPathsGenerated") ?? "Please generate paths first.",
8644 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationErrorTitle") ?? "Simulation Error",
8645 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8646 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
8647 return;
8648 }
8649
8650 CMMType selectedCmmType = GetSelectedCmmType();
8651 _pathManager.SetCmmType(selectedCmmType);
8652
8653 if (_pathManager.HasTrajectoryTypeMismatch(out _, out _))
8654 {
8655 MessageBox.Show(
8656 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "TrajectoryMismatchSimulationMessage")?.Replace("\\n", "\n") ?? PathManager.TrajectoryMismatchSimulationMessage,
8657 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "TrajectoryMismatchSimulationTitle") ?? "CMM Type Mismatch",
8658 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8659 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
8660 return;
8661 }
8662
8663 // Identify if a model needs to be loaded
8664 string modelToLoad = "";
8665 bool isScanner = false;
8666 if (selectedCmmType == CMMType.Scanner)
8667 {
8668 _pathManager.EnsureCurrentScannerConfiguration();
8669 var props = _pathManager.CurrentScannerProps;
8670 if (props != null)
8671 {
8672 modelToLoad = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(props.ModelFile) ? props.ModelFile : _pathManager.CurrentScannerName;
8673 isScanner = true;
8674 }
8675 }
8676 else
8677 {
8678 var firstPath = _pathManager.ColorPaths[_pathManager.ExecutionOrder[0]];
8679 if (firstPath.Points.Any() && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(firstPath.ToolName))
8680 {
8681 modelToLoad = firstPath.ToolName;
8682 isScanner = false;
8683 }
8684 }
8685
8686 // If a model needs to be loaded and is not already cached, load it on a background task
8687 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(modelToLoad) && !ToolModelLoader.IsModelCached(modelToLoad))
8688 {
8689 _isModelLoading = true;
8690
8691 // Update UI state to starting / loading
8692 string startingSimText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StartingSimulation") ?? "Starting Simulation...";
8693 string loadingModelText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "LoadingModel") ?? "Loading Model";
8694
8695 if (measuring_sp != null)
8696 {
8697 measuring_sp.SimulatePathButton_Text = startingSimText;
8698 }
8699
8700 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
8701 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8702 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{loadingModelText} (0%)";
8703
8704 try
8705 {
8706 await ToolModelLoader.LoadModelIntoCacheAsync(modelToLoad, isScanner, (percent) =>
8707 {
8708 System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8709 {
8710 Machine_Status_Progress = percent;
8711 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{loadingModelText} ({percent:F0}%)";
8712 });
8713 });
8714 }
8715 catch (Exception ex)
8716 {
8717 System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Background model loading error: {ex.Message}");
8718 }
8719 finally
8720 {
8721 _isModelLoading = false;
8722 }
8723 }
8724
8725 // Set progress bar to gray for simulation
8726 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
8727
8728 _pathManager.StartSimulation();
8729 SimulationSpeedPanelVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
8730 IsSimulationSeekEnabled = true;
8731 IsSimulationActive = true;
8732 PauseSimulationVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
8733 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationStarted") ?? "Simulation started...";
8734 }
8735 catch (Exception ex)
8736 {
8737 string errorMessage = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_ErrorStartingSimulation") ?? "Error starting simulation";
8738 MessageBox.Show(
8739 $"{errorMessage}: {ex.Message}",
8740 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Error",
8741 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8742 MessageBoxImage.Error);
8743
8744 // Set error state
8745 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Red);
8746 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8747 string errorText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_Error") ?? "Simulation Error";
8748 Machine_Status_ProgressText = errorText;
8749 }
8750 }

8758 private System.Drawing.Color NormalizeColorLightness(System.Drawing.Color color, double targetLightness)
8759 {
8760 // Convert RGB to HSL
8761 double r = color.R / 255.0;
8762 double g = color.G / 255.0;
8763 double b = color.B / 255.0;
8764
8765 double max = Math.Max(r, Math.Max(g, b));
8766 double min = Math.Min(r, Math.Min(g, b));
8767 double delta = max - min;
8768
8769 // Calculate Hue
8770 double hue = 0.0;
8771 if (delta != 0)
8772 {
8773 if (max == r)
8774 hue = 60 * (((g - b) / delta) % 6);
8775 else if (max == g)
8776 hue = 60 * (((b - r) / delta) + 2);
8777 else
8778 hue = 60 * (((r - g) / delta) + 4);
8779 }
8780 if (hue < 0) hue += 360;
8781
8782 // Calculate Lightness
8783 double lightness = (max + min) / 2.0;
8784
8785 // Calculate Saturation
8786 double saturation = 0.0;
8787 if (delta != 0)
8788 saturation = delta / (1 - Math.Abs(2 * lightness - 1));
8789
8790 // Set new lightness
8791 lightness = targetLightness;
8792
8793 // Convert HSL back to RGB
8794 double c = (1 - Math.Abs(2 * lightness - 1)) * saturation;
8795 double x = c * (1 - Math.Abs((hue / 60.0) % 2 - 1));
8796 double m = lightness - c / 2.0;
8797
8798 double rPrime = 0, gPrime = 0, bPrime = 0;
8799 if (hue < 60) { rPrime = c; gPrime = x; bPrime = 0; }
8800 else if (hue < 120) { rPrime = x; gPrime = c; bPrime = 0; }
8801 else if (hue < 180) { rPrime = 0; gPrime = c; bPrime = x; }
8802 else if (hue < 240) { rPrime = 0; gPrime = x; bPrime = c; }
8803 else if (hue < 300) { rPrime = x; gPrime = 0; bPrime = c; }
8804 else { rPrime = c; gPrime = 0; bPrime = x; }
8805
8806 byte newR = (byte)((rPrime + m) * 255);
8807 byte newG = (byte)((gPrime + m) * 255);
8808 byte newB = (byte)((bPrime + m) * 255);
8809
8810 return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(newR, newG, newB);
8811 }

8920 public void SetCustomExecutionOrder(List<string> colorNames)
8921 {
8922 List<Color> colors = new List<Color>();
8923
8924 foreach (string colorName in colorNames)
8925 {
8926 try
8927 {
8928 // Parse the RGB values from the format "Name (R95_G0_B0)" using regex
8929 var colorMatch = Regex.Match(colorName, @"R(\d{1,3})_G(\d{1,3})_B(\d{1,3})");
8930 if (colorMatch.Success)
8931 {
8932 byte r = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[1].Value);
8933 byte g = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[2].Value);
8934 byte b = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[3].Value);
8935
8936 Color color = Color.FromArgb(255, r, g, b);
8937 colors.Add(color);
8938 }
8939 }
8940 catch
8941 {
8942 // Ignore invalid color names
8943 }
8944 }
8945
8946 SetCustomExecutionOrder(colors);
8947 }

9037 private void OnSimulationStopped(object sender, SimulationEventArgs e)
9038 {
9039 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationCompleted") ?? "Simulation completed.";
9040
9041 // Reset progress bar to gray when simulation stops
9042 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
9043 Machine_Status_Progress = e.ProgressPercent >= 99.999 ? 100 : 0;
9044 IsSimulationActive = false;
9045 IsSimulationSeekEnabled = false;
9046 PauseSimulationVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
9047 SimulationSpeedPanelVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
9048
9049 string idleText = e.ProgressPercent >= 99.999
9050 ? (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationCompleted") ?? "Simulation completed.")
9051 : (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle");
9052 Machine_Status_ProgressText = idleText;
9053
9054 // Notify context menu visibility changes
9055 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowFollowProbeMenuItem));
9056 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowStopFollowingMenuItem));
9057

9276 private static double DistancePointToLine(Point3D p, Point3D lineOrigin, Vector3D lineDir)
9277 {
9278 Vector3D v = new Vector3D(lineOrigin, p);
9279 Vector3D cross = EyeshotGeometryUtils.CrossProduct(v, lineDir);
9280 double dirLen = Math.Sqrt(lineDir.X * lineDir.X + lineDir.Y * lineDir.Y + lineDir.Z * lineDir.Z);
9281 if (dirLen < 1e-9) return p.DistanceTo(lineOrigin);
9282 return Math.Sqrt(cross.X * cross.X + cross.Y * cross.Y + cross.Z * cross.Z) / dirLen;
9283 }

9290 private string GetLocalizedFormattedString(string key, params object[] args)
9291 {
9292 string rawValue = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, key)!;
9293 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rawValue) && args != null && args.Length > 0)
9294 {
9295 try
9296 {
9297 return string.Format(rawValue, args);
9298 }
9299 catch (FormatException)
9300 {
9301 // Fallback in case of formatting error, e.g., key found but args mismatch
9302 return $"{rawValue} (Format Error)";
9303 }
9304 }
9305 return rawValue; // Return raw value if no args or key not found
9306 }

9322 public static string? GetXMLElementValue(XmlDocument doc, string key)
9323 {
9324 // Check if the document is null
9325 if (doc.DocumentElement == null)
9326 {
9327 return null; // or handle the error appropriately
9328 }
9329
9330 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key))
9331 {
9332 return null;
9333 }
9334
9335 try
9336 {
9337 // Use XPath to find the element with the specified key
9338 XmlNode? node = doc.SelectSingleNode($"//{key}");
9339 return node?.Attributes?["Value"]?.Value; // Return the value or an empty string if not found
9340 }
9341 catch (System.Xml.XPath.XPathException)
9342 {
9343 // Invalid key for XPath (e.g. status text containing spaces/special chars)
9344 return null;
9345 }
9346 }

9348 // Method to convert a SecureString to a plain string
9354 private string? SecureStringToString(SecureString secureString)
9355 {
9356 IntPtr unmanagedString = IntPtr.Zero;
9357
9358 try
9359 {
9360 unmanagedString = Marshal.SecureStringToGlobalAllocUnicode(secureString);
9361 return Marshal.PtrToStringUni(unmanagedString);
9362 }
9363 finally
9364 {
9365 Marshal.ZeroFreeGlobalAllocUnicode(unmanagedString);
9366 }
9367 }
9368
9369 // Method to convert a plain string to a SecureString
9375 private SecureString ConvertToSecureString(string plainString)
9376 {
9377 SecureString secureString = new SecureString();
9378
9379 foreach (char c in plainString)
9380 {
9381 secureString.AppendChar(c);
9382 }
9383
9384 secureString.MakeReadOnly();
9385 return secureString;
9386 }

9393 private void PerformManualPicking(System.Drawing.Point mousePos, Entity entity)
9394 {
9395 try
9396 {
9397 Point3D cameraTarget = _designControl.Camera.Target;
9398 Point3D cameraEye = _designControl.Camera.Location;
9399 Vector3D cameraDirection = new Vector3D(
9400 cameraTarget.X - cameraEye.X,
9401 cameraTarget.Y - cameraEye.Y,
9402 cameraTarget.Z - cameraEye.Z);
9403
9404 EyeshotGeometryUtils.NormalizeVector(ref cameraDirection);
9405
9406 Point3D intersectionPoint = Point3D.Origin;
9407 bool foundIntersection = false;
9408
9409 if (entity is Mesh mesh)
9410 {
9411 foundIntersection = EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithMesh(mesh, cameraEye, cameraDirection, out intersectionPoint);
9412 }
9413 else if (entity is Brep brep)
9414 {
9415 foundIntersection = EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithBrep(brep, cameraEye, cameraDirection, out intersectionPoint);
9416 }
9417
9418 if (foundIntersection && (intersectionPoint != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(intersectionPoint))
9419 {
9420 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {intersectionPoint.X:F3}, Y: {intersectionPoint.Y:F3}, Z: {intersectionPoint.Z:F3}";
9421 }
9422 }
9423 catch (Exception ex)
9424 {
9425 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualPickingError")!, ex.Message);
9426 }
9427 }

9432 private bool IsModelEntity(Entity ent)
9433 {
9434 if (ent == null) return false;
9435
9436 // 1. Check for system EntityData identifiers
9437 if (ent.EntityData is string data)
9438 {
9439 if (data == "PART_ORIGIN" ||
9440 data == "SECTION_VISUAL" ||
9441 data == "IgnoredOverlay_Ref")
9442 return false;
9443 }
9444 else if (ent.EntityData != null)
9445 {
9446 // If it's an object (like CADHole or CADFace), it's a system marker
9447 return false;
9448 }
9449
9450 // 2. Check for system layers (PathManager and SdfShellGenerator use these)
9451 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ent.LayerName))
9452 {
9453 string layer = ent.LayerName.ToUpper();
9454 if (layer.StartsWith("PATH_") ||
9455 layer.StartsWith("PROBE_") ||
9456 layer.StartsWith("SCANNER_") ||
9457 layer.StartsWith("COLLISION_") ||
9458 layer.StartsWith("RAYCAST_") ||
9459 layer.StartsWith("SHELL_")) // Skip SDF shells
9460 return false;
9461 }
9462
9463 // 3. Only process 3D geometric entities that can reasonably contain faces
9464 return ent is Mesh || ent is Brep || ent is Solid || ent is BlockReference;
9465 }
