9538 private void HandleDesignControlSelectionChanged(object parameter)
9539 {
9540 if (!(_designControl.IsLoaded) || isUpdatingSelection || !(parameter is devDept.Eyeshot.Control.SelectionChangedEventArgs e)) return;
9541
9542 if (_waitingForSectionPartSelection)
9543 {
9544 var candidates = GetSectionCandidateParts();
9545 var selectedPart = candidates.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.Selected);
9546
9547 // Fallback if the raw entity was not flagged as selected yet, extract from AddedItems wrapper
9548 if (selectedPart == null && e.AddedItems != null && e.AddedItems.Count > 0)
9549 {
9550 var first = e.AddedItems[0];
9551 if (first != null)
9552 {
9553 var firstType = first.GetType();
9554
9555 Entity? rawEnt = (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
9556 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
9557 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) is object inner ?
9558 (inner.GetType().GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity ?? inner.GetType().GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity) : null);
9559
9560 // Eyeshot Selection sometimes directly gives Entity
9561 var firstObj = first as object;
9562 if (rawEnt == null && firstObj is Entity eEnt)
9563 rawEnt = eEnt;
9564
9565 if (rawEnt != null && candidates.Contains(rawEnt))
9566 {
9567 selectedPart = rawEnt;
9568 // Do not force rawEnt.Selected = true to preserve face/vertex selection
9569 }
9570 }
9571 }
9572
9573 if (selectedPart != null)
9574 {
9575 _waitingForSectionPartSelection = false;
9576 SectionViewOverlayVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
9577 UpdateSectionPlaneMaxAndPos();
9578 SectionPlanePosition = SectionPlaneMaxPosition;
9579 UpdateSectionPlane();
9580
9581 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0 && _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars.Count > 0)
9582 {
9583 var btn = _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars[0].Buttons.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "SectionViewMain") as ToolBarButton;
9584 if (btn != null) btn.Pushed = true;
9585 }
9586 }
9587 return;
9588 }
9589
9590 // Check if selection change only involves path entities (waypoints, segments, dragging spheres)
9591 bool onlyPathEntities = true;
9592 if (e != null)
9593 {
9594 if (e.AddedItems != null && e.AddedItems.Count > 0)
9595 {
9596 foreach (var item in e.AddedItems)
9597 {
9598 var ent = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(item);
9599 if (ent == null || !(ent.EntityData is WaypointData || ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData || ent == _draggingSphere || (ent is LinearPath && ent.LayerName != null && ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))))
9600 {
9601 onlyPathEntities = false;
9602 break;
9603 }
9604 }
9605 }
9606 if (onlyPathEntities && e.RemovedItems != null && e.RemovedItems.Count > 0)
9607 {
9608 foreach (var item in e.RemovedItems)
9609 {
9610 var ent = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(item);
9611 if (ent == null || !(ent.EntityData is WaypointData || ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData || ent == _draggingSphere || (ent is LinearPath && ent.LayerName != null && ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))))
9612 {
9613 onlyPathEntities = false;
9614 break;
9615 }
9616 }
9617 }
9618 if (e.AddedItems?.Count == 0 && e.RemovedItems?.Count == 0)
9619 {
9620 onlyPathEntities = true;
9621 }
9622 }
9623 else
9624 {
9625 onlyPathEntities = false;
9626 }
9627
9628 if (onlyPathEntities)
9629 {
9630 return;
9631 }
9632
9633 try
9634 {
9635 isUpdatingSelection = true;
9636 _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
9637 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers(); // Clear ALL markers when selection changes
9638
9639 if (e?.AddedItems == null || e.AddedItems.Count == 0) return;
9640
9641 // Complex Eyeshot selection details extraction (kept largely as-is due to Eyeshot's API)
9642 var first = e.AddedItems[0];
9643 if (first == null) return;
9644
9645 var firstType = first.GetType();
9646 string firstTypeName = firstType.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
9647
9648 Entity? selEntity = (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
9649 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
9650 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) is object inner ?
9651 (inner.GetType().GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity ?? inner.GetType().GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity) : null);
9652
9653 int subIndex = (int?)(firstType.GetProperty("Index")?.GetValue(first)
9654 ?? firstType.GetProperty("FaceIndex")?.GetValue(first)
9655 ?? firstType.GetProperty("VertexIndex")?.GetValue(first)
9656 ?? firstType.GetProperty("SubIndex")?.GetValue(first)) ?? -1;
9657
9658 if (selEntity == null) return;
9659
9660 int entityIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(selEntity);
9661 if (entityIndex < 0) return;
9662
9663 // Flatten all faces for easy lookup
9664 // FIX: Changed from _facesByColor to _allFacesByColor to include hole faces in selection lookup.
9665 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(l => l).ToList();
9666 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = null;
9667
9668 if (firstTypeName.Contains("face") || firstTypeName.Contains("selectedface"))
9669 {
9670 var match = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex && f.FaceIndex == subIndex);
9671 if (match != null)
9672 {
9673 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(match);
9674 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(match);
9675 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(match);
9676 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = match;
9677
9678 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(match);
9679 if (parentHole != null)
9680 {
9681 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
9682 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole); // Also select the hole in the tree
9683 }
9684 }
9685 else
9686 {
9687 var fallback = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
9688 if (fallback != null)
9689 {
9690 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(fallback);
9691 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(fallback);
9692 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(fallback);
9693 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = fallback;
9694
9695 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(fallback);
9696 if (parentHole != null)
9697 {
9698 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
9699 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
9700 }
9701 }
9702 }
9703 }
9704 else if (firstTypeName.Contains("vertex") || firstTypeName.Contains("selectedvertex"))
9705 {
9706 if (subIndex >= 0)
9707 {
9708 var facesWithVertex = allFaces.Where(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex && f.KeyPoints.Any(k => k.VertexIndex == subIndex)).ToList();
9709 if (facesWithVertex.Count > 0)
9710 {
9711 var face = facesWithVertex.First();
9712 _treeViewHelper.SelectVertexInTree(face, subIndex);
9713 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(face, highlightVertexIndex: subIndex);
9714 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(face);
9715 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = face;
9716
9717 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(face);
9718 if (parentHole != null)
9719 {
9720 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
9721 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
9722 }
9723 }
9724 else
9725 {
9726 var fallback = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
9727 if (fallback != null)
9728 {
9729 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(fallback);
9730 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(fallback);
9731 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(fallback);
9732 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = fallback;
9733
9734 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(fallback);
9735 if (parentHole != null)
9736 {
9737 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
9738 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
9739 }
9740 }
9741 }
9742 }
9743 }
9744 else // Generic entity selection fallback
9745 {
9746 var firstFaceOfEntity = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
9747 if (firstFaceOfEntity != null)
9748 {
9749 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(firstFaceOfEntity);
9750 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
9751 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
9752 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = firstFaceOfEntity;
9753
9754 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
9755 if (parentHole != null)
9756 {
9757 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
9758 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
9759 }
9760 }
9761 }
9762 }
9763 catch (Exception ex)
9764 {
9765 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_SelectionSyncError")!, ex.Message);
9766 }
9767 finally
9768 {
9769 isUpdatingSelection = false;
9770 _designControl.Invalidate();
9771 }
9772 }

9779 private Entity? GetEntityFromSelectionItem(object item)
9780 {
9781 if (item == null) return null;
9782 if (item is Entity ent) return ent;
9783 var type = item.GetType();
9784 Entity? rawEnt = (type.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(item) as Entity)
9785 ?? (type.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(item) as Entity);
9786 if (rawEnt == null)
9787 {
9788 var itemProp = type.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(item);
9789 if (itemProp != null)
9790 {
9791 rawEnt = itemProp.GetType().GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(itemProp) as Entity
9792 ?? itemProp.GetType().GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(itemProp) as Entity;
9793 }
9794 }
9795 return rawEnt;
9796 }

9804 private void HandleDesignControlMouseDown(object parameter)
9805 {
9806 if (parameter is not System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e) return;
9807
9808 if (_activeContextMenu != null || _justClosedContextMenu)
9809 {
9810 if (_activeContextMenu != null)
9811 {
9812 _activeContextMenu.IsOpen = false;
9813 _activeContextMenu = null;
9814 }
9815 _justClosedContextMenu = false;
9816 e.Handled = true;
9817 return;
9818 }
9819
9820 var screenPoint = new System.Drawing.Point((int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).X, (int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).Y);
9821
9822 // --- Right-Click Handling for Context Menus ---
9823 if (e.RightButton == System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonState.Pressed)
9824 {
9825 // Identify the part right-clicked
9826 _lastRightClickedPart = null;

10362 private void HandleDesignControlMouseMove(object parameter)
10363 {
10364 if (!(parameter is MouseEventArgs e)) return;
10365
10366 try
10367 {
10368 CurrentPointCoords = string.Empty;
10369
10370 System.Drawing.Point mousePos = new System.Drawing.Point((int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).X, (int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).Y);
10371 Point3D worldPos = _designControl.ScreenToWorld(mousePos);
10372
10373 if (_isCustomDragging && _manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData wpData && worldPos != null)
10374 {
10375 // Project the point onto the face surface
10376 Point3D? snappedPt = null;
10377 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
10378 {
10379 if (_draggingFaceMesh != null)
10380 {
10381 Point3D rayStart;
10382 Vector3D rayDir;
10383 if (_designControl.Camera.ProjectionMode == devDept.Eyeshot.projectionType.Perspective)
10384 {
10385 rayStart = _designControl.Camera.Location;
10386 rayDir = new Vector3D(rayStart, worldPos);
10387 rayDir.Normalize();
10388 }
10389 else
10390 {
10391 rayDir = new Vector3D(
10392 _designControl.Camera.Target.X - _designControl.Camera.Location.X,
10393 _designControl.Camera.Target.Y - _designControl.Camera.Location.Y,
10394 _designControl.Camera.Target.Z - _designControl.Camera.Location.Z);
10395 rayDir.Normalize();
10396 rayStart = worldPos - rayDir * 100000.0;
10397 }
10398 Point3D intersectPt;
10399 if (EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithMesh(_draggingFaceMesh, rayStart, rayDir, out intersectPt))
10400 {
10401 snappedPt = intersectPt;
10402 }
10403 else
10404 {
10405 snappedPt = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToMesh(worldPos, _draggingFaceMesh);
10406 }
10407 }
10408 else
10409 {
10410 snappedPt = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(worldPos, _draggingMeasurePointBrep, _draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex);
10411 }
10412 }
10413 else
10414 {
10415 // Fallback to snapping to closest part surface
10416 Entity? targetPart;
10417 Vector3D newNormal;
10418 snappedPt = SnapToClosestPartSurface(worldPos, out newNormal, out targetPart);
10419 }
10420
10421 if (_draggingSphere != null && _draggingSpherePosition != null && snappedPt != null)
10422 {
10423 Vector3D sphereTrans = new Vector3D(_draggingSpherePosition, snappedPt);
10424 _draggingSphere.Translate(sphereTrans);
10425 _draggingSpherePosition = (Point3D)snappedPt.Clone();
10426
10427 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex] = snappedPt;
10428 if (wpData.Path.PathEntity != null)
10429 {
10430 wpData.Path.PathEntity.Vertices = wpData.Path.Points.ToArray();
10431 wpData.Path.PathEntity.Regen(0.1);
10432 }
10433 _pathManager?.UpdatePathSegmentVertices(wpData.Path);
10434 }
10435
10436 _designControl.Invalidate();
10437 }
10438 else if (_designControl != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible && _manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData dragWp && !_isCustomDragging)
10439 {
10440 var trans = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Transformation;
10441 if (trans == null)
10442 {
10443 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
10444 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
10445 _designControl.Invalidate();
10446 _manipulatingEntity = null;
10447 return;
10448 }
10449 if (trans != null && _initialTriadTrans != null)
10450 {
10451 Point3D currentPt = (Point3D)dragWp.OriginalPosition.Clone();
10452 currentPt.TransformBy(trans);
10453
10454 // If it's an approach point, project/constrain it along the normal of the associated measure point
10455 bool isApproach = false;
10456 int mIdx = -1;
10457 if (dragWp.Path.IsMeasure != null)
10458 {
10459 if (dragWp.PointIndex + 1 < dragWp.Path.Points.Count && dragWp.Path.IsMeasure[dragWp.PointIndex + 1])
10460 {
10461 isApproach = true;
10462 mIdx = dragWp.PointIndex + 1;
10463 }
10464 else if (dragWp.PointIndex > 0 && dragWp.Path.IsMeasure[dragWp.PointIndex - 1])
10465 {
10466 isApproach = true;
10467 mIdx = dragWp.PointIndex - 1;
10468 }
10469 }
10470
10471 if (isApproach && mIdx != -1)
10472 {
10473 Point3D measurePt = dragWp.Path.Points[mIdx];
10474 Vector3D normal = dragWp.Path.Normals[mIdx];
10475 if (normal.LengthSquared < 1e-6) normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
10476 normal.Normalize();
10477
10478 double t = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(measurePt, currentPt), normal);
10479 t = Math.Max(0.0, t); // Cannot go below the surface (inside the part)
10480 currentPt = measurePt + normal * t;
10481 }
10482
10483 dragWp.Path.Points[dragWp.PointIndex] = currentPt;
10484
10485 if (dragWp.Path.PathEntity != null)
10486 {
10487 dragWp.Path.PathEntity.Vertices = dragWp.Path.Points.ToArray();
10488 dragWp.Path.PathEntity.Regen(0.1);
10489 }
10490
10491 // Update visible segment line entities to follow the moving point
10492 _pathManager?.UpdatePathSegmentVertices(dragWp.Path);
10493
10494 _designControl.Invalidate();
10495 }
10496 }
10497
10498 int entityIndex = _designControl!.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(mousePos);
10499
10500 if (entityIndex >= 0 && entityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
10501 {
10502 if ((worldPos != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(worldPos))
10503 {
10504 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {worldPos.X:F3}, Y: {worldPos.Y:F3}, Z: {worldPos.Z:F3}";
10505 }
10506 else
10507 {
10508 PerformManualPicking(mousePos, _designControl.Entities[entityIndex]);
10509 }
10510 }
10511 else
10512 {
10513 if ((worldPos != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(worldPos))
10514 {
10515 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {worldPos.X:F3}, Y: {worldPos.Y:F3}, Z: {worldPos.Z:F3}";
10516 }
10517 }
10518 }
10519 catch { /* Suppressing common mouse move errors for smoother experience */ }
10520 }

10530 private void HandleTreeViewSelectedItemChanged(object? selectedItem)
10531 {
10532 if (isUpdatingSelection || selectedItem == null) return;
10533
10534 try
10535 {
10536 isUpdatingSelection = true;
10537 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
10538
10539 _designControl.SelectionFilterMode = selectionFilterType.Face | selectionFilterType.Vertex;
10540 _designControl.ActionMode = actionType.SelectVisibleByPickDynamic;
10541
10542 // Caso: nó de cor ou grupo (sem Tag)
10543 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem tvi && tvi.Tag == null)
10544 {
10545 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
10546 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
10547 _designControl.Invalidate();
10548 return;
10549 }
10550
10551 // Caso: Face selecionada
10552 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem faceTvi && faceTvi.Tag is CADFace cadFace)
10553 {
10554 if (cadFace.EntityIndex < 0 || cadFace.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
10555 {
10556 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_InvalidEntityIndexFace");
10557 return;
10558 }
10559 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
10560 var entObj = _designControl.Entities[cadFace.EntityIndex];
10561 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(cadFace);
10562 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(cadFace);
10563 _visualsManager.HighlightFaceVisualFallback(entObj as Brep, cadFace.FaceIndex);
10564 _designControl.Invalidate();
10565 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_FaceHighlightApplied");
10566 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = cadFace;
10567
10568 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(cadFace);
10569 if (parentHole != null)
10570 {
10571 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
10572 }
10573 return;
10574 }
10575
10576 // Caso: Vértice selecionado
10577 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem vertexTvi && vertexTvi.Tag is FacePoint fp && fp.VertexIndex >= 0)
10578 {
10579 CADFace? parentFace = FindParentFaceForVertex(vertexTvi);
10580 if (parentFace == null)
10581 {
10582 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_VertexNodeMissingParent");
10583 return;
10584 }
10585 if (parentFace.EntityIndex < 0 || parentFace.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
10586 {
10587 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_InvalidEntityIndexVertex");
10588 return;
10589 }
10590 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
10591 var entObj = _designControl.Entities[parentFace.EntityIndex];
10592 if (entObj is Brep brepForVertex)
10593 {
10594 try
10595 {
10596 var t = brepForVertex.GetType();
10597 var setVertex = t.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int), typeof(bool) })
10598 ?? t.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int) });
10599
10600 if (setVertex != null)
10601 {
10602 try
10603 {
10604 setVertex.Invoke(brepForVertex, new object[] { fp.VertexIndex, true });
10605 }
10606 catch
10607 {
10608 setVertex.Invoke(brepForVertex, new object[] { fp.VertexIndex });
10609 }
10610 }
10611 }
10612 catch { /* ignore */ }
10613 }
10614 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(parentFace, highlightVertexIndex: fp.VertexIndex);
10615 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(parentFace);
10616 _selectionUtils.TryRefreshDesignControlSelection();
10617 _designControl.Invalidate();
10618 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = parentFace;
10619
10620 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(parentFace);
10621 if (parentHole != null)
10622 {
10623 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
10624 }
10625 return;
10626 }
10627
10628 // Caso: Ponto de controle selecionado
10629 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem cpTvi && cpTvi.Tag is Point4D controlPoint)
10630 {
10631 _visualsManager.ShowTemporaryControlPointSphere(controlPoint);
10632 _designControl.Invalidate();
10633 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingControlPoint")!, controlPoint.X, controlPoint.Y, controlPoint.Z);
10634 return;
10635 }
10636
10637 // Caso: Furo selecionado
10638 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem holeTvi && holeTvi.Tag is CADHole cadHole)
10639 {
10640 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
10641 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(cadHole);
10642 _designControl.Invalidate();
10643 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingHole")!, cadHole.HoleId);
10644 return;
10645 }
10646
10647 // Default: limpa seleção
10648 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
10649 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
10650 _designControl.Invalidate();
10651 }
10652 catch (Exception ex)
10653 {
10654 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_TreeViewSelectionError")!, ex.Message);
10655 }
10656 finally
10657 {
10658 isUpdatingSelection = false;
10659 }
10660 }

10852 private bool showOriginGrids = true;

10855 public ICommand ToggleOriginGridsCommand => toggleOriginGridsCommand ??= new DelegateCommand(() =>
10856 {
10857 showOriginGrids = !showOriginGrids;
10858 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(OriginGridVisibilityMenuText));
10859 if (_designControl != null && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
10860 {
10861 if (showOriginGrids)
10862 {
10863 // Remove existing grids (except main grid)
10864 while (_designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Count > 1)
10865 {
10866 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.RemoveAt(1);
10867 }
10868
10869 // Remove existing PART_ORIGIN entities
10870 var oldOrigins = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.EntityData as string != null && (e.EntityData as string)!.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN")).ToList();
10871 foreach (var o in oldOrigins)
10872 {
10873 _designControl.Entities.Remove(o);
10874 }
10875
10876 // Re-add for each file path
10877 var cadEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e is Brep || e is Mesh).ToList();
10878 var groupedByPath = cadEntities.GroupBy(e => e.EntityData as string ?? "");
10879
10880 foreach (var group in groupedByPath)
10881 {
10882 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.Key))
10883 AddPartOrigins(group);
10884 else
10885 AddPartOrigins(group, group.Key);
10886 }
10887 }
10888 else
10889 {
10890 // Skip the first grid which is the main scene grid
10891 for (int i = 1; i < _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Count; i++)
10892 {
10893 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[i].Visible = false;
10894 }
10895
10896 var partOrigins = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.EntityData as string != null && (e.EntityData as string)!.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN"));
10897 foreach (var origin in partOrigins)
10898 {
10899 origin.Visible = false;
10900 }
10901 }
10902
10903 _designControl.Invalidate();
10904 }
10905 });

10914 private void AddPartOrigins(IEnumerable<Entity>? specificEntities = null, string? sourcePath = null)
10915 {
10916 if (_designControl == null) return;
10917
10918 IEnumerable<Entity> entitiesToProcess;
10919 if (specificEntities != null)
10920 {
10921 entitiesToProcess = specificEntities.Where(e => e is Brep || e is Mesh);
10922 }
10923 else
10924 {
10925 entitiesToProcess = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e is Brep || e is Mesh);
10926 }
10927
10928 if (!entitiesToProcess.Any()) return;
10929
10930 Point3D min = new Point3D(double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue);
10931 Point3D max = new Point3D(double.MinValue, double.MinValue, double.MinValue);
10932
10933 foreach (var ent in entitiesToProcess)
10934 {
10935 ent.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
10936 if (ent.BoxMin.X < min.X) min.X = ent.BoxMin.X;
10937 if (ent.BoxMin.Y < min.Y) min.Y = ent.BoxMin.Y;
10938 if (ent.BoxMin.Z < min.Z) min.Z = ent.BoxMin.Z;
10939
10940 if (ent.BoxMax.X > max.X) max.X = ent.BoxMax.X;
10941 if (ent.BoxMax.Y > max.Y) max.Y = ent.BoxMax.Y;
10942 if (ent.BoxMax.Z > max.Z) max.Z = ent.BoxMax.Z;
10943 }
10944
10945 string baseBlockName = "OriginSymbol";
10946 if (!_designControl.Blocks.Contains(baseBlockName))
10947 {
10948 var b = new Block(baseBlockName);
10949 var l1 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 20, 0, 0) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Red, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
10950 var l2 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 0, 20, 0) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Green, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
10951 var l3 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Blue, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
10952 b.Entities.Add(l1);
10953 b.Entities.Add(l2);
10954 b.Entities.Add(l3);
10955 _designControl.Blocks.Add(b);
10956 }
10957
10958 var br = new BlockReference(min.X, min.Y, min.Z, baseBlockName, 1);
10959 br.EntityData = string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath) ? "PART_ORIGIN" : $"PART_ORIGIN:{sourcePath}";
10960 _designControl.Entities.Add(br);
10961
10962 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
10963 {
10964 var grid = new devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid();
10965 grid.Plane = new Plane(min, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
10966 grid.Step = 10;
10967 grid.Min = new Point2D(0, 0);
10968
10969 double maxDim = Math.Max(Math.Max(50, max.X - min.X), Math.Max(50, max.Y - min.Y));
10970 maxDim = Math.Ceiling(maxDim / 10.0) * 10.0;
10971 grid.Max = new Point2D(maxDim, maxDim);
10972
10973 grid.Lighting = false;
10974 grid.Visible = showOriginGrids;
10975 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(grid);
10976 }
10977 }

10984 private bool IsSectionCandidateEntity(Entity ent)
10985 {
10986 if (ent is not Brep && ent is not Mesh) return false;
10987
10988 if (_manualMarkingSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
10989 _measurementPointSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
10990 _allControlPointSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
10991 _visualsManager.ControlPointSpheres.Contains(ent))
10992 {
10993 return false;
10994 }
10995
10996 if (ent.EntityData is string entityData)
10997 {
10998 if (entityData == "PART_ORIGIN" ||
10999 entityData == "SECTION_VISUAL" ||
11000 entityData == "IgnoredOverlay_Ref")
11001 {
11002 return false;
11003 }
11004 }
11005
11006 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ent.LayerName))
11007 {
11008 if (ent.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
11009 ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
11010 ent.LayerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
11011 ent.LayerName.Equals("SECTION_VISUAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
11012 {
11013 return false;
11014 }
11015 }
11016
11017 return true;

11026 private (CADFace Face, Brep Brep) FindClosestFace(Point3D pt)
11027 {
11028 CADFace? closestFace = null;
11029 Brep? closestBrep = null;
11030 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
11031
11032 if (_allFacesByColor != null)
11033 {
11034 foreach (var face in _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f))
11035 {
11036 if (face.EntityIndex >= 0 && face.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
11037 {
11038 var brep = _designControl.Entities[face.EntityIndex] as Brep;
11039 if (brep != null)
11040 {
11041 Point3D projected = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(pt, brep, face.FaceIndex);
11042 double dist = pt.DistanceTo(projected);
11043 if (dist < minDistance)
11044 {
11045 minDistance = dist;
11046 closestFace = face;
11047 closestBrep = brep;
11048 }
11049 }
11050 }
11051 }
11052 }
11053
11054 if (closestFace == null && _designControl != null && _designControl.Entities != null)
11055 {
11056 for (int entIdx = 0; entIdx < _designControl.Entities.Count; entIdx++)
11057 {
11058 if (_designControl.Entities[entIdx] is Brep brep)
11059 {
11060 for (int faceIdx = 0; faceIdx < brep.Faces.Length; faceIdx++)
11061 {
11062 try
11063 {
11064 Point3D projected = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(pt, brep, faceIdx);
11065 double dist = pt.DistanceTo(projected);
11066 if (dist < minDistance)
11067 {
11068 minDistance = dist;
11069 closestBrep = brep;
11070 closestFace = new CADFace
11071 {
11072 EntityIndex = entIdx,
11073 FaceIndex = faceIdx,
11074 FaceColor = brep.Faces[faceIdx].Color ?? System.Drawing.Color.White
11075 };
11076 }
11077 }
11078 catch { }
11079 }
11080 }
11081 }
11082 }
11083
11084 return (closestFace!, closestBrep!);
11085 }
11086
11094 private Point3D SnapToClosestPartSurface(Point3D point, out Vector3D normal, out Entity? closestPart)
11095 {
11096 closestPart = null;
11097 normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
11098 Point3D bestSnappedPoint = (Point3D)point.Clone();
11099 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
11100
11101 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
11102 foreach (var part in parts)
11103 {
11104 Point3D snappedPt = (Point3D)point.Clone();
11105 Vector3D partNormal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
11106 bool success = false;
11107
11108 try
11109 {
11110 if (part is Brep brep)
11111 {
11112 // Convert BREP to mesh for closest-point search
11113 var brepMesh = brep.ConvertToMesh();
11114 if (brepMesh != null && brepMesh.Triangles != null && brepMesh.Vertices != null)
11115 {
11116 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
11117 int bestTriIdx = -1;
11118 Point3D bestClosest = point;
11119
11120 for (int ti = 0; ti < brepMesh.Triangles.Length; ti++)
11121 {
11122 var tri = brepMesh.Triangles[ti];
11123 var tv1 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
11124 var tv2 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
11125 var tv3 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
11126 var cp = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ClosestPointOnTriangle(point, tv1, tv2, tv3);
11127 double d = point.DistanceTo(cp);
11128 if (d < closestDist)
11129 {
11130 closestDist = d;
11131 bestClosest = cp;
11132 bestTriIdx = ti;
11133 }
11134 }
11135
11136 snappedPt = bestClosest;
11137
11138 // Get face normal using Brep API; fall back to mesh triangle cross product
11139 if (bestTriIdx >= 0)
11140 {
11141 bool gotNormal = false;
11142 for (int fi = 0; fi < brep.Faces.Length; fi++)
11143 {
11144 try
11145 {
11146 var fn = brep.Faces[fi].Normal(snappedPt);
11147 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
11148 {
11149 partNormal = fn;
11150 partNormal.Normalize();
11151 gotNormal = true;
11152 break;
11153 }
11154 }
11155 catch { }
11156 }
11157 if (!gotNormal)
11158 {
11159 var tri = brepMesh.Triangles[bestTriIdx];
11160 var tv1 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
11161 var tv2 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
11162 var tv3 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
11163 var e1 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv2);
11164 var e2 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv3);
11165 partNormal = Vector3D.Cross(e1, e2);
11166 if (partNormal.Length > 1e-6) partNormal.Normalize();
11167 }
11168 }
11169 success = true;
11170 }
11171 }
11172 else if (part is Mesh mesh)
11173 {
11174 if (mesh.Triangles != null && mesh.Vertices != null)
11175 {
11176 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
11177 int bestTriIdx = -1;
11178 Point3D bestClosest = point;
11179
11180 for (int ti = 0; ti < mesh.Triangles.Length; ti++)
11181 {
11182 var tri = mesh.Triangles[ti];
11183 var tv1 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
11184 var tv2 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
11185 var tv3 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
11186 var cp = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ClosestPointOnTriangle(point, tv1, tv2, tv3);
11187 double d = point.DistanceTo(cp);
11188 if (d < closestDist)
11189 {
11190 closestDist = d;
11191 bestClosest = cp;
11192 bestTriIdx = ti;
11193 }
11194 }
11195
11196 snappedPt = bestClosest;
11197
11198 if (bestTriIdx >= 0)
11199 {
11200 var tri = mesh.Triangles[bestTriIdx];
11201 var tv1 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
11202 var tv2 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
11203 var tv3 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
11204 var e1 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv2);
11205 var e2 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv3);
11206 partNormal = Vector3D.Cross(e1, e2);
11207 if (partNormal.Length > 1e-6) partNormal.Normalize();
11208 }
11209 success = true;
11210 }
11211 }
11212 }
11213 catch (Exception ex)
11214 {
11215 Debug.WriteLine($"SnapToClosestPartSurface: skipping part {part?.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
11216 }
11217
11218 if (success)
11219 {
11220 double dist = point.DistanceTo(snappedPt);
11221 if (dist < minDistance)
11222 {
11223 minDistance = dist;
11224 bestSnappedPoint = snappedPt;
11225 normal = partNormal;
11226 closestPart = part;
11227 }
11228 }
11229 }
11230
11231 return bestSnappedPoint;
11232 }

11238 private List<Entity> GetSectionCandidateParts()
11239 {
11240 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null) return new List<Entity>();
11241 return _designControl.Entities.Where(IsSectionCandidateEntity).ToList();
11242 }
11243
11249 private Entity? GetClosestPart(List<Entity> parts)
11250 {
11251 if (parts == null || !parts.Any() || _designControl == null) return null;
11252
11253 var cameraLoc = _designControl.Camera.Location;
11254 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
11255 Entity? closestPart = null;
11256
11257 foreach (var p in parts)
11258 {
11259 p.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
11260 Point3D center = new Point3D(
11261 (p.BoxMin.X + p.BoxMax.X) / 2,
11262 (p.BoxMin.Y + p.BoxMax.Y) / 2,
11263 (p.BoxMin.Z + p.BoxMax.Z) / 2);
11264 double dist = center.DistanceTo(cameraLoc);
11265 if (dist < minDistance)
11266 {
11267 minDistance = dist;
11268 closestPart = p;
11269 }
11270 }
11271 return closestPart;
11272 }
11273
11278 private Entity? GetTargetPartForSection()
11279 {
11280 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
11281 if (!parts.Any()) return null;
11282
11283 // 1. Priority: Currently selected part
11284 var targetPart = parts.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.Selected);
11285
11286 // 2. Fallback: Face the user last clicked
11287 if (targetPart == null && _visualsManager?.CurrentSelectedFace != null &&
11288 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex >= 0 &&
11289 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
11290 {
11291 var faceEntity = _designControl.Entities[_visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex];
11292 if (parts.Contains(faceEntity))
11293 {
11294 targetPart = faceEntity;
11295 }
11296 }
11297
11298 // 3. Fallback: Closest part to camera
11299 return targetPart ?? GetClosestPart(parts);
11300 }

11422 private void UpdateSectionPlane()
11423 {
11424 if (_designControl == null || SectionViewOverlayVisibility != Visibility.Visible) return;
11425
11426 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
11427 if (!parts.Any()) return;
11428 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
11429 if (targetPart == null) return;
11430
11431 targetPart.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
11432
11433 // Hide other parts to isolate section view
11434 foreach (var part in parts)
11435 {
11436 if (part != targetPart)
11437 {
11438 if (!_preSectionVisibility.ContainsKey(part))
11439 {
11440 _preSectionVisibility[part] = part.Visible;
11441 }
11442 part.Visible = false;
11443 }
11444 }
11445
11446 var min = targetPart.BoxMin;
11447 var size = targetPart.BoxSize;
11448
11449 // Hide other origins and grids
11450 var origins = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => (e.EntityData as string) == "PART_ORIGIN").ToList();
11451 foreach (var origin in origins)
11452 {
11453 if (origin is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference br)
11454 {
11455 bool isTargetOrigin = Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.X - min.X) < 1 &&
11456 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.Y - min.Y) < 1 &&
11457 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.Z - min.Z) < 1;
11458 if (!isTargetOrigin)
11459 {
11460 if (!_preSectionVisibility.ContainsKey(origin))
11461 _preSectionVisibility[origin] = origin.Visible;
11462 origin.Visible = false;
11463 }
11464 }
11465 }
11466
11467 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
11468 {
11469 foreach (var grid in _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids)
11470 {
11471 if (grid == _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0]) continue; // Skip main grid
11472
11473 bool isTargetGrid = Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.X - min.X) < 1 &&
11474 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Y - min.Y) < 1 &&
11475 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Z - min.Z) < 1;
11476 if (!isTargetGrid)
11477 {
11478 if (!_preSectionGridVisibility.ContainsKey(grid))
11479 _preSectionGridVisibility[grid] = grid.Visible;
11480 grid.Visible = false;
11481 }
11482 }
11483 }
11484
11485 Plane plane;
11486 Point3D planeOrigin;
11487 double planeWidth, planeHeight;
11488
11489 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
11490 {
11491 case "X":
11492 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X + SectionPlanePosition, min.Y, min.Z);
11493 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisY, Vector3D.AxisZ);
11494 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.X;
11495 planeWidth = size.Y + 20; // 10 padding on each side based on grid
11496 planeHeight = size.Z + 20;
11497 break;
11498 case "Y":
11499 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X, min.Y + SectionPlanePosition, min.Z);
11500 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisZ);
11501 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.Y;
11502 planeWidth = size.X + 20;
11503 planeHeight = size.Z + 20;
11504 break;
11505 case "Z":
11506 default:
11507 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X, min.Y, min.Z + SectionPlanePosition);
11508 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
11509 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.Z;
11510 planeWidth = size.X + 20;
11511 planeHeight = size.Y + 20;
11512 break;
11513 }
11514
11515 if (_designControl.ClippingPlane1 != null)
11516 {
11517 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane = plane;
11518 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Capping = false;
11519 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Active = true;
11520 }
11521
11522 // Optional: Draw a visual boundary for the plane
11523 _designControl.Invalidate();
11524 _ignoredItemManager?.SyncVisibility();
11525
11526 // Auto-update section view window if it's open
11527 if (_activeSectionWindow != null && _activeSectionWindow.IsLoaded)
11528 {
11529 ShowSectionViewWindow();
11530 }
11531 }
11532
11538 private void ObjectManipulator_SectionPlaneDrag(object sender, devDept.Eyeshot.Control.ObjectManipulator.ObjectManipulatorEventArgs e)
11539 {
11540 if (_designControl == null || SectionViewOverlayVisibility != Visibility.Visible || _designControl.ClippingPlane1 == null) return;
11541
11542 // Extract the new translation from the manipulator
11543 var newTrans = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Transformation;
11544
11545 // Extract position based on axis
11546 double newPosition = 0;
11547 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
11548 if (targetPart == null) return;
11549
11550 targetPart.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
11551 var min = targetPart.BoxMin;
11552
11553 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
11554 {
11555 case "X":
11556 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[0, 3] - min.X;
11557 break;
11558 case "Y":
11559 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[1, 3] - min.Y;
11560 break;
11561 case "Z":
11562 default:
11563 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[2, 3] - min.Z;
11564 break;
11565 }
11566
11567 // Set the value via property to trigger UI updates and plane sync
11568 SectionPlanePosition = newPosition;
11569
11570 // Update the clipping plane position
11571 var currentPlane = _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane;
11572 currentPlane.Origin = new Point3D(newTrans.Matrix[0, 3], newTrans.Matrix[1, 3], newTrans.Matrix[2, 3]);
11573 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane = currentPlane;
11574
11575 // Ensure SectionViewWindow updates in real-time if open
11576 if (_activeSectionWindow != null && _activeSectionWindow.IsLoaded)
11577 {
11578 ShowSectionViewWindow();
11579 }
11580
11581 var oldVisual = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.EntityData as string == "SECTION_VISUAL") as devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh;
11582 if (oldVisual != null)
11583 {
11584 _designControl.Entities.Remove(oldVisual);
11585
11586 double pWidth = 0, pHeight = 0;
11587 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
11588 {
11589 case "X": pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.Y + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Z + 20; break;
11590 case "Y": pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.X + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Z + 20; break;
11591 case "Z": default: pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.X + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Y + 20; break;
11592 }
11593 var p1 = currentPlane.Origin;
11594 var p2 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisX * pWidth;
11595 var p3 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisX * pWidth + currentPlane.AxisY * pHeight;
11596 var p4 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisY * pHeight;
11597
11598 devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.LinearPath lp = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.LinearPath(p1, p2, p3, p4, p1);
11599 var visualPlane = lp.ExtrudeAsMesh(currentPlane.AxisZ * 0.2, 0.01, devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh.natureType.Plain);
11600 visualPlane.Translate(currentPlane.AxisZ * -0.1);
11601
11602 visualPlane.EntityData = "SECTION_VISUAL";
11603 visualPlane.LayerName = "SECTION_VISUAL";
11604 visualPlane.Color = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(100, System.Drawing.Color.Red);
11605 visualPlane.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
11606 _designControl.Entities.Add(visualPlane);
11607 }
11608
11609 _designControl.Invalidate();
11610 }
11611
11612 private SectionViewWindow? _activeSectionWindow = null;
11613 private List<LinearDim>? _lastSectionMeasurements = null;
11614 private devDept.Geometry.Plane? _lastSectionPlane = null;
11615
11619 private void ShowSectionViewWindow()
11620 {
11621 try
11622 {
11623 // Calculate section curves
11624 var plane = _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane;
11625 var curves = new List<ICurve>();
11626
11627 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
11628 if (targetPart == null) return;
11629 int targetEntityIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(targetPart);
11630
11631 var cadFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
11632 var cadFacesToProcess = cadFaces.Where(f => f.EntityIndex == targetEntityIndex).ToList();
11633 bool generatedAny = false;
11634
11635 if (cadFacesToProcess.Any())
11636 {
11637 var ent = _designControl.Entities[targetEntityIndex];
11638 if (ent is Brep brep)
11639 {
11640 var clone = (Brep)brep.Clone();
11641 try { clone.Regen(0.1); } catch { }
11642
11643 foreach (var cadFace in cadFacesToProcess)
11644 {
11645 if (cadFace.FaceIndex >= 0 && cadFace.FaceIndex < clone.Faces.Length)
11646 {
11647 var face = clone.Faces[cadFace.FaceIndex];
11648 var mesh = face.ConvertToMesh();
11649 if (mesh != null)
11650 {
11651 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
11652 if (sectionCurves != null && sectionCurves.Length > 0)
11653 {
11654 foreach (var curve in sectionCurves)
11655 {
11656 if (curve is Entity curveEnt)
11657 {
11658 curveEnt.Color = cadFace.FaceColor;
11659 curveEnt.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
11660 curveEnt.LineWeight = 2;
11661 curveEnt.LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
11662
11663 // Store CADHole or CADFace for Context Menu
11664 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null && _faceIndexToHoleMap.TryGetValue(cadFace.FaceGlobalIndex, out var cadHole))
11665 curveEnt.EntityData = cadHole;
11666 else
11667 curveEnt.EntityData = cadFace;
11668
11669 curves.Add(curve);
11670 }
11671 }
11672 generatedAny = true;
11673 }
11674 }
11675 }
11676 }
11677 }
11678 }
11679 else
11680 {
11681 // Fallback: faces not yet extracted
11682 if (targetPart is Brep brep)
11683 {
11684 var clone = (Brep)brep.Clone();
11685 try { clone.Regen(0.1); } catch { }
11686
11687 for (int fIdx = 0; fIdx < clone.Faces.Length; fIdx++)
11688 {
11689 var face = clone.Faces[fIdx];
11690 var mesh = face.ConvertToMesh();
11691 if (mesh == null) continue;
11692
11693 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
11694 if (sectionCurves == null || sectionCurves.Length == 0) continue;
11695
11696 // Use the face's own color, or fall back to the entity color
11697 var faceColor = face.Color ?? targetPart.Color;
11698
11699 foreach (var curve in sectionCurves)
11700 {
11701 if (curve is Entity curveEnt)
11702 {
11703 curveEnt.Color = faceColor;
11704 curveEnt.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
11705 curveEnt.LineWeight = 2;
11706 curveEnt.LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
11707 // No EntityData — faces haven't been extracted yet, so no properties to show
11708 curves.Add(curve);
11709 }
11710 }
11711 generatedAny = true;
11712 }
11713 }
11714 else if (targetPart is Mesh mesh)
11715 {
11716 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
11717 if (sectionCurves != null) { curves.AddRange(sectionCurves); generatedAny = true; }
11718 }
11719 }
11720
11721 if (!generatedAny)
11722 {
11723 MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_EmptySectionViewSlice") ?? "No section curves generated. The plane might not intersect any part.", "Section View", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
11724 return;
11725 }
11726
11727 var existingWindow = _activeSectionWindow;
11728 if (existingWindow != null && existingWindow.IsLoaded)
11729 {
11730 existingWindow.UpdateCurves(curves, plane);
11731 }
11732 else
11733 {
11734 // Check if we have saved measurements for this exact plane
11735 List<LinearDim>? dimsToRestore = null;
11736 if (_lastSectionPlane != null && plane.Equals(_lastSectionPlane))
11737 {
11738 dimsToRestore = _lastSectionMeasurements;
11739 }
11740
11741 // Create and show the new window
11742 _activeSectionWindow = new SectionViewWindow(this, curves, DocLanguage, plane, (dims) =>
11743 {
11744 // Clone dimensions before the window (and its entities) are disposed
11745 _lastSectionMeasurements = dims.Select(d => (LinearDim)d.Clone()).ToList();
11746 _lastSectionPlane = plane;
11747 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(DeactivateSectionView);
11748 }, dimsToRestore);
11749
11750 _activeSectionWindow.Owner = MainParent;
11751 _activeSectionWindow.Show();
11752 _activeSectionWindow.Closed += SectionWindow_Closed;
11753 }
11754 }
11755 catch (Exception ex)
11756 {
11757 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in ShowSectionViewWindow: {ex.Message}");
11758 MessageBox.Show($"Failed to open Section View:\n{ex.Message}\n\n{ex.StackTrace}", "Section View Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
11759 }
11760 }

11770 MainParent.Activate();

11804 private void ManipulateObject(object parameter)
11805 {
11806 try
11807 {
11808 // Identify the main part entity
11809 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
11810 if (partEntity == null) return;
11811
11812 _isPartManipulating = true;
11813 _pathManager?.SavePathSnapshot();
11814
11815 // Keep path visuals out of the manipulator selection. They are moved from
11816 // ColorPath data on accept and redrawn once, which avoids stale bridge copies.
11817 var associatedEntities = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(partEntity);
11818 var entitiesToManipulate = associatedEntities
11819 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
11820 .Distinct()
11821 .ToList();
11822
11823 // Select all associated entities
11824 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
11825 foreach (var ent in entitiesToManipulate)
11826 {
11827 ent.Selected = true;
11828 }
11829
11830 // Calculate manipulator position - Align with Bounding Box min or Part Origin for CNC origin representation
11831 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
11832 Point3D partOrigin = partEntity.BoxMin;
11833
11834 var originEntity = associatedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => IsPartOriginEntityForPart(e, partEntity));
11835 if (originEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference brOrigin)
11836 {
11837 partOrigin = brOrigin.InsertionPoint;
11838 }
11839
11840 // Enable manipulator at partOrigin

11934 private List<Entity> GetPartPathVisualEntities(int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
11935 {

11938 return result;

11941 {

11950 else if (ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData)

11968 private HashSet<Color> GetPathColorsForPart(int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)

11972 return colors;
11973
11974 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
11975 {

11979

11981 {
11982 if (path.PointEntityIndices.Any(idx => idx == partIndex))
11983 colors.Add(kvp.Key);
11984 }
11985 else if (ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, kvp.Key) ||
11986 ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, path.Color))
11987 {
11988 colors.Add(kvp.Key);
11989 }
11990 }
11991
11992 return colors;

12072 private static bool IsNonBridgePathSegmentForPart(ColorPath path, int startIndex, int endIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
12073 {
12074 if (path == null ||
12075 path.Points == null ||
12076 startIndex < 0 ||
12077 endIndex < 0 ||
12078 startIndex >= path.Points.Count ||
12079 endIndex >= path.Points.Count)
12080 {
12081 return false;
12082 }
12083
12084 if (IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, startIndex)) ||
12085 IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, endIndex)))
12086 return false;
12087
12088 bool startPertinent = IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(path, startIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
12089 bool endPertinent = IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(path, endIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
12090 if (!startPertinent && !endPertinent)
12091 return false;
12092
12093 return !IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(path, startIndex, partIndex) &&
12094 !IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(path, endIndex, partIndex);
12095 }
12096
12105 private static bool IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
12106 {
12107 if (path == null ||
12108 path.Points == null ||
12109 pointIndex < 0 ||
12110 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count)
12111 {
12112 return false;
12113 }
12114
12115 if (IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, pointIndex)))
12116 return false;
12117
12118 return IsPathPointPertinentToPart(path, pointIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
12119 }
12120
12129 private static bool IsPathPointPertinentToPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
12130 {
12131 if (path == null ||
12132 path.Points == null ||
12133 pointIndex < 0 ||
12134 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count)
12135 {
12136 return false;
12137 }
12138
12139 if (HasUsablePathPointOwnership(path))
12140 {
12141 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, pointIndex);
12142 if (ownerIndex == partIndex)
12143 return true;
12144 if (ownerIndex >= 0)
12145 return false;
12146
12147 return IsUnownedPointInsidePartRun(path, pointIndex, partIndex);
12148 }
12149
12150 return ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, path.Color);
12151 }
12152
12160 private static bool IsUnownedPointInsidePartRun(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex)
12161 {
12162 if (path.Points == null ||
12163 pointIndex < 0 ||
12164 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count ||
12165 IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, pointIndex)))
12166 {
12167 return false;
12168 }
12169
12170 int runStart = pointIndex;
12171 while (runStart > 0 && !IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, runStart - 1)))
12172 runStart--;
12173
12174 int runEnd = pointIndex;
12175 while (runEnd + 1 < path.Points.Count && !IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, runEnd + 1)))
12176 runEnd++;
12177
12178 bool runHasSelectedPart = false;
12179 bool runHasOtherPart = false;
12180 for (int i = runStart; i <= runEnd; i++)
12181 {
12182 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, i);
12183 if (ownerIndex == partIndex)
12184 runHasSelectedPart = true;
12185 else if (ownerIndex >= 0)
12186 runHasOtherPart = true;
12187 }
12188
12189 return runHasSelectedPart && !runHasOtherPart;
12190 }
12191
12199 private static bool IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex)
12200 {
12201 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, pointIndex);
12202 return ownerIndex >= 0 && ownerIndex != partIndex;
12203 }

12217 : -1;

12230 path.PointEntityIndices.Any(index => index >= 0);

12287 private static bool ColorPathStatesEqual(ColorPath oldState, ColorPath currentState)
12288 {
12289 const double tolerance = 0.001;
12290 if (oldState == null || currentState == null)
12291 return oldState == currentState;
12292
12293 return PointListsEqual(oldState.Points, currentState.Points, tolerance) &&
12294 PointListsEqual(oldState.OriginalPoints, currentState.OriginalPoints, tolerance) &&
12295 VectorListsEqual(oldState.Normals, currentState.Normals, tolerance) &&
12296 VectorListsEqual(oldState.UpVectors, currentState.UpVectors, tolerance) &&
12297 BoolListsEqual(oldState.IsMeasure, currentState.IsMeasure) &&
12298 StringListsEqual(oldState.PointTypes, currentState.PointTypes) &&
12299 IntListsEqual(oldState.PointEntityIndices, currentState.PointEntityIndices) &&
12300 oldState.IsVisible == currentState.IsVisible &&
12301 oldState.ShowPathLines == currentState.ShowPathLines &&
12302 oldState.TrajectoryMode == currentState.TrajectoryMode;
12303 }

12312 private static bool PointListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<Point3D>? first, IReadOnlyList<Point3D>? second, double tolerance)
12313 {
12314 if (first == null || second == null)
12315 return first == second;
12316 if (first.Count != second.Count)
12317 return false;
12318
12319 for (int i = 0; i < first.Count; i++)
12320 {
12321 if (first[i].DistanceTo(second[i]) > tolerance)
12322 return false;
12323 }
12324
12325 return true;
12326 }
12327
12335 private static bool VectorListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<Vector3D>? first, IReadOnlyList<Vector3D>? second, double tolerance)
12336 {
12337 if (first == null || second == null)
12338 return first == second;
12339 if (first.Count != second.Count)
12340 return false;
12341
12342 for (int i = 0; i < first.Count; i++)
12343 {
12344 if (Math.Abs(first[i].X - second[i].X) > tolerance ||
12345 Math.Abs(first[i].Y - second[i].Y) > tolerance ||
12346 Math.Abs(first[i].Z - second[i].Z) > tolerance)
12347 {
12348 return false;
12349 }
12350 }
12351
12352 return true;
12353 }
12354
12361 private static bool BoolListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<bool>? first, IReadOnlyList<bool>? second) =>
12362 (first == null || second == null)
12363 ? first == second
12364 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);
12365
12372 private static bool StringListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<string>? first, IReadOnlyList<string>? second) =>
12373 (first == null || second == null)
12374 ? first == second
12375 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);
12376
12383 private static bool IntListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<int>? first, IReadOnlyList<int>? second) =>
12384 (first == null || second == null)
12385 ? first == second
12386 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);

12391 private void MoveObjectToOrigin(object parameter)
12392 {
12393 try
12394 {
12395 // Identify the main part entity
12396 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
12397 if (partEntity == null) return;
12398
12399 var associatedEntities = GetAssociatedEntities(partEntity);
12400
12401 // Calculate bounding box and required translation
12402 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
12403
12404 // Find the origin symbol associated with this part to determine the exact original origin point
12405 Point3D minOrigin = partEntity.BoxMin;
12406 var originSymbols = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.EntityData as string == "PART_ORIGIN").ToList();
12407 var associatedOrigin = originSymbols.FirstOrDefault(o =>
12408 o is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference br &&
12409 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.X - minOrigin.X) < 1 &&
12410 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.Y - minOrigin.Y) < 1 &&
12411 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.Z - minOrigin.Z) < 1);
12412
12413 if (associatedOrigin != null)
12414 {
12415 minOrigin = (associatedOrigin as devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference)!.InsertionPoint;
12416 }
12417
12418 // Calculate required translation to place minOrigin at (0,0,0)
12419 Vector3D translation = new Vector3D(-minOrigin.X, -minOrigin.Y, -minOrigin.Z);
12420 var trans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateTranslation(translation);
12421
12422 // Apply transformation to all associated entities
12423 foreach (var ent in associatedEntities)
12424 {
12425 ent.TransformBy(trans);
12426 }
12427
12428 // Apply transformation to ignored and flipped overlays
12429 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
12430 if (partIndex >= 0)
12431 {
12432 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyTransformation(partIndex, trans);
12433 }
12434
12435 // Move associated grids
12436 devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? associatedGrid = null;
12437 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
12438 {
12439 devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? gridToRemove = null;
12440 foreach (var grid in _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids)
12441 {
12442 if (grid != _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0]) // Skip main grid
12443 {
12444 if (Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.X - minOrigin.X) < 1 &&
12445 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Y - minOrigin.Y) < 1 &&
12446 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Z - minOrigin.Z) < 1)
12447 {
12448 associatedGrid = grid;
12449 gridToRemove = grid;
12450 }
12451 }
12452 }
12453
12454 if (gridToRemove != null)
12455 {
12456 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(gridToRemove);
12457 }
12458 }
12459
12460 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
12461 _designControl.ZoomFit();
12462 _designControl.Invalidate();
12463
12464 // Clear selection after move
12465 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12466
12467 // Mark as moved so we can reset it if we track original positions
12468 StoreOriginalPosition(partEntity, associatedEntities, trans, associatedGrid);
12469 }
12470 catch (Exception ex)
12471 {
12472 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in MoveObjectToOrigin: {ex.Message}");
12473 }
12474 }
12475
12476 private Dictionary<Entity, (List<(Entity ent, devDept.Geometry.Transformation trans)> entities, devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? grid, devDept.Geometry.Transformation gridTrans)> _originalPositions = new();
12477
12485 private void StoreOriginalPosition(Entity mainPart, List<Entity> associated, devDept.Geometry.Transformation appliedTrans, devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? grid = null)
12486 {
12487 if (!_originalPositions.ContainsKey(mainPart))
12488 {
12489 var list = new List<(Entity, devDept.Geometry.Transformation)>();
12490 foreach (var ent in associated.Where(ent => ent != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(ent)).Distinct())
12491 {
12492 // We store the inverse of the applied transformation to get back
12493 var inverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
12494 inverse.Invert();
12495 list.Add((ent, inverse));
12496 }
12497
12498 var gridInverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
12499 gridInverse.Invert();
12500
12501 _originalPositions[mainPart] = (list, grid, gridInverse);
12502 }
12503 else
12504 {
12505 // Update existing stored inverse by multiplying
12506 var inverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
12507 inverse.Invert();
12508 var current = _originalPositions[mainPart];
12509
12510 for (int i = 0; i < current.entities.Count; i++)
12511 {
12512 var item = current.entities[i];
12513 current.entities[i] = (item.ent, inverse * item.trans);
12514 }
12515
12516 var newGridTrans = inverse * current.gridTrans;
12517 _originalPositions[mainPart] = (current.entities, current.grid ?? grid, newGridTrans);
12518 }
12519 }

12526 private void TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(HashSet<int> entityIndices, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
12527 {
12528 if (entityIndices == null || entityIndices.Count == 0 || transform == null)
12529 return;
12530
12531 var transformedFaces = new HashSet<CADFace>();
12532 var transformedFaceIndices = new HashSet<int>();
12533
12534 foreach (var face in EnumerateCadPlanningFaces())
12535 {
12536 if (face == null || !entityIndices.Contains(face.EntityIndex) || !transformedFaces.Add(face))
12537 continue;
12538
12539 TransformFacePointList(face.KeyPoints, transform);
12540 TransformPoint4DList(face.ControlPoints, transform);
12541 TransformPoint4DList(face.MeasurementPoints, transform);
12542 face.GeometricInfo = TransformGeometricInfoVectors(face.GeometricInfo, transform);
12543
12544 if (face.FaceGlobalIndex > 0)
12545 transformedFaceIndices.Add(face.FaceGlobalIndex);
12546 }
12547
12548 if (transformedFaceIndices.Count == 0)
12549 return;
12550
12551 var transformedHoles = new HashSet<CADHole>();
12552 foreach (var hole in EnumerateCadPlanningHoles())
12553 {
12554 if (hole == null ||
12555 hole.FaceGlobalIndices == null ||
12556 !hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any(transformedFaceIndices.Contains) ||
12557 !transformedHoles.Add(hole))
12558 continue;
12559
12560 hole.TopCenterPoint = TransformNullablePoint3D(hole.TopCenterPoint, transform);
12561 hole.BottomCenterPoint = TransformNullablePoint3D(hole.BottomCenterPoint, transform);
12562 if (hole.AxisDirection != null)
12563 hole.AxisDirection = TransformDirection(hole.AxisDirection, transform);
12564 hole.GeometricInfo = TransformGeometricInfoVectors(hole.GeometricInfo, transform);
12565 }
12566 }

12577 yield return face;

12581 {
12582 foreach (var face in list)

12596 yield return hole;
12597 }

12676 private static Vector3D TransformDirection(Vector3D direction, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
12677 {
12678 var origin = new Point3D(0, 0, 0);
12679 var end = new Point3D(direction.X, direction.Y, direction.Z);
12680 origin.TransformBy(transform);
12681 end.TransformBy(transform);
12682
12683 var transformed = new Vector3D(end.X - origin.X, end.Y - origin.Y, end.Z - origin.Z);
12684 if (transformed.Length > 1e-8)
12685 transformed.Normalize();
12686 return transformed;
12687 }

12695 private static string? TransformGeometricInfoVectors(string? geometricInfo, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
12696 {
12697 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(geometricInfo))
12698 return geometricInfo;
12699
12700 string result = TransformGeometricInfoVector(geometricInfo, "Normal", transform);
12701 result = TransformGeometricInfoVector(result, "Axis", transform);
12702 return result;
12703 }
12704
12712 private static string TransformGeometricInfoVector(string geometricInfo, string label, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
12713 {
12714 return Regex.Replace(
12715 geometricInfo,
12716 $@"({Regex.Escape(label)}:\s*)\‍(([^,]+),\s*([^,]+),\s*([^)]+)\‍)",
12717 match =>
12718 {
12719 if (!double.TryParse(match.Groups[2].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double x) ||
12720 !double.TryParse(match.Groups[3].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double y) ||
12721 !double.TryParse(match.Groups[4].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double z))
12722 {
12723 return match.Value;
12724 }
12725
12726 var transformed = TransformDirection(new Vector3D(x, y, z), transform);
12727 return string.Format(
12728 System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
12729 "{0}({1:0.######}, {2:0.######}, {3:0.######})",
12730 match.Groups[1].Value,
12731 transformed.X,
12732 transformed.Y,
12733 transformed.Z);
12734 },
12735 RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
12736 }
