12795 private void StopManipulating(object parameter)
12796 {
12797 var designControl = _designControl;
12798 var objectManipulator = designControl?.ObjectManipulator;
12799 if (designControl != null && (objectManipulator?.Visible == true || _isCustomDragging))
12800 {
12801 bool wasCustomDragging = _isCustomDragging;
12802 _isCustomDragging = false;
12803 _prevDragPosition = null;
12804 bool wasPartManipulating = _isPartManipulating;
12805 _isPartManipulating = false;
12806
12807 var trans = objectManipulator?.Transformation;
12808 if (objectManipulator != null && trans != null)
12809 {
12810 devDept.Geometry.Transformation deltaTrans;
12811 if (_initialTriadTrans != null)
12812 {
12813 var invInitial = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)_initialTriadTrans.Clone();
12814 invInitial.Invert();
12815 deltaTrans = trans * invInitial;
12816 }
12817 else
12818 {
12819 deltaTrans = trans;
12820 }
12821
12822 if (_isCreatingIntermediaryPoint)
12823 {
12824 if (_tempInsertPosition != null)
12825 {
12826 var testPos = (Point3D)_tempInsertPosition.Clone();
12827 testPos.TransformBy(deltaTrans);
12828 if (_tempInsertPosition.DistanceTo(testPos) < 1e-4)
12829 {
12830 CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation();
12831 return;
12832 }
12833 }
12834
12835 _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint = false;
12836 if (_draggingSphere != null)
12837 {
12838 designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
12839 _draggingSphere = null;
12840 }
12841
12842 var tempInsertPath = _tempInsertPath;
12843 var tempInsertPosition = _tempInsertPosition;
12844 if (tempInsertPath != null && tempInsertPosition != null)
12845 {
12846 var newPos = (Point3D)tempInsertPosition.Clone();
12847 newPos.TransformBy(deltaTrans);
12848
12849 bool isBridgeInsertion = false;
12850 if (tempInsertPath.PointTypes != null &&
12851 _tempInsertIndex > 0 &&
12852 _tempInsertIndex < tempInsertPath.PointTypes.Count)
12853 {
12854 string startType = tempInsertPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex - 1];
12855 string endType = tempInsertPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex];
12856 isBridgeInsertion = IsBridgeManipulationType(startType) && IsBridgeManipulationType(endType);
12857 }
12858
12859 var bridgePathManager = _pathManager;
12860 if (isBridgeInsertion && bridgePathManager != null)
12861 {
12862 var oldStates = bridgePathManager.ColorPaths.ToDictionary(kvp => kvp.Key, kvp => kvp.Value.CloneState());
12863 if (bridgePathManager.TryInsertBridgeIntermediary(tempInsertPath, _tempInsertIndex, newPos, out var changedPaths))
12864 {
12865 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
12866 foreach (var changedPath in changedPaths.Distinct())
12867 {
12868 if (oldStates.TryGetValue(changedPath.Color, out var oldState))
12869 {
12870 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(
12871 bridgePathManager,
12872 designControl,
12873 changedPath.Color,
12874 oldState,
12875 changedPath.CloneState()));
12876 }
12877 }
12878
12879 if (commands.Count == 1)
12880 UndoManager.PushCommand(commands[0]);
12881 else if (commands.Count > 1)
12882 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
12883
12884 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
12885 _tempInsertPath = null;
12886 _tempInsertPosition = null;
12887 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
12888
12889 bridgePathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
12890 designControl.Entities.Regen();
12891 objectManipulator.Cancel();
12892 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12893 designControl.Invalidate();
12894 _manipulatingEntity = null;
12895 return;
12896 }
12897
12898 CleanupPendingIntermediaryCreation();
12899 return;
12900 }
12901
12902 // Insert into model
12903 tempInsertPath.Points.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, newPos);
12904 if (tempInsertPath.Normals != null && _tempInsertIndex - 1 < tempInsertPath.Normals.Count)
12905 tempInsertPath.Normals.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, (Vector3D)tempInsertPath.Normals[_tempInsertIndex - 1].Clone());
12906 else if (tempInsertPath.Normals != null)
12907 tempInsertPath.Normals.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, Vector3D.AxisZ);
12908
12909 if (tempInsertPath.IsMeasure != null)
12910 tempInsertPath.IsMeasure.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, false);
12911
12912 string newPointType = "Approach";
12913 if (tempInsertPath.PointTypes != null && _tempInsertIndex - 1 < tempInsertPath.PointTypes.Count)
12914 {
12915 string startType = tempInsertPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex - 1];
12916 string endType = (_tempInsertIndex < tempInsertPath.PointTypes.Count) ? tempInsertPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex] : "";
12917 if ((startType == "Bridge" || startType == "BridgeIntermediary") && (endType == "Bridge" || endType == "BridgeIntermediary"))
12918 {
12919 newPointType = "BridgeIntermediary";
12920 }
12921 }
12922
12923 if (tempInsertPath.PointTypes != null)
12924 tempInsertPath.PointTypes.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, newPointType);
12925
12926 if (tempInsertPath.OriginalPoints != null)
12927 tempInsertPath.OriginalPoints.Insert(_tempInsertIndex, (Point3D)newPos.Clone());
12928
12929 // Insert into other overlapping bridges
12930 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Count > 0)
12931 {
12932 Point3D p1 = tempInsertPath.Points[_tempInsertIndex - 1];
12933 Point3D p2 = tempInsertPath.Points[_tempInsertIndex + 1]; // +1 because we just inserted at _tempInsertIndex
12934 foreach (var info in _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo)
12935 {
12936 var otherPath = info.Path;
12937 // Find where to insert (between p1 and p2 or p2 and p1)
12938 for (int i = 0; i < otherPath.Points.Count - 1; i++)
12939 {
12940 if ((otherPath.Points[i].DistanceTo(p1) < 1e-4 && otherPath.Points[i + 1].DistanceTo(p2) < 1e-4) ||
12941 (otherPath.Points[i].DistanceTo(p2) < 1e-4 && otherPath.Points[i + 1].DistanceTo(p1) < 1e-4))
12942 {
12943 int insertIdx = i + 1;
12944 otherPath.Points.Insert(insertIdx, (Point3D)newPos.Clone());
12945 if (otherPath.Normals != null && insertIdx - 1 < otherPath.Normals.Count)
12946 otherPath.Normals.Insert(insertIdx, (Vector3D)otherPath.Normals[insertIdx - 1].Clone());
12947 else if (otherPath.Normals != null)
12948 otherPath.Normals.Insert(insertIdx, Vector3D.AxisZ);
12949
12950 if (otherPath.IsMeasure != null)
12951 otherPath.IsMeasure.Insert(insertIdx, false);
12952
12953 if (otherPath.PointTypes != null)
12954 otherPath.PointTypes.Insert(insertIdx, "BridgeIntermediary");
12955
12956 if (otherPath.OriginalPoints != null)
12957 otherPath.OriginalPoints.Insert(insertIdx, (Point3D)newPos.Clone());
12958
12959 var overlapPathManager = _pathManager;
12960 if (overlapPathManager != null)
12961 {
12962 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(overlapPathManager, designControl, otherPath.Color, info.OldState, otherPath.CloneState()));
12963 }
12964 break;
12965 }
12966 }
12967 }
12968 }
12969
12970 // Register command in Undo history
12971 var insertPathManager = _pathManager;
12972 if (insertPathManager != null)
12973 {
12974 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(insertPathManager, designControl, tempInsertPath.Color, _oldPathStateForWaypointMove ?? tempInsertPath.CloneState(), tempInsertPath.CloneState()));
12975 }
12976
12977 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
12978 _tempInsertPath = null;
12979 _tempInsertPosition = null;
12980 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
12981
12982 var refreshPathManager = _pathManager;
12983 if (refreshPathManager != null)
12984 {
12985 refreshPathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
12986 designControl.Entities.Regen();
12987 }
12988 }
12989
12990 objectManipulator.Cancel();
12991 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12992 designControl.Invalidate();
12993 _manipulatingEntity = null;
12994 return;
12995 }
12996
12997 var selectedEntities = designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.Selected).ToList();
12998
12999 // Check if manipulating a Waypoint
13000 var waypointEntity = (!wasPartManipulating && (_manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData))
13001 ? _manipulatingEntity
13002 : (!wasPartManipulating ? selectedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => e.EntityData is WaypointData) : null);
13003 if (waypointEntity != null)
13004 {
13005 var data = (WaypointData)waypointEntity.EntityData;
13006 var pathManager = _pathManager;
13007
13008 if (wasCustomDragging && _draggingSphere != null)
13009 {
13010 designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
13011 _draggingSphere = null;
13012 }
13013 waypointEntity.Visible = true;
13014
13015 // Select only this entity so ObjectManipulator.Apply applies the transformation to it!
13016 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
13017 waypointEntity.Selected = true;
13018
13019 objectManipulator.Apply();
13020
13021 Point3D oldPos = (Point3D)data.OriginalPosition.Clone();
13022 Vector3D oldNormal = (Vector3D)data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex].Clone();
13023
13024 Point3D newPos;
13025 if (wasCustomDragging)
13026 {
13027 newPos = _draggingSpherePosition != null ? (Point3D)_draggingSpherePosition.Clone() : (Point3D)data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex].Clone();
13028 deltaTrans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation(1);
13029 }
13030 else
13031 {
13032 newPos = (Point3D)data.OriginalPosition.Clone();
13033 newPos.TransformBy(deltaTrans);
13034 }
13035
13036 // Do not waste time doing calculations if the point didn't move
13037 if (newPos.DistanceTo(oldPos) < 1e-4)
13038 {
13039 CancelWaypointManipulation(waypointEntity);
13040 return;
13041 }
13042
13043 bool isMeasure = data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex];
13044 bool isScanPoint = data.Path.PointTypes != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.PointTypes.Count && string.Equals(data.Path.PointTypes[data.PointIndex], "scanpoints", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
13045
13046 if (isMeasure && !isScanPoint)
13047 {
13048 Vector3D newNormal = oldNormal;
13049 Point3D snappedPos = newPos;
13050
13051 if (wasCustomDragging)
13052 {
13053 snappedPos = (Point3D)newPos.Clone();
13054 newNormal = (Vector3D)data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex].Clone();
13055 // Recalculate normal at snapped position
13056 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
13057 {
13058 try
13059 {
13060 var fn = _draggingMeasurePointBrep.Faces[_draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex].Normal(snappedPos);
13061 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
13062 {
13063 newNormal = fn;
13064 newNormal.Normalize();
13065 }
13066 }
13067 catch { }
13068 }
13069 }
13070 else
13071 {
13072 // Find the parent face from the original position
13073 Entity targetPartForFace = null!;
13074 int targetFaceIndex = -1;
13075 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
13076
13077 foreach (var ent in designControl.Entities)
13078 {
13079 if (ent is Brep brep)
13080 {
13081 for (int i = 0; i < brep.Faces.Length; i++)
13082 {
13083 try
13084 {
13085 var mesh = brep.Faces[i].ConvertToMesh();
13086 if (mesh != null)
13087 {
13088 var proj = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(oldPos, brep, i);
13089 double dist = proj.DistanceTo(oldPos);
13090 if (dist < closestDist && dist < 1.0)
13091 {
13092 closestDist = dist;
13093 targetPartForFace = brep;
13094 targetFaceIndex = i;
13095 }
13096 }
13097 }
13098 catch { }
13099 }
13100 }
13101 }
13102
13103 if (targetPartForFace is Brep targetBrep && targetFaceIndex != -1)
13104 {
13105 snappedPos = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(newPos, targetBrep, targetFaceIndex);
13106 try
13107 {
13108 var fn = targetBrep.Faces[targetFaceIndex].Normal(snappedPos);
13109 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
13110 {
13111 newNormal = fn;
13112 newNormal.Normalize();
13113 }
13114 }
13115 catch { }
13116 }
13117 else
13118 {
13119 Entity? targetPart;
13120 snappedPos = SnapToClosestPartSurface(newPos, out newNormal, out targetPart);
13121 }
13122 }
13123
13124 // Align newNormal direction to match the previous normal
13125 Vector3D prevNormal = data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex];
13126 if (Vector3D.Dot(newNormal, prevNormal) < 0)
13127 {
13128 newNormal = new Vector3D(-newNormal.X, -newNormal.Y, -newNormal.Z);
13129 }
13130
13131 // Translate associated approach points (entrance and exit if applicable)
13132 // We move approach point(s) by the exact offset and normal rotation/alignment.
13133 // To stay perpendicular and aligned, the approach point should be placed at the
13134 // snapped position offset by the newNormal * offsetDistance.
13135
13136 // Entry approach point
13137 if (data.PointIndex > 0 && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && !data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex - 1])
13138 {
13139 bool isOurs = true;
13140 if (data.Path.OriginalPoints != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
13141 {
13142 double originalOffset = data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex - 1].DistanceTo(data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex]);
13143 if (originalOffset > 100.0) isOurs = false;
13144 }
13145
13146 if (isOurs)
13147 {
13148 double offsetDistance = data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex - 1].DistanceTo(oldPos);
13149 if (offsetDistance < 0.001) offsetDistance = 15.0;
13150 data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex - 1] = snappedPos + newNormal * offsetDistance;
13151 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex - 1] = newNormal;
13152 }
13153 }
13154
13155 // Exit approach point
13156 if (data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex + 1])
13157 {
13158 bool isOurs = true;
13159 if (data.Path.OriginalPoints != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
13160 {
13161 double originalOffset = data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex + 1].DistanceTo(data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex]);
13162 if (originalOffset > 100.0) isOurs = false;
13163 }
13164
13165 if (isOurs)
13166 {
13167 double offsetDistance = data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex + 1].DistanceTo(oldPos);
13168 if (offsetDistance < 0.001) offsetDistance = 15.0;
13169 data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex + 1] = snappedPos + newNormal * offsetDistance;
13170 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex + 1] = newNormal;
13171 }
13172 }
13173
13174 newPos = snappedPos;
13175 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex] = newNormal;
13176 }
13177 else if (isScanPoint)
13178 {
13179 // Scanner scan point: save translated position directly and keep the normal as is
13180 data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex] = newPos;
13181 }
13182 else
13183 {
13184 // It's an approach/intermediary point.
13185 // Check if it is bound to a measurement point (adjacent).
13186 int mIdx = -1;
13187 if (data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex + 1])
13188 {
13189 mIdx = data.PointIndex + 1; // It is the entry approach point
13190 }
13191 else if (data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex > 0 && data.PointIndex - 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex - 1])
13192 {
13193 mIdx = data.PointIndex - 1; // It is the exit approach point
13194 }
13195
13196 if (mIdx != -1)
13197 {
13198 // Bound to a measurement point. Snap to the normal axis of the face of that measurement point.
13199 Point3D measurePt = data.Path.Points[mIdx];
13200 Vector3D normal = data.Path.Normals[mIdx];
13201 if (normal.LengthSquared < 1e-6) normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
13202 normal.Normalize();
13203
13204 // Project newPos onto the line starting at measurePt along the normal direction.
13205 double t = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(measurePt, newPos), normal);
13206 t = Math.Max(0.0, t); // Cannot go below the surface (inside the part)
13207 Point3D projectedPos = measurePt + normal * t;
13208 newPos = projectedPos;
13209
13210 // If the other approach point (entry/exit) exists, update it to match the projected pos.
13211 if (mIdx - 1 >= 0 && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && mIdx - 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[mIdx - 1])
13212 {
13213 data.Path.Points[mIdx - 1] = newPos;
13214 data.Path.Normals[mIdx - 1] = normal;
13215 }
13216 if (mIdx + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && mIdx + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[mIdx + 1])
13217 {
13218 data.Path.Points[mIdx + 1] = newPos;
13219 data.Path.Normals[mIdx + 1] = normal;
13220 }
13221 }
13222 }
13223
13224 data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex] = newPos;
13225
13226 if (pathManager != null)
13227 {
13228 pathManager.DrawSinglePath(data.Path);
13229 designControl.Entities.Regen();
13230 }
13231
13232 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePoints != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Count > 0)
13233 {
13234 foreach (var item in _otherOverlappingBridgePoints)
13235 {
13236 var otherPath = item.Path;
13237 int otherIdx = item.PointIndex;
13238 otherPath.Points[otherIdx] = newPos;
13239
13240 if (pathManager != null)
13241 {
13242 pathManager.DrawSinglePath(otherPath);
13243 }
13244 }
13245 }
13246
13247 data.IsNew = false;
13248 data.OriginalPosition = (Point3D)newPos.Clone();
13249 Vector3D finalNormal = (Vector3D)data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex].Clone();
13250
13251 if (_oldPathStateForWaypointMove != null && pathManager != null)
13252 {
13253 var mainCommand = new UpdateColorPathCommand(pathManager, designControl, data.Path.Color, _oldPathStateForWaypointMove, data.Path.CloneState());
13254 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
13255
13256 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Count > 0)
13257 {
13258 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand> { mainCommand };
13259 foreach (var info in _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo)
13260 {
13261 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(pathManager, designControl, info.Path.Color, info.OldState, info.Path.CloneState()));
13262 }
13263 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
13264 }
13265 else
13266 {
13267 UndoManager.PushCommand(mainCommand);
13268 }
13269 }
13270 else
13271 {
13272 var mainCommand = new MoveWaypointCommand(pathManager, designControl, data.Path, data.PointIndex, oldPos, newPos, oldNormal, finalNormal, waypointEntity);
13273 if (pathManager != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePoints != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Count > 0 && _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Count > 0)
13274 {
13275 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand> { mainCommand };
13276 foreach (var info in _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo)
13277 {
13278 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(pathManager, designControl, info.Path.Color, info.OldState, info.Path.CloneState()));
13279 }
13280 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
13281 }
13282 else
13283 {
13284 UndoManager.PushCommand(mainCommand);
13285 }
13286 }
13287
13288 // Record in EditHistory for session persistence
13289 if (pathManager != null)
13290 {
13291 pathManager.EditHistory.Add(new PointEditEventDTO
13292 {
13293 ColorR = data.Path.Color.R,
13294 ColorG = data.Path.Color.G,
13295 ColorB = data.Path.Color.B,
13296 PointIndex = data.PointIndex,
13297 OldX = oldPos.X,
13298 OldY = oldPos.Y,
13299 OldZ = oldPos.Z,
13300 NewX = newPos.X,
13301 NewY = newPos.Y,
13302 NewZ = newPos.Z
13303 });
13304
13305 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePoints != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Count > 0)
13306 {
13307 foreach (var item in _otherOverlappingBridgePoints)
13308 {
13309 pathManager.EditHistory.Add(new PointEditEventDTO
13310 {
13311 ColorR = item.Path.Color.R,
13312 ColorG = item.Path.Color.G,
13313 ColorB = item.Path.Color.B,
13314 PointIndex = item.PointIndex,
13315 OldX = oldPos.X,
13316 OldY = oldPos.Y,
13317 OldZ = oldPos.Z,
13318 NewX = newPos.X,
13319 NewY = newPos.Y,
13320 NewZ = newPos.Z
13321 });
13322 }
13323 }
13324 }
13325
13326 // Update the line
13327 if (data.Path.PathEntity != null)
13328 {
13329 data.Path.PathEntity.Vertices = data.Path.Points.ToArray();
13330 data.Path.PathEntity.Regen(0.1);
13331 }
13332
13333 objectManipulator.Cancel();
13334 if (waypointEntity != null) waypointEntity.Selected = false;
13335
13336 // DrawSinglePath already rebuilt this path's visuals above — no need for full rebuild
13337 designControl.Invalidate();
13338 _manipulatingEntity = null;
13339 _prevDragPosition = null;
13340 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = null;
13341 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;
13342 return;
13343 }
13344
13345 if (!wasPartManipulating)
13346 {
13347 objectManipulator.Cancel();
13348 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
13349 designControl.Invalidate();
13350 _manipulatingEntity = null;
13351 return;
13352 }
13353
13354 // Identity Transformation Check (Antennae Fix)
13355 bool isIdentity = true;
13356 if (deltaTrans != null)
13357 {
13358 for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++)
13359 {
13360 for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++)
13361 {
13362 double expected = (row == col) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
13363 if (Math.Abs(deltaTrans[row, col] - expected) > 1e-4)
13364 {
13365 isIdentity = false;
13366 break;
13367 }
13368 }
13369 if (!isIdentity) break;
13370 }
13371 }
13372
13373 if (isIdentity)
13374 {
13375 objectManipulator.Cancel();
13376 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
13377 designControl.Invalidate();
13378 _manipulatingEntity = null;
13379 _isPartManipulating = false;
13380 return;
13381 }
13382
13383 var appliedTransform = deltaTrans!;
13384
13385 var mainPart = _manipulatingEntity ?? ResolvePartEntity(parameter) ?? selectedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep || e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh);
13386 if (mainPart != null)
13387 selectedEntities = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(mainPart);
13388
13389 var selectedPathVisualEntities = selectedEntities
13390 .Where(IsPathVisualEntity)
13391 .Distinct()
13392 .ToList();
13393
13394 selectedEntities = selectedEntities
13395 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
13396 .Distinct()
13397 .ToList();
13398
13399 int mainPartIndex = mainPart != null ? _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(mainPart) : -1;
13400 var movedEntityIndices = new HashSet<int>();
13401 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
13402 movedEntityIndices.Add(mainPartIndex);
13403
13404 var exclusiveFallbackColors = mainPartIndex >= 0
13405 ? GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(mainPartIndex)
13406 : new HashSet<Color>();
13407 var affectedPathColors = mainPartIndex >= 0
13408 ? GetPathColorsForPart(mainPartIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors)
13409 : new HashSet<Color>();
13410 foreach (var color in GetPathColorsFromVisualEntities(selectedPathVisualEntities))
13411 affectedPathColors.Add(color);
13412
13413 // --- PRE-MOVE STATE CAPTURE ---
13414 var oldPathsState = new Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>();
13415 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
13416 {
13417 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
13418 {
13419 oldPathsState[kvp.Key] = kvp.Value.CloneState();
13420 }
13421 }
13422
13423 var bridgeSnapshot = _pathManager?.CaptureAffectedBridgeState(movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors);
13424 devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? associatedGrid = null;
13425
13426 if (mainPart != null && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13427 {
13428 var originEntity = selectedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => IsPartOriginEntityForPart(e, mainPart));
13429 if (originEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference brOrigin)
13430 {
13431 var inverseTrans = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTransform.Clone();
13432 inverseTrans.Invert();
13433 Point3D oldOriginPt = new Point3D(brOrigin.InsertionPoint.X, brOrigin.InsertionPoint.Y, brOrigin.InsertionPoint.Z);
13434 oldOriginPt.TransformBy(inverseTrans);
13435
13436 foreach (var grid in _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids)
13437 {
13438 if (grid != _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0]) // Skip main
13439 {
13440 if (Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.X - oldOriginPt.X) < 1 &&
13441 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Y - oldOriginPt.Y) < 1 &&
13442 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Z - oldOriginPt.Z) < 1)
13443 {
13444 associatedGrid = grid;
13445 }
13446 }
13447 }
13448 }
13449 }
13450
13451 bool hasPathsToMove = affectedPathColors.Count > 0 || selectedPathVisualEntities.Count > 0;
13452 bool shouldMovePaths = false;
13453
13454 bool movedPart = true;
13455 if (hasPathsToMove)
13456 {
13457 var result = MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MovePathsWithObject") ?? "Path planning was already generated for this object. Do you want to move the paths alongside the object?", "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
13458 shouldMovePaths = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
13459 }
13460
13461 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
13462 foreach (var ent in selectedEntities)
13463 {
13464 ent.Selected = true;
13465 }
13466 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Apply();
13467
13468 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
13469 {
13470 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(movedEntityIndices, appliedTransform);
13471 }
13472
13473 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
13474 {
13475 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyTransformation(mainPartIndex, appliedTransform);
13476 }
13477
13478 if (associatedGrid != null)
13479 {
13480 var plane = associatedGrid.Plane;
13481 plane.TransformBy(appliedTransform);
13482 associatedGrid.Plane = plane;
13483 }
13484
13485 if (hasPathsToMove && _pathManager != null)
13486 {
13487 if (shouldMovePaths)
13488 {
13489 var changedPathColors = _pathManager.ApplyPartMoveToPathDataFromSnapshot(
13490 oldPathsState,
13491 movedEntityIndices,
13492 exclusiveFallbackColors,
13493 appliedTransform);
13494
13495 foreach (var color in _pathManager.ReconnectAffectedHighZBridges(bridgeSnapshot, movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors, appliedTransform))
13496 changedPathColors.Add(color);
13497
13498 foreach (var color in changedPathColors)
13499 affectedPathColors.Add(color);
13500
13501 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
13502 }
13503 else
13504 {
13505 RestorePathStates(oldPathsState, affectedPathColors);
13506 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
13507 }
13508 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
13509 }
13510
13511 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
13512 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
13513 _designControl.Invalidate();
13514
13515 if (movedPart)
13516 {
13517 // --- POST-MOVE COMMAND CREATION ---
13518 var compositeCommands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
13519 if (mainPart != null)
13520 {
13521 var movedGeometryEntities = selectedEntities
13522 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
13523 .Distinct()
13524 .ToList();
13525
13526 if (!movedGeometryEntities.Contains(mainPart))
13527 movedGeometryEntities.Add(mainPart);
13528
13529 if (movedGeometryEntities.Count > 0)
13530 compositeCommands.Add(new MovePartCommand(_designControl, movedGeometryEntities, appliedTransform, _ignoredItemManager, mainPartIndex >= 0 && mainPart != null ? new[] { mainPart } : null));
13531 }
13532
13533 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
13534 {
13535 var metadataEntityIndices = new HashSet<int>(movedEntityIndices);
13536 var metadataRedoTransform = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTransform.Clone();
13537 var metadataUndoTransform = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTransform.Clone();
13538 metadataUndoTransform.Invert();
13539
13540 compositeCommands.Add(new ActionUndoCommand(
13541 undoAction: () =>
13542 {
13543 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(metadataEntityIndices, (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataUndoTransform.Clone());
13544 _pathManager?.InvalidateShellCache();
13545 },
13546 redoAction: () =>
13547 {
13548 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(metadataEntityIndices, (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataRedoTransform.Clone());
13549 _pathManager?.InvalidateShellCache();
13550 },
13551 description: "Updated CAD planning metadata for moved part",
13552 category: "Part Manipulation"));
13553 }
13554
13555 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
13556 {
13557 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
13558 {
13559 if (oldPathsState.TryGetValue(kvp.Key, out var oldState))
13560 {
13561 var cp = kvp.Value;
13562 if (!ColorPathStatesEqual(oldState, cp))
13563 {
13564 compositeCommands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, kvp.Key, oldState, cp.CloneState(), regenerateAllPaths: true));
13565 }
13566 }
13567 }
13568 }
13569
13570 if (compositeCommands.Count == 1)
13571 UndoManager.PushCommand(compositeCommands[0]);
13572 else if (compositeCommands.Count > 1)
13573 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(compositeCommands));
13574
13575 if (mainPart != null)
13576 {
13577 StoreOriginalPosition(mainPart, selectedEntities.Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e)).Distinct().ToList(), appliedTransform, associatedGrid);
13578 }
13579 _pathManager?.InvalidateShellCache();
13580 }
13581 }
13582
13583 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel(); // Ensure it hides explicitly
13584 _manipulatingEntity = null;
13585 }
13586 }

13593 private Entity? ResolvePartEntity(object? parameter)
13594 {
13595 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null) return null;
13596
13597 Entity? partEntity = null;
13598 if (parameter is CADFace face)
13599 {
13600 if (face.EntityIndex >= 0 && face.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
13601 partEntity = _designControl.Entities[face.EntityIndex];
13602 }
13603 else if (parameter is CADHole hole)
13604 {
13605 partEntity = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(e => e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep brep && hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any(idx => brep.Faces.Length > idx));
13606 }
13607 else if (parameter is FacePoint)
13608 {
13609 partEntity = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(e => e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep);
13610 }
13611 else if (parameter is Entity entParams)
13612 {
13613 partEntity = entParams;
13614 }
13615
13616 partEntity ??= GetSectionCandidateParts().FirstOrDefault();
13617 return partEntity;
13618 }

13625 private List<Entity> GetAssociatedEntities(Entity partEntity)
13626 {

13628
13629 associatedEntities.AddRange(_designControl.Entities.Where(e => IsPartOwnedManipulationHelper(e, partEntity)));
13630
13631 return associatedEntities.Distinct().ToList();

13640 private bool IsPartOwnedManipulationHelper(Entity entity, Entity partEntity)
13641 {
13642 if (entity == null || entity == partEntity || IsPathVisualEntity(entity))
13643 return false;
13644
13645 if (IsPartOriginEntityForPart(entity, partEntity))
13646 return true;
13647
13648 string? layerName = entity.LayerName;
13649 bool isHelperLayer = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName) &&
13650 (layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13651 layerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
13652 if (!isHelperLayer)
13653 return false;
13654
13655 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
13656 if (entity.EntityData is CADFace faceData && faceData.EntityIndex == partIndex)
13657 return true;
13658
13659 string? partSource = GetPartSourceKey(partEntity);
13660 return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partSource) &&
13661 entity.EntityData is string helperSource &&
13662 string.Equals(helperSource, partSource, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
13663 }
13664
13671 private bool IsPartOriginEntityForPart(Entity entity, Entity partEntity)
13672 {
13673 if (entity.EntityData is not string entityData ||
13674 !entityData.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13675 {
13676 return false;
13677 }
13678
13679 string? partSource = GetPartSourceKey(partEntity);
13680 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partSource))
13681 {
13682 return string.Equals(entityData, $"PART_ORIGIN:{partSource}", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
13683 }
13684
13685 if (!string.Equals(entityData, "PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13686 return false;
13687
13688 return IsOriginNearPart(entity, partEntity);
13689 }
13690
13696 private static string? GetPartSourceKey(Entity partEntity)
13697 {
13698 if (partEntity.EntityData is not string source ||
13699 string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(source) ||
13700 source.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13701 string.Equals(source, "UI_MARKER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13702 string.Equals(source, "SECTION_VISUAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13703 string.Equals(source, "IgnoredOverlay_Ref", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13704 {
13705 return null;
13706 }
13707
13708 return source;
13709 }

13717 private static bool IsOriginNearPart(Entity originEntity, Entity partEntity)
13718 {
13719 if (originEntity is not BlockReference origin)
13720 return false;
13721
13722 try
13723 {
13724 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13725 return origin.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(partEntity.BoxMin) < 1.0;
13726 }
13727 catch
13728 {
13729 return false;
13730 }
13731 }

13738 private Entity? GetAssociatedPart(Point3D point)
13739 {
13740 if (_allFacesByColor == null || !_allFacesByColor.Any()) return null;
13741
13742 CADFace? closestFace = null;
13743 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
13744
13745 foreach (var faceList in _allFacesByColor.Values)
13746 {
13747 foreach (var face in faceList)
13748 {
13749 foreach (var mp in face.MeasurementPoints)
13750 {
13751 double dist = point.DistanceTo(new Point3D(mp.X, mp.Y, mp.Z));
13752 if (dist < minDistance)
13753 {
13754 minDistance = dist;
13755 closestFace = face;
13756 }
13757 }
13758 }
13759 }
13760
13761 if (closestFace != null && closestFace.EntityIndex >= 0 && closestFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
13762 {
13763 return _designControl.Entities[closestFace.EntityIndex];
13764 }
13765
13766 return null;
13767 }

13777 {

13779 var wpPosition = path.Points[pointIndex];
13780 var assocPart = GetAssociatedPart(wpPosition);
13781 return assocPart == part;

13791 private void AlignTriadWithOriginGrid(object parameter)
13792 {
13793 if (_designControl == null) return;
13794
13795 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
13796 if (partEntity == null) return;
13797
13798 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13799 Point3D newMin = partEntity.BoxMin;
13800 Point3D newMax = partEntity.BoxMax;
13801
13802 // Find associated origin and grid
13803 var originSymbols = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.EntityData is string str && str.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN")).ToList();
13804 var associatedOrigin = originSymbols.OrderBy(o => (o is BlockReference br) ? br.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(newMin) : double.MaxValue).FirstOrDefault() as BlockReference;
13805
13806 if (associatedOrigin != null)
13807 {
13808 associatedOrigin.Transformation = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
13809 associatedOrigin.InsertionPoint = new Point3D(newMin.X, newMin.Y, newMin.Z);
13810 }
13811
13812 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13813 {
13814 var grid = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.OrderBy(g => g.Plane.Origin.DistanceTo(newMin)).FirstOrDefault();
13815 if (grid != null && grid != _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0])
13816 {
13817 grid.Plane = new Plane(newMin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
13818 grid.Max = new Point2D(Math.Max(50, newMax.X - newMin.X), Math.Max(50, newMax.Y - newMin.Y));
13819 }
13820 }
13821
13822 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
13823 _designControl.Invalidate();
13824 }

13834 private Entity? FindNearbyWaypoint(System.Drawing.Point screenPoint, double pixelTolerance = 30.0)
13835 {
13836 Entity? closestWaypoint = null;
13837 double minScreenDist = pixelTolerance;
13838
13839 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
13840 {
13841 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path != null && wd.PointIndex >= 0 && wd.PointIndex < wd.Path.Points.Count)
13842 {
13843 Point3D pt = wd.Path.Points[wd.PointIndex];
13844 Point3D wpScreen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pt);
13845 if (wpScreen == null) continue;
13846
13847 double dx = screenPoint.X - wpScreen.X;
13848 double dy = screenPoint.Y - wpScreen.Y;
13849 double dist = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
13850
13851 if (dist < minScreenDist)
13852 {
13853 minScreenDist = dist;
13854 closestWaypoint = ent;
13855 }
13856 }
13857 }
13858 return closestWaypoint;
13859 }

13867 private Point3D GetClosestPointOnPath(LinearPath pathLine, System.Drawing.Point screenPoint)
13868 {
13869 if (pathLine.Vertices.Length < 2) return null!;
13870
13871 var camera = _designControl.ActiveViewport.Camera;
13872 Point3D clickWorldPoint = _designControl.ScreenToWorld(screenPoint);
13873 if (clickWorldPoint == null) return null!;
13874
13875 Point3D rayOrigin;
13876 Vector3D rayDir;
13877
13878 if (camera.ProjectionMode == devDept.Eyeshot.projectionType.Perspective)
13879 {
13880 rayOrigin = camera.Location;
13881 rayDir = new Vector3D(camera.Location, clickWorldPoint);
13882 }
13883 else
13884 {
13885 rayOrigin = clickWorldPoint;
13886 rayDir = new Vector3D(camera.Location, camera.Target);
13887 }
13888 rayDir.Normalize();
13889
13890 Point3D a = pathLine.Vertices[0];
13891 Point3D b = pathLine.Vertices[1];
13892 Vector3D V = new Vector3D(a, b);
13893 Vector3D W0 = new Vector3D(a, rayOrigin);
13894
13895 double bDot = Vector3D.Dot(rayDir, V);
13896 double c = V.LengthSquared;
13897 double d = Vector3D.Dot(rayDir, W0);
13898 double e = Vector3D.Dot(V, W0);
13899
13900 double denom = c - bDot * bDot;
13901 double t = 0;
13902 if (denom < 1e-9)
13903 {
13904 if (c > 1e-9)
13905 {
13906 t = e / c;
13907 }
13908 }
13909 else
13910 {
13911 t = (e - bDot * d) / denom;
13912 }
13913 t = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(1.0, t));
13914
13915 return a + t * V;
13916 }
13917
13924 private LinearPath? FindNearbyPathLine(System.Drawing.Point screenPoint, double pixelTolerance = 150.0)
13925 {
13926 LinearPath? closestPathLine = null;
13927 double minScreenDist = pixelTolerance;
13928
13929 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
13930 {
13931 if (ent is LinearPath pathLine && pathLine.LayerName != null && pathLine.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))
13932 {
13933 for (int i = 0; i < pathLine.Vertices.Length - 1; i++)
13934 {
13935 Point3D p1Screen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pathLine.Vertices[i]);
13936 Point3D p2Screen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pathLine.Vertices[i + 1]);
13937 if (p1Screen == null || p2Screen == null) continue;
13938
13939 double dist = DistanceToSegment(new Point2D(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y), new Point2D(p1Screen.X, p1Screen.Y), new Point2D(p2Screen.X, p2Screen.Y));
13940 if (dist < minScreenDist)
13941 {
13942 minScreenDist = dist;
13943 closestPathLine = pathLine;
13944 }
13945 }
13946 }
13947 }
13948 return closestPathLine;
13949 }
13950
13958 private double DistanceToSegment(Point2D p, Point2D a, Point2D b)
13959 {
13960 double dx = b.X - a.X;
13961 double dy = b.Y - a.Y;
13962 double l2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
13963 if (l2 < 1e-9)
13964 {
13965 double px = p.X - a.X;
13966 double py = p.Y - a.Y;
13967 return Math.Sqrt(px * px + py * py);
13968 }
13969 double t = ((p.X - a.X) * dx + (p.Y - a.Y) * dy) / l2;
13970 t = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(1, t));
13971 double projX = a.X + t * dx;
13972 double projY = a.Y + t * dy;
13973 double diffX = p.X - projX;
13974 double diffY = p.Y - projY;
13975 return Math.Sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffY * diffY);
13976 }

13985 private (int prevWp, int nextWp) FindSurroundingWaypoints(ColorPath path, int p)
13986 {
13987 int prevWp = 0;
13988 int nextWp = path.Points.Count - 1;
13989
13990 var waypointIndices = new HashSet<int>();
13991 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
13992 {
13993 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path == path)
13994 {
13995 waypointIndices.Add(wd.PointIndex);
13996 }
13997 }
13998
13999 waypointIndices.Add(0);
14000 waypointIndices.Add(path.Points.Count - 1);
14001
14002 for (int i = p - 1; i >= 0; i--)
14003 {
14004 if (waypointIndices.Contains(i))
14005 {
14006 prevWp = i;
14007 break;
14008 }
14009 }
14010
14011 for (int i = p + 1; i < path.Points.Count; i++)
14012 {
14013 if (waypointIndices.Contains(i))
14014 {
14015 nextWp = i;
14016 break;
14017 }
14018 }
14019
14020 return (prevWp, nextWp);
14021 }

14111 private void UpdateHasPathChangesVisibility()
14112 {
14113 bool pathChangesMade = UndoManager.GetTimeline().Any(c =>
14114 c.Category == "Path Planning" ||
14115 c.Category == "Path Editing" ||
14116 c.Category == "Path Translation");
14117
14118 HasPathChangesVisibility = pathChangesMade ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
14119 }
14120
14121 private DelegateCommand? recalculatePathsCommand;
14122 public ICommand RecalculatePathsCommand => recalculatePathsCommand ??= new DelegateCommand(RecalculatePaths);
14123
14127 private void RecalculatePaths()
14128 {
14129 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any()) return;
14130
14131 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
14132 try
14133 {
14134 // Backup old state for undo
14135 var oldStates = new Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>();
14136 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
14137 {
14138 oldStates[kvp.Key] = kvp.Value.CloneState();
14139 }
14140
14141 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
14142 {
14143 var path = kvp.Value;
14144
14145 // 1. Gather all active waypoint markers for this path
14146 var baseWaypoints = _designControl.Entities
14147 .Where(ent => ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path == path)
14148 .Select(ent => (WaypointData)ent.EntityData)
14149 .OrderBy(wd => wd.PointIndex)
14150 .ToList();
14151
14152 if (baseWaypoints.Count < 2) continue;
14153
14154 // 2. Extract base waypoint info
14155 var baseInfos = baseWaypoints.Select(wd => new
14156 {
14157 Position = (Point3D)path.Points[wd.PointIndex].Clone(),
14158 Normal = (Vector3D)path.Normals[wd.PointIndex].Clone(),
14159 IsMeasure = path.IsMeasure[wd.PointIndex]
14160 }).ToList();
14161
14162 var newPoints = new List<Point3D>();
14163 var newNormals = new List<Vector3D>();
14164 var newIsMeasure = new List<bool>();
14165
14166 newPoints.Add(baseInfos[0].Position);
14167 newNormals.Add(baseInfos[0].Normal);
14168 newIsMeasure.Add(baseInfos[0].IsMeasure);
14169
14170 for (int i = 0; i < baseInfos.Count - 1; i++)
14171 {
14172 var startInfo = baseInfos[i];
14173 var endInfo = baseInfos[i + 1];
14174
14175 bool shouldRecalculate = _lastRightClickedPart == null ||
14176 IsWaypointOnPart(path, baseWaypoints[i].PointIndex, _lastRightClickedPart) ||
14177 IsWaypointOnPart(path, baseWaypoints[i + 1].PointIndex, _lastRightClickedPart);
14178
14179 if (shouldRecalculate)
14180 {
14181 bool isApproachSegment = (startInfo.IsMeasure && !endInfo.IsMeasure) || (!startInfo.IsMeasure && endInfo.IsMeasure);
14182
14183 if (isApproachSegment)
14184 {
14185 newPoints.Add(endInfo.Position);
14186 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
14187 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
14188 }
14189 else
14190 {
14191 List<Point3D> segment = _pathManager.PlanCollisionFreePath(startInfo.Position, endInfo.Position);
14192 if (segment != null && segment.Count >= 2)
14193 {
14194 for (int j = 1; j < segment.Count; j++)
14195 {
14196 newPoints.Add(segment[j]);
14197 if (j == segment.Count - 1)
14198 {
14199 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
14200 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
14201 }
14202 else
14203 {
14204 newNormals.Add(Vector3D.AxisZ);
14205 newIsMeasure.Add(false);
14206 }
14207 }
14208 }
14209 else
14210 {
14211 newPoints.Add(endInfo.Position);
14212 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
14213 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
14214 }
14215 }
14216 }
14217 else
14218 {
14219 // Copy existing points from path.Points[startWpIdx + 1] to path.Points[endWpIdx]
14220 int startWpIdx = baseWaypoints[i].PointIndex;
14221 int endWpIdx = baseWaypoints[i + 1].PointIndex;
14222 for (int k = startWpIdx + 1; k <= endWpIdx; k++)
14223 {
14224 newPoints.Add((Point3D)path.Points[k].Clone());
14225 newNormals.Add((Vector3D)path.Normals[k].Clone());
14226 newIsMeasure.Add(path.IsMeasure[k]);
14227 }
14228 }
14229 }
14230
14231 path.Points = newPoints;
14232 path.Normals = newNormals;
14233 path.IsMeasure = newIsMeasure;
14234
14235 // Draw the path
14236 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(path);
14237 }
14238
14239 // Push composite undo command for all modified paths
14240 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
14241 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
14242 {
14243 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, kvp.Key, oldStates[kvp.Key], kvp.Value.CloneState()));
14244 }
14245 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
14246
14247 _designControl.Invalidate();
14248 SaveCurrentSession();
14249 }
14250 catch (Exception ex)
14251 {
14252 MessageBox.Show($"Error recalculating paths: {ex.Message}", "Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
14253 }
14254 finally
14255 {
14256 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
14257 }
14258 }
14259 #endregion
14260 }
14261}
